items.title_en: Levent Alpöge claims proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis [pdf]
items.title_zh: Levent Alpöge 声称证明了广义黎曼猜想
items.summary_en: Levent Alpöge claims to have found a proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis. The claim is presented in a PDF.
items.summary_zh: Levent Alpöge 声称找到了广义黎曼猜想的证明。相关论证以 PDF 形式发布。

items.title_en: Hurried Announcement: Alessandro Masullo GRH
items.title_zh: 仓促公告：Alessandro Masullo 的广义黎曼猜想证明
items.summary_en: Alessandro Masullo has proposed a proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis. Brian Conrad has reviewed it closely for months, provided extensive feedback, and considers the draft to be looking good so far. The authors had hoped to refine it at Stanford before announcing it, but decided to release the current draft so others could check and formalize it.
items.summary_zh: Alessandro Masullo 提出了一份广义黎曼猜想的证明。Brian Conrad 已经对其进行了数月的仔细审阅，并提供了大量反馈，目前认为证明草稿看起来不错。原计划是在斯坦福进一步完善后再公布，但现在决定先发布当前版本，供其他人检查和形式化。

items.title_en: Carnegie Mellon is putting computer science courses on YouTube for free
items.title_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学将计算机科学课程免费放到 YouTube
items.summary_en: Carnegie Mellon’s Kenneth C. Griffin School of Computer Science is publishing free lectures on YouTube. Self-paced courseware is planned as the next step. The release gives learners access to the school’s computer science material without charge.
items.summary_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学肯尼斯·C·格里芬计算机科学学院正在 YouTube 上发布免费课程讲座。下一步计划推出可自主学习的课程材料。这将让学习者免费接触该学院的计算机科学内容。

items.title_en: SpaceX catches the Starship to end Flight 15
items.title_zh: SpaceX 在第 15 次飞行结束时接住星舰
items.summary_en: SpaceX's Starship Flight 15 ended with the vehicle being caught by the launch system. The available material provides no further details about the flight or the catch.
items.summary_zh: SpaceX 的星舰第 15 次飞行以发射系统接住飞行器告终。现有信息未提供这次飞行或捕获过程的更多细节。

items.title_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Nginx
items.title_zh: Nginx 中存在无需认证的远程代码执行漏洞
items.summary_en: Nginx has been reported to contain unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities. The supplied records identify two related CVE entries, CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，Nginx 存在无需认证即可触发的远程代码执行漏洞。相关记录列出了两个 CVE 编号：CVE-2026-123633 和 CVE-2026-123007。

items.title_en: Inkling 2 Mini
items.title_zh: Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary_en: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights model small enough to run on a laptop. It is a looped transformer that runs its middle layers three times per token, allowing it to reason more and use fewer tokens. The model reportedly leads open-weights models under 100 billion total parameters on DeepSWE v1.1 and Vals Index v2.2, while also running faster than similarly performing models.
items.summary_zh: Thinking Machines 发布了 Inkling 2 Mini，这是一款小到可以在笔记本电脑上运行的开放权重模型。它采用循环 Transformer，每个 token 将中间层运行三次，从而进行更多推理并减少 token 使用量。据称，在总参数量低于 1000 亿的开放权重模型中，它在 DeepSWE v1.1 和 Vals Index v2.2 上处于领先，同时运行速度也快于性能相近的模型。

items.title_en: Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as 'biggest breakthrough in decades'
items.title_zh: 治疗胰腺癌的药片被誉为“数十年来最大突破”
items.summary_en: In a trial of daraxonrasib, the cancer became undetectable in one in 12 patients with advanced pancreatic cancer. Tumors stopped growing in nearly all of the 61 participants, whose cancer had spread to other parts of the body. The results are being hailed as a major advance in pancreatic cancer treatment.
items.summary_zh: 在 daraxonrasib 的一项试验中，12 名晚期胰腺癌患者中有 1 人的癌症变得无法检测到。61 名参与者的肿瘤几乎全部停止生长，这些患者的癌症此前已扩散到身体其他部位。这些结果被誉为胰腺癌治疗领域的重大进展。

items.title_en: GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol
items.title_zh: GPT‑6.2 Astra 与 Sol
items.summary_en: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are presented as two named models or systems. No further technical details or capabilities are established here.
items.summary_zh: GPT‑6.2 Astra 和 Sol 是两个名为 Astra 与 Sol 的模型或系统。现有信息未提供更多技术细节或功能说明。

items.title_en: New Evidence Shows School Phone Bans Are Gradually Improving Test Scores
items.title_zh: 新证据显示，学校禁用手机正逐步提高考试成绩
items.summary_en: A large national analysis comparing students’ scores before and after cellphone bans found modest academic improvements. Schools with strict policies requiring students to lock phones in pouches for the entire school day saw math and reading gains equivalent to roughly one or two additional weeks of schooling per year. The study was published by Harvard’s Center for Education Policy Research and is the first national study to track individual students’ growth in this way.
items.summary_zh: 一项比较学生禁用手机前后成绩的大型全国性分析发现，学业表现出现小幅改善。要求学生在整个上课日将手机锁入袋中的学校，数学和阅读成绩提升幅度相当于每年额外增加约一至两周的学习。该研究由哈佛教育政策研究中心发布，是首项以这种方式追踪个体学生成长的全国性研究。

items.title_en: Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis
items.title_zh: 用 Lean 验证黎曼猜想——联合声明
items.summary_en: Levent Alpöge released a Lean library containing a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis on November 20, 2026. The library comprises 17 million lines of code. The Lean and Mathlib communities issued a joint statement endorsing the verification, with support from the Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 20 日，Levent Alpöge 发布了一个包含黎曼猜想证明的 Lean 库。该库包含 1700 万行代码。Lean 和 Mathlib 社区随后发表联合声明，Lean FRO 与 Mathlib Initiative 也表示支持这项验证工作。

items.title_en: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda to standardize parts to lower costs
items.title_zh: 丰田、日产和本田将统一零部件以降低成本
items.summary_en: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda have agreed to standardize vehicle parts to reduce production costs as Japanese automakers compete with China’s growing automotive sector. The initial effort will unify quality criteria for steel, protocols for plastics and resins, and color coding for wiring harnesses. The Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association plans to expand standardization to more components across the vehicle, focusing first on parts that are largely invisible to consumers and represent significant costs.
items.summary_zh: 丰田、日产和本田已同意统一汽车零部件标准，以降低生产成本，应对中国汽车产业的增长。首阶段将统一钢材质量标准、塑料和树脂的处理规范，以及线束的颜色编码。日本汽车工业协会计划未来将标准化范围扩大到更多整车零部件，首先选择消费者通常看不到且成本占比较高的部件。

items.title_en: Java4Shell: RCE in OpenJDK when processing Base64
items.title_zh: Java4Shell：处理 Base64 时 OpenJDK 中的远程代码执行漏洞
items.summary_en: Calif disclosed Java4Shell, tracked as CVE-2026-114938, a memory-corruption vulnerability in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder. OpenJDK is described as the most popular Java runtime. The vulnerability has a CVSS 4.0 score of 9.2 out of 10, rated Critical. Its severity could make affected OpenJDK deployments a high-priority patching target.
items.summary_zh: Calif 披露了 Java4Shell（编号 CVE-2026-114938），这是 OpenJDK Base64 解码器中的内存破坏漏洞。OpenJDK 被称为最流行的 Java 运行时。该漏洞在 CVSS 4.0 中获得 9.2 分（满分 10 分），评级为“严重”。这一评级意味着受影响的 OpenJDK 部署可能需要优先修补。

items.title_en: Anthropic’s Nasdaq debut
items.title_zh: Anthropic 登陆纳斯达克
items.summary_en: Anthropic made its debut on the Nasdaq stock exchange.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 在纳斯达克证券交易所挂牌上市。

items.title_en: Gemini 4 Neon
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Neon
items.summary_en: Google has introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a model aimed at complex coding, knowledge work, and scientific workflows. The company says it offers frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion at a lower cost. The model is presented by Google DeepMind’s senior vice president and chief AI architect.
items.summary_zh: Google 推出了 Gemini 4 Neon，面向复杂编程、知识工作和科学工作流。Google 表示，该模型以更低成本提供前沿级智能，并能快速完成端到端任务。该模型由 Google DeepMind 高级副总裁兼首席 AI 架构师发布。

items.title_en: Many of Amazon’s Black Friday and Cyber Monday “deals” offered no savings
items.title_zh: 亚马逊许多黑色星期五和网络星期一“优惠”并没有省钱
items.summary_en: An investigation found that many Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals advertised by Amazon did not provide actual savings. The deals were presented as discounts even though shoppers often paid no less than usual.
items.summary_zh: 一项调查发现，亚马逊宣传的许多黑色星期五和网络星期一优惠实际上并没有带来节省。这些商品虽然以折扣形式展示，消费者实际支付的价格却往往并未降低。

items.title_en: Garage Door Spam
items.title_zh: 车库门垃圾通知
items.summary_en: A garage door opener initially sent notifications whenever the door opened or closed, which made unexpected openings seem meaningful when the owner was away. The owner continued using the myQ app despite its advertisements because the notifications appeared trustworthy.
items.summary_zh: 一款车库门开启器最初会在车门开关时发送通知，因此人在外出时，异常开门会显得格外重要。尽管 myQ 应用广告很多，用户仍因信任这些通知而继续使用它。

items.title_en: 87% of the Anthropic power will come from gas and 11% from coal in 2028
items.title_zh: 2028 年 Anthropic 的电力将有 87% 来自天然气、11% 来自煤炭
items.summary_en: A case study estimates that Anthropic could emit 32 million metric tons of carbon dioxide in 2028. It examines the company’s total power use and the role of dedicated power generation for AI data centers, noting that planned bring-your-own-power gas capacity is far more common than renewable generation. The study also identifies another 200 GW of new fossil-fuel power plants being built on the grid, partly to meet data-center demand.
items.summary_zh: 一项案例研究估计，Anthropic 在 2028 年可能排放 3,200 万吨二氧化碳。研究考察了该公司的总用电量，以及 AI 数据中心专用发电的作用，并指出已规划的“自带电力”项目中，天然气发电远多于可再生能源。研究还指出，为满足包括数据中心在内的增长需求，电网上另有 200 吉瓦新的化石燃料发电厂正在建设。

items.title_en: Quad9's withdrawal from France: A canary in the coal mine
items.title_zh: Quad9 退出法国：煤矿里的金丝雀
items.summary_en: Swiss nonprofit Quad9 said it will withdraw its free public DNS resolver from France after months of litigation. A French court imposed daily financial penalties because Quad9 did not block domains linked to alleged copyright infringement. Quad9 said the choice was between crippling penalties and changing its service in ways that would undermine user privacy and security. The case is presented as a warning about the consequences of mandating DNS-level blocking.
items.summary_zh: 瑞士非营利组织 Quad9 表示，将在经历数月诉讼后退出法国免费公共 DNS 解析服务。法国法院因其未屏蔽涉嫌侵犯版权的域名，对 Quad9 处以每日罚款。Quad9 表示，它只能在承受可能令组织陷入困境的处罚，或改变服务并损害用户隐私与安全之间作出选择。该事件被视为强制实施 DNS 层拦截可能带来后果的警示。

items.title_en: Pancreatic cancer halted by virus injection in three patients
items.title_zh: 三名胰腺癌患者在接受病毒注射后病情得到遏制
items.summary_en: A virus injection halted pancreatic cancer in three patients.
items.summary_zh: 三名胰腺癌患者在接受病毒注射后，癌症病情得到遏制。

items.title_en: Qwen4-Max
items.title_zh: Qwen4-Max
items.summary_en: Qwen4-Max is described as supporting chat, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool use, and artifacts. It is positioned as a model or service with functionality spanning multiple input and output types.
items.summary_zh: Qwen4-Max 被描述为支持聊天、图像和视频理解、图像生成、文档处理、联网搜索、工具调用及 artifacts。它定位为覆盖多种输入和输出形式的模型或服务。

items.title_en: How to make almost anything
items.title_zh: 如何制造几乎任何东西
items.summary_en: A project or course titled “How to make almost anything” focuses on creating a wide range of physical or electronic things. Further details about its methods or scope are not available here.
items.summary_zh: “如何制造几乎任何东西”是一项围绕制作各种实体或电子作品展开的项目或课程。现有信息未提供其具体方法或内容范围。

items.title_en: I'll never buy Framework hardware again
items.title_zh: 我再也不会购买 Framework 硬件
items.summary_en: The author says they no longer intend to buy Framework hardware and criticizes the company’s support. The stated goal is for Framework to fix the support problem and provide the working laptop that was paid for.
items.summary_zh: 作者表示今后不再购买 Framework 硬件，并批评该公司的客户支持。作者希望 Framework 修复支持问题，交付已经付费购买且能够正常工作的笔记本电脑。

items.title_en: Technical issue at JPMorgan Chase triggers online banking delays for US banks
items.title_zh: 摩根大通技术故障导致美国银行在线银行服务延迟
items.summary_en: A technical issue at JPMorgan Chase triggered online-banking delays for banks in the United States. The incident affected online banking service availability or responsiveness.
items.summary_zh: 摩根大通的一项技术故障引发了美国银行的在线银行服务延迟。该事件影响了在线银行服务的可用性或响应速度。

items.title_en: We need smart people who give a shit
items.title_zh: 我们需要那些聪明且真正上心的人
items.summary_en: The author argues that complex systems are held together by smart people who care deeply about their work. This view becomes especially apparent when examining how difficult systems function, or how close they are to failing. The essay begins from that observation about the people who keep complicated systems operating.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，复杂系统依靠聪明且真正关心工作的人维系。这一点在观察复杂系统如何运转，或如何勉强维持运转时尤其明显。文章以这一关于维持复杂系统运行者的观察为出发点。

items.title_en: Inside Deutsche Bank
items.title_zh: 德意志银行
items.summary_en: A major investigation into Deutsche Bank is based on a leak of more than 15 million files. The files cover sensitive functions including anti-financial-crime work, sanctions monitoring, internal auditing, and decisions about whether risky clients should remain customers. The investigation portrays flaws in the bank's culture, systemic blind spots, and tensions between profit-seeking and compliance.
items.summary_zh: 一项针对德意志银行的重大调查建立在超过 1500 万份泄露文件的基础上。这些文件涉及反金融犯罪、制裁监控、内部审计，以及决定高风险客户是否继续留存等敏感职能。调查呈现出该行文化中的缺陷、系统性盲点，以及追求利润与合规要求之间的矛盾。

items.title_en: Slopstrap – Make your site look hastily vibecoded
items.title_zh: Slopstrap：让网站看起来像是匆忙用“氛围编程”写出来的
items.summary_en: Slopstrap describes itself as a CSS framework intended to make websites look as though they were hastily created by an LLM. It presents the tool as a way to give any project an intentionally AI-generated appearance.
items.summary_zh: Slopstrap 自称是一个 CSS 框架，旨在让网站看起来像是匆忙由 LLM 创建的。它将自己定位为一种让项目呈现刻意 AI 生成风格的工具。

items.title_en: AI is killing All About Berlin
items.title_zh: AI 正在扼杀 All About Berlin
items.summary_en: The operator of All About Berlin says the site's traffic fell by 70% to 75% after years of growth, attributing the decline to Google's AI Overviews. Search pages now place an AI-generated answer trained on the site's content before the link to the site itself. The change has had a devastating effect on the site's traffic.
items.summary_zh: All About Berlin 的运营者表示，该网站在多年增长后，流量因 Google AI Overviews 下跌了 70% 至 75%。如今搜索页面会先展示基于该网站内容训练的 AI 生成答案，最后才显示指向网站的链接。这一变化对网站流量造成了严重打击。

items.title_en: Brazil's tax authority open-sources its tax calculator on GitHub under MIT
items.title_zh: 巴西税务机关在 GitHub 以 MIT 许可证开源税务计算器
items.summary_en: Brazil's tax authority has open-sourced its tax calculator on GitHub under the MIT license. The release makes the calculator's source code available for public use and inspection.
items.summary_zh: 巴西税务机关已将其税务计算器以 MIT 许可证发布到 GitHub 上。此次发布让公众可以使用并检查该计算器的源代码。

items.title_en: Apple Services Down
items.title_zh: Apple 服务中断
items.summary_en: Apple services are reported to be down. The available information does not identify which services are affected, how long the outage has lasted, or its cause.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，Apple 服务发生中断。现有信息未说明受影响的具体服务、持续时间或原因。

items.title_en: BugMeNot has closed
items.title_zh: BugMeNot 已关闭
items.summary_en: BugMeNot has closed. Its farewell thanks everyone who envisioned a better internet.
items.summary_zh: BugMeNot 已经关闭。告别信息向所有曾设想建设更好互联网的人表示感谢。

items.title_en: Windows 11 is collecting data on which coding agents and developer tools you use
items.title_zh: Windows 11 正收集你使用哪些编程代理和开发工具的数据
items.summary_en: Reverse engineering of Windows 11’s MissionControlAggregator found coding-agent and developer-tool usage bits in a diagnostic ETW report. The observed list includes Codex, Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Python, .NET, GCC, and Visual Studio Code executables. The finding raises questions about why a Windows system DLL records the use of these tools.
items.summary_zh: 对 Windows 11 的 MissionControlAggregator 进行逆向分析后，研究者在诊断 ETW 报告中发现了编程代理和开发工具的使用标记。相关列表包括 Codex、Claude、Copilot、Cursor，以及 Python、.NET、GCC 和 Visual Studio Code 等可执行文件。这一发现引出了一个问题：Windows 系统 DLL 为何要记录这些工具的使用情况。

items.title_en: If you can't explain something in simple terms, you don't understand it (2017)
items.title_zh: 如果你无法用简单的话解释某件事，你其实并不理解它（2017）
items.summary_en: In the early 1960s, Richard Feynman delivered a series of undergraduate physics lectures. Those lectures were later collected into the book The Feynman Lectures on Physics.
items.summary_zh: 20 世纪 60 年代初，理查德·费曼为本科生讲授了一系列物理课程。这些讲座后来被汇编成《费曼物理学讲义》。

items.title_en: Detonating a pile of lead azide
items.title_zh: Derek Lowe：引爆一大堆叠氮化铅
items.summary_en: The piece concerns the detonation of a large pile of lead azide. Lead azide is an explosive compound, making the incident a hazardous chemistry event.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容涉及引爆一大堆叠氮化铅。叠氮化铅是一种爆炸性化合物，因此这是一起危险的化学实验事件。

items.title_en: Google's AI answers reducing search traffic by 40%
items.title_zh: 谷歌 AI 答案让搜索流量下降 40%
items.summary_en: A randomized experiment found that Google AI Overviews reduce clicks to external websites by about 40% among US desktop users. The summaries now appear on more than half of the US keywords tracked by DataForSEO, up from 6% two years earlier. Generative engine optimization has not yet demonstrated a way to offset the lost traffic, while AI assistants sent websites only 0.3% of their traffic in March. The findings indicate that traditional search rankings bring substantially fewer visits when an AI answer appears above them.
items.summary_zh: 一项随机实验发现，在美国桌面用户中，谷歌 AI Overviews 会让外部网站获得的点击量减少约 40%。根据 DataForSEO 的跟踪数据，这些摘要如今出现在超过一半的美国关键词结果中，而两年前这一比例仅为 6%。生成式引擎优化尚未证明能弥补这部分流量损失；3 月份，AI 助手为网站带来的流量仅占 0.3%。这表明，当 AI 答案出现在搜索结果上方时，传统排名带来的访问量会显著下降。

items.title_en: UK government forced to admit it issued Apple a secret encryption order
items.title_zh: 英国政府被迫承认曾向苹果发出秘密加密命令
items.summary_en: The Investigatory Powers Tribunal rejected the UK government’s attempt to keep its order to Apple secret. The tribunal ruled that the government must acknowledge issuing Apple a Technical Capability Notice under Section 253 of the Investigatory Powers Act 2016. Such notices can require technology companies to alter services to facilitate investigatory powers, in this case amid a dispute over encrypted iCloud data.
items.summary_zh: 调查权力法庭驳回了英国政府试图对苹果命令保持保密的做法。法庭裁定，政府必须承认其依据《2016 年调查权力法》第 253 条向苹果发出过技术能力通知。这类通知可以要求科技公司修改服务，以协助行使调查权；本案涉及加密 iCloud 数据争议。

items.title_en: My monitor was cutting my download speed by 75%
items.title_zh: 我的显示器让下载速度下降了 75%
items.summary_en: A 2.5 Gbps symmetrical internet connection produced 2.4 Gbps uploads but only 600 Mbps downloads. The same result appeared on another laptop, while the ISP found no problem on its side. The investigation traced the bottleneck to a Studio Display XDR, a small buffer, and a USB burst size of four packets.
items.summary_zh: 一条上下行对称 2.5 Gbps 的网络连接，上传速度达到 2.4 Gbps，但下载速度只有 600 Mbps。在另一台笔记本电脑上测试也得到相同结果，而 ISP 检查后未发现其网络存在问题。调查最终将瓶颈定位到 Studio Display XDR、一个较小的缓冲区，以及每次四个数据包的 USB 突发大小。

items.title_en: Optimizely compromised, served malware on Zoom, GitLab
items.title_zh: Optimizely 遭入侵，Zoom、GitLab 等网站被投放恶意软件
items.summary_en: On November 16, 2026, malicious JavaScript was served through Optimizely’s Web experimentation platform to visitors of 178 organizations, including Zoom, the BBC, CNN, Salesforce, GitLab, IKEA, HSBC, and others. The malware could replace cryptocurrency wallet addresses, skim payment-card data, steal cookies and screenshots, and deliver the Coruna and DarkSword iOS exploit kits on iPhones and iPads. Cryptocurrency had already been stolen in transactions verified as belonging to the attackers.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 16 日，Optimizely 的 Web 实验平台向 178 家机构的网站访客投放了恶意 JavaScript，受影响机构包括 Zoom、BBC、CNN、Salesforce、GitLab、IKEA 和 HSBC 等。该恶意软件能够替换加密货币钱包地址、窃取支付卡数据、Cookie 和屏幕截图，并在 iPhone 和 iPad 上投递 Coruna 与 DarkSword iOS 漏洞利用套件。已有加密货币在被确认属于攻击者的交易中遭窃取。

items.title_en: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI
items.title_zh: Frostbite：由 AI 发现、设计并验证的新型 CPU 架构
items.summary_en: Frostbite is a general-purpose CPU built around interaction nets, with its architecture discovered, designed, and verified end to end by AI systems. The project introduces a new instruction set and exploits local steps, explicit dependencies, and single ownership of values. On the reported benchmark, it reached 4.59 times the performance per watt of a modern dual-issue, in-order CPU core.
items.summary_zh: Frostbite 是一款基于交互网络的通用 CPU，其架构由 AI 系统端到端完成发现、设计和验证。该项目引入了全新的指令集，并利用局部步骤、显式依赖和数值单一所有权等特性。在所报告的基准测试中，它达到了现代双发射顺序执行 CPU 核心 4.59 倍的每瓦性能。

items.title_en: Highly classified US national security communications network goes down
items.title_zh: 高度机密的美国国家安全通信网络发生故障
items.summary_en: The highly classified network used by the National Security Agency for internal communications is down, according to six people familiar with the matter. The reported outage affects a communications system supporting the agency’s internal operations.
items.summary_zh: 据六名知情人士透露，美国国家安全局用于内部通信的高度机密网络目前发生故障。此次中断影响了支持该机构内部运作的通信系统。

items.title_en: How the European Commission rolled out Matrix to more than 40k staff
items.title_zh: 欧洲委员会如何将 Matrix 推广给超过 4 万名员工
items.summary_en: The European Commission moved from a Matrix proof of concept in December 2025 to a sovereign communication tool deployed on every Commission laptop by September 2026. Built on Matrix by Element and operated by the Commission itself, the service now supports more than 40,000 users. Commission officials described the operational challenges of scaling the system and how they addressed them.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲委员会从 2025 年 12 月的 Matrix 概念验证起步，到 2026 年 9 月将一套主权通信工具部署到每台委员会笔记本电脑上。该工具由 Element 基于 Matrix 构建，并由委员会自行运营，目前已服务超过 4 万名用户。委员会官员还介绍了系统扩展过程中遇到的运营难题及应对方式。

items.title_en: Nvidia stopped disclosing Singapore sales as revenues hit $104B
items.title_zh: 英伟达营收达到 1040 亿美元后停止披露新加坡销售额
items.summary_en: Nvidia stopped disclosing its Singapore sales as its revenue reached $104 billion. No further details about the reporting change or its reasons are established here.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达营收达到 1040 亿美元后，停止披露其在新加坡的销售额。现有信息未说明这一报告变化的具体原因或其他细节。

items.title_en: Microsoft 365 outage leads to chlorine gas poisoning of 15 hotel guests
items.title_zh: Microsoft 365 故障导致 15 名酒店客人氯气中毒
items.summary_en: A Microsoft Outlook outage meant Phantasialand did not receive notice that excessive chlorine was present in a pool. Fifteen guests were injured as a result.
items.summary_zh: 微软 Outlook 服务中断，导致 Phantasialand 未能收到泳池氯含量过高的通知。结果造成 15 名客人受伤。

items.title_en: Ask HN: I have been unemployed for 2y. 15 years of experience, US. What to do?
items.title_zh: 问 HN：我失业两年了，有 15 年经验，在美国该怎么办？
items.summary_en: A senior software engineer in the US DMV area says they have been unemployed for two years after leaving an insurance technology company in January 2025. They have 15 years of experience, continue tutoring mathematics, and may soon manage a pizzeria, but have found no software engineering job despite skills in C#/.NET, AWS, and AI. With only four to five months of savings left, they are asking for well-paid alternatives to software engineering or adjacent work.
items.summary_zh: 一名居住在美国 DMV 地区的资深软件工程师表示，自己在 2025 年 1 月离开一家保险科技公司后已失业两年。此人拥有 15 年经验，目前继续辅导数学，并可能很快开始担任披萨店经理，但尽管具备 C#/.NET、AWS 和 AI 技能，仍未找到软件工程工作。由于积蓄只够支撑四到五个月，对方正在寻求软件工程或相关领域之外的高薪替代路径。

items.title_en: DNS resolvers are the wrong place to fight piracy
items.title_zh: Quad9 将退出法国：DNS 解析器不该成为打击盗版的场所
items.summary_en: The nonprofit DNS resolver Quad9 will stop answering queries from France on November 24, 2026, rather than comply with a Paris court order sought by beIN Sports. The court fined Quad9 for refusing to block pirate sports-streaming domains, and roughly 20 similar cases are still pending. The dispute raises concerns that forcing public DNS resolvers to enforce domain blocking could undermine services beyond its intended target.
items.summary_zh: 非营利 DNS 解析器 Quad9 将于 2026 年 11 月 24 日停止响应来自法国的查询，以拒绝执行 beIN Sports 申请的巴黎法院命令。Quad9 因拒绝屏蔽盗版体育流媒体域名而被罚款，法国目前还有约 20 起类似案件待审。这场争议引发了对强制公共 DNS 解析器执行域名屏蔽可能造成更广泛影响的担忧。

items.title_en: Universal XSS in uBlock Origin from website-driven element picker
items.title_zh: uBlock Origin 的网站驱动元素选择器存在通用 XSS
items.summary_en: A one-click universal XSS vulnerability affected the Firefox version of uBlock Origin through its element picker. A malicious website could trick the extension into adding arbitrary trusted filters, which can inject JavaScript into other websites and execute it in their contexts. The issue has been fixed; a related but less severe problem also affected the MV3-based uBO Lite.
items.summary_zh: uBlock Origin 的 Firefox 版本元素选择器存在一个可通过一次点击触发的通用 XSS 漏洞。恶意网站可以诱使扩展添加任意受信过滤规则，而受信规则能够向其他网站注入 JavaScript，并在这些网站的上下文中执行。该问题现已修复；基于 MV3 的 uBO Lite 也受到一个相关但危害较小的问题影响。

items.title_en: Seven new models at scalable price-performance
items.title_zh: 七个具备可扩展性价比的新模型
items.summary_en: Microsoft has announced seven new models positioned around scalable price-performance.
items.summary_zh: Microsoft 宣布推出七个新模型，主打可扩展的价格与性能表现。

items.title_en: We promoted developers into architects without informing them
items.title_zh: 我们把开发者提拔成架构师，却没有告诉他们
items.summary_en: The author argues that AI-assisted coding shifts developers’ work toward architecture and product judgment. A performance bug in a Google Forms add-on was traced to AI-generated logging that recorded user email information despite Google’s restrictions. The proposed fix is to log only the timestamp, show the welcome screen first, and tell marketing which installation data is unavailable.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，AI 辅助编程正在把开发者的工作重心转向架构和产品判断。一个 Google Forms 插件的性能问题，最终被追溯到 AI 生成的日志代码：它记录了用户邮箱，而 Google 已限制可获取的用户信息。作者提出的修复方案是只记录时间戳、先显示欢迎界面，并告知市场团队安装时无法获取哪些数据。

items.title_en: Inkling-2-Mini in 5.4 GB Memory
items.title_zh: 在 5.4 GB 内存中运行 Inkling-2-Mini
items.summary_en: LookAtMyQuant is a quantization compiler that evaluates how much compressing each part of a model affects its output. It selects codes for individual parts so the model fits a size budget with minimal damage. On Gemma 4 E2B, its GGUF reportedly achieves 12 times lower KL divergence than Q4_K_M at the same file size.
items.summary_zh: LookAtMyQuant 是一个量化编译器，用于评估压缩模型各部分对输出造成的影响。它会为各个部分选择编码，使模型在满足大小限制的同时尽量减少损失。在 Gemma 4 E2B 上，其 GGUF 文件在相同文件大小下的 KL 散度据称比 Q4_K_M 低 12 倍。

items.title_en: Sandwich Simulator
items.title_zh: 三明治模拟器
items.summary_en: Sandwich Simulator lets users spread something on a slice of bread, add toppings, and take a photo. Each creation receives a number and a link.
items.summary_zh: “三明治模拟器”允许用户在一片面包上涂抹食材、添加配料并拍照。每个作品都会获得一个编号和链接。

items.title_en: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data
items.title_zh: 限制移动操作系统中的 AI 代理捕获数据
items.summary_en: Signal says it is restricting the latest AI agents built into mobile operating systems from potentially capturing and storing Signal data. The move is presented as part of Signal’s broader privacy mission.
items.summary_zh: Signal 表示，正在限制移动操作系统中最新的 AI 代理，以防它们捕获并存储 Signal 数据。这一举措被视为 Signal 隐私保护使命的一部分。

items.title_en: Claude solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
items.title_zh: Claude 破解黑洞物理学中的两个开放问题
items.summary_en: Claude Fable 5.2 is reported to have solved two open problems in theoretical physics involving black holes and the search for quantum gravity. The problems sit at the intersection of general relativity and quantum mechanics, whose mathematical incompatibility remains a central challenge in physics. Researchers often use holographic duality and simplified model universes to study these questions.
items.summary_zh: 据称，Claude Fable 5.2 解决了理论物理学中的两个开放问题，涉及黑洞和量子引力理论的探索。这些问题位于广义相对论与量子力学的交叉地带，而两者在数学上的不相容仍是物理学的核心挑战之一。研究人员经常借助全息对偶和简化的模型宇宙来研究这些问题。

items.title_en: Carnival Cruises emits ten times more sulphur oxide than all of Europe's cars (2019)
items.title_zh: 嘉年华邮轮排放的硫氧化物是欧洲所有汽车总和的十倍（2019）
items.summary_en: A Transport & Environment analysis found that Carnival Corporation emitted nearly 10 times more sulfur oxides around European coasts in 2017 than all 260 million European cars combined. The report attributes the pollution to cruise ships burning dirty bunker fuel. The findings prompted calls for cleaner fuel and stronger controls on shipping emissions.
items.summary_zh: Transport & Environment 的分析发现，2017 年嘉年华集团在欧洲海岸附近排放的硫氧化物，几乎是欧洲 2.6 亿辆汽车总和的 10 倍。报告将污染归因于邮轮燃烧污染严重的船用燃料。该发现促使人们呼吁使用更清洁的燃料，并加强对航运排放的监管。

items.title_en: Unforced Navier-Stokes Singularity and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
items.title_zh: 无外力 Navier–Stokes 奇异性与广义黎曼猜想
items.summary_en: Terence Tao lists recent results involving unforced Euler and Navier–Stokes equations, the Riemann Hypothesis, and researchers including Levent Alpöge and Tristan Buckmaster. He says the results will be reported more widely, while noting that their current level of digestion varies. The post is dated November 20, 2026.
items.summary_zh: Terence Tao 列出了涉及无外力 Euler 方程、Navier–Stokes 方程、黎曼猜想以及 Levent Alpöge、Tristan Buckmaster 等研究者的最新结果。他表示，这些结果还会在其他渠道广泛报道，同时指出目前对这些成果的理解和整理程度各不相同。该文章发表于 2026 年 11 月 20 日。

items.title_en: Frame – 31.5" color ePaper display
items.title_zh: Frame：31.5 英寸彩色电子纸显示器
items.summary_en: Frame is a handmade wooden frame containing a 31.5-inch full-color ePaper display. It is the product’s third release and is now available for pre-order. The first batch is limited to about 470 units, with a few intended to ship by the end of 2026 and most deliveries expected in early 2027.
items.summary_zh: Frame 是一款采用手工木制外壳的 31.5 英寸全彩电子纸显示器。这是该产品的第三次发布，目前已开放预订。首批约 470 台，计划在 2026 年底前发出少量产品，大多数订单预计于 2027 年初交付。

items.title_en: The MacBook Pro's OLED PWM problem
items.title_zh: MacBook Pro 的 OLED PWM 问题：更好的显示屏为何更难用
items.summary_en: Apple has introduced tandem OLED technology to the MacBook Pro, alongside the Mini-LED option that remains available. The display offers individually illuminated pixels, effectively infinite contrast, deeper blacks, higher peak HDR brightness, and touch input, prompting an overwhelmingly positive initial reaction. The source argues that impressive image quality does not necessarily make the screen comfortable for every user, particularly because of its PWM behavior.
items.summary_zh: 苹果为 MacBook Pro 引入了串联 OLED 技术，同时继续提供 Mini-LED 版本。该显示屏具备独立发光像素、近乎无限的对比度、更深的黑色、更高的 HDR 峰值亮度，并首次支持触控，发布初期反响普遍积极。文章指出，出色的画质并不一定意味着所有用户都能舒适使用，尤其是其 PWM 特性可能带来问题。

items.title_en: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day
items.title_zh: 纳斯达克抹去 2026 年全部涨幅，AI 抛售拖累 Anthropic 上市第二日
items.summary_en: The Nasdaq Composite erased all of its gains for 2026 and ended Friday 5% below its value on January 1. Anthropic's stock fell during its second trading day, failing to lift the wider market. The Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 both closed in correction territory as investors questioned the large sums being committed to AI infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 纳斯达克综合指数抹去了 2026 年以来的全部涨幅，周五收盘时较 1 月 1 日的水平低 5%。Anthropic 股价在上市第二个交易日下跌，未能提振整体市场。道琼斯工业平均指数和标普 500 指数均以进入回调区间收盘，投资者开始质疑投入 AI 基础设施的巨额资金。

items.title_en: ID.me terms required for IRS sign-in
items.title_zh: IRS 登录要求接受 ID.me 条款
items.summary_en: Taxpayers using ID.me to sign in to IRS online services accept terms that send most disputes to arbitration rather than a judge or jury, unless they opt out within 30 days. ID.me's privacy policy says it may use information for marketing and transfer information during a sale, merger, or similar transaction. It excludes government identity-verification data from ID.me Shop marketing unless the user consents or another listed exception applies. Login.gov and IRS Direct Pay remain alternatives for IRS access.
items.summary_zh: 纳税人使用 ID.me 登录美国国税局在线服务时，将接受把大多数争议提交仲裁、而非交由法官或陪审团审理的条款，除非在 30 天内选择退出。ID.me 的隐私政策称，其可能将信息用于营销，并在出售、合并或类似交易中转移信息。政府身份验证数据通常不会用于 ID.me Shop 的营销，但用户同意或符合其他列明例外的情况除外。IRS 仍提供 Login.gov 和无需登录的 Direct Pay 作为替代方式。

items.title_en: Why there are still no non-WebKit browsers on iOS
items.title_zh: 为什么 iOS 上仍然没有非 WebKit 浏览器
items.summary_en: Mozilla says that no browser using an engine other than WebKit has launched on iOS, even years after Apple allowed alternative engines in the EU. Since the EU’s Digital Markets Act began requiring browser choice in 2024, millions of users have selected Firefox and its daily iOS use has doubled. Apple still requires all iOS browsers to use its own browser engine.
items.summary_zh: Mozilla 表示，即使苹果在欧盟允许使用替代浏览器引擎多年，iOS 上仍没有采用非 WebKit 引擎的浏览器推出。自欧盟《数字市场法》于 2024 年开始要求提供浏览器选择以来，已有数百万用户选择 Firefox，其在 iOS 上的日活跃使用量也翻了一倍。苹果仍要求所有 iOS 浏览器使用自家的浏览器引擎。

items.title_en: Perplexity and Intelligence
items.title_zh: 困惑度与智能
items.summary_en: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki describes modern AI as largely based on training a compressor or predictor over a very large corpus of data.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨困惑度如何衡量 AI 模型的进步，以及它如何帮助开发者建立评估新兴能力的共同方法。OpenAI 首席科学家 Jakub Pachocki 将现代 AI 描述为主要通过在超大规模数据语料上训练压缩器或预测器来构建。

items.title_en: AI agents ask better questions than KPMG accountants in audit trial
items.title_zh: 审计试验中，AI 智能体比 KPMG 会计师提出了更好的问题
items.summary_en: KPMG UK tested more than 100 AI agents on the accounts of a major UK-listed company. The agents sometimes investigated financial issues more deeply and asked better questions than the human audit team. The experiment raises questions about how automation could change the economics of auditing as machines take on more analytical work.
items.summary_zh: KPMG 英国分部让 100 多个 AI 智能体审查一家英国上市大型公司的账目。在试验中，智能体有时比人类审计团队更深入地调查财务问题，并提出更好的问题。随着机器承担更多分析工作，这项试验引发了人们对自动化将如何改变审计行业经济模式的讨论。

items.title_en: Fuck Your AI Safeguards
items.title_zh: 去你的 AI 安全护栏
items.summary_en: A developer describes asking Claude Code to identify easy security improvements in a project and finding a one-line fix. The attempt was then blocked by AI safeguards, despite the developer saying they controlled the product and were trying to address security and compliance issues.
items.summary_zh: 一名开发者让 Claude Code 找出项目中容易修复的安全问题，并发现了一个只需一行代码即可解决的问题。随后，这一操作被 AI 安全护栏阻止，尽管开发者表示自己控制着该产品，目的是修复安全问题并满足合规要求。

items.title_en: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
items.title_zh: 语言模型可以重写自己的权重
items.summary_en: Researchers describe a self-rewriting method in which a language model diagnoses its failures and edits its own weights without gradients or another training run. An open 27-billion-parameter model improved its accuracy by 6.6 points on unseen problems after its own edit. Across eight sessions, it repeatedly tested edits and retained only those that improved performance, and it restored a damaged copy to more than 80% of its original image-task accuracy.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员介绍了一种自我重写方法：语言模型无需梯度或重新训练，就能诊断自身失败并修改权重。一个拥有 270 亿参数的开放模型在自我修改后，在未见过的问题上的准确率提高了 6.6 个百分点。模型在八个连续会话中反复测试修改，只保留能提升性能的版本，并将一个受损副本恢复到原始图像任务准确率的 80% 以上。

items.title_en: What's Next for Nvidia?
items.title_zh: 英伟达的下一步是什么？
items.summary_en: Nvidia’s board announced that co-founder Jensen Huang had resigned after 33 years at the company. The change raises questions about what happens when a company loses a visionary chief executive. The supplied discussion argues that Nvidia could risk losing innovation and relying on momentum and its brand.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达董事会宣布，联合创始人黄仁勋在公司任职 33 年后辞职。这一变动引发了人们对公司失去具有远见的首席执行官后将如何发展的疑问。相关讨论认为，英伟达可能面临创新减弱、转而依赖既有势头和品牌的风险。

items.title_en: Phrack 73
items.title_zh: Phrack 73
items.summary_en: Phrack's latest release follows its 40th-anniversary relaunch, which included a printed edition, conference events, talks, and a capture-the-flag challenge. The relaunch aimed to put new research in readers' hands and encourage people to read, research, write, and contribute again. Its stated goal is to inspire readers to take systems apart and investigate how they work.
items.summary_zh: Phrack 的最新一期延续了其 40 周年重启活动，该活动包括纸质版、会议活动、演讲和夺旗挑战。重启的目标是把新的研究成果交到读者手中，并鼓励人们重新阅读、研究、写作和贡献。其明确目标是激发读者拆解系统、探究其工作方式。

items.title_en: Handwriting, as a Font
items.title_zh: 把手写字迹变成字体
items.summary_en: This browser tool turns a user’s handwriting into a font. Users write each letter in the browser and download the result as OTF or WOFF2. No account or upload is required, and the letters remain on the device.
items.summary_zh: 这个浏览器工具可以将用户的手写字迹转换为字体。用户在浏览器中书写每个字母，然后下载 OTF 或 WOFF2 格式的字体。它无需账户或上传，字母会保留在设备上。

items.title_en: Protomaps: Self-hosting map tiles has gotten cheap and easy
items.title_zh: Protomaps：自托管地图瓦片如今既便宜又简单
items.summary_en: Protomaps uses PMTiles, a tile format that stores a map in a single file and serves it through HTTP Range requests. The file can be uploaded to a storage bucket and cached by compatible CDNs, while an edge function can translate conventional x/y/z tile URLs for services such as Cloudflare. This makes map data portable and inexpensive to deploy compared with usage-priced commercial APIs.
items.summary_zh: Protomaps 使用 PMTiles，这种瓦片格式将地图存储在单个文件中，并通过 HTTP Range 请求提供服务。该文件可以上传到存储桶并由支持相关缓存的 CDN 缓存；对于 Cloudflare 等服务，也可以用边缘函数将传统的 x/y/z 瓦片 URL 转换为 Range 请求。与按使用量收费的商业 API 相比，这让地图数据更易移植，也更便宜易部署。

items.title_en: Microsoft's ONNX Runtime has disappeared from GitHub
items.title_zh: 微软 ONNX Runtime 从 GitHub 消失
items.summary_en: Microsoft's ONNX Runtime has disappeared from GitHub. The available information does not establish why it disappeared, when the change occurred, or what will happen to the project.
items.summary_zh: 微软的 ONNX Runtime 已从 GitHub 消失。现有信息无法确认其消失原因、发生时间或项目后续安排。

items.title_en: Microsoft blames monster email outage on software defect introduced in July fix
items.title_zh: 微软称大规模电子邮件故障源于 7 月修复引入的软件缺陷
items.summary_en: Microsoft blamed last week’s major Microsoft 365 email outage on a defect introduced by a July 2026 change. The defect remained dormant in network gateway servers until increased load and reduced capacity triggered it, causing a day-long disruption. Microsoft’s preliminary post-incident report said the change had passed load testing and initially caused no impact after deployment.
items.summary_zh: 微软将上周 Microsoft 365 大规模电子邮件故障归因于 2026 年 7 月一次变更引入的软件缺陷。该缺陷一直潜伏在网络网关服务器中，直到负载上升、容量下降时被触发，造成持续一天的中断。微软的初步事后报告称，该变更通过了负载测试，部署后最初也没有造成影响。

items.title_en: Jiff 1.0: A datetime library for Rust
items.title_zh: Jiff 1.0：Rust 的日期时间库
items.summary_en: Jiff 1.0 is a datetime library for Rust that puts time-zone handling at the center of its API. It automatically addresses many common daylight-saving-time problems and is already widely adopted in the Rust ecosystem. The name is pronounced like “gif,” with a soft “g,” as in “gem.”
items.summary_zh: Jiff 1.0 是一个 Rust 日期时间库，其 API 将时区处理置于核心位置。它会自动处理许多与夏令时有关的常见问题，并已在 Rust 生态中得到广泛采用。Jiff 的发音类似带软 g 音的“gif”，就像“gem”中的 g。

items.title_en: What Happened to Silicon Valley?
items.title_zh: 硅谷发生了什么？
items.summary_en: The lecture traces Silicon Valley's shift from customer-centered innovation toward extraction driven by shareholder capitalism, monopoly ambitions, and hype. It connects that evolution to the current AI boom and argues that technology's value depends on surrounding rules, incentives, and interfaces. Its proposed direction emphasizes openness, portability, interoperability, and a circulatory economy of value.
items.summary_zh: 这场演讲追溯了硅谷如何从以客户为中心的创新，转向由股东资本主义、垄断野心和炒作驱动的价值攫取。演讲将这一变化与当前 AI 热潮联系起来，并认为技术价值取决于周围的规则、激励机制和界面。其主张的方向强调开放性、可移植性、互操作性，以及价值循环流动的经济模式。

items.title_en: MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash
items.title_zh: MAI Code 2 与 Code 2 Flash
items.summary_en: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash are two named systems or models. No further capabilities, availability, or technical specifications are established here.
items.summary_zh: MAI Code 2 和 MAI Code 2 Flash 是两个名为 Code 2 与 Code 2 Flash 的系统或模型。现有信息未提供更多功能、可用性或技术规格。

items.title_en: Anthropic prices initial public offering
items.title_zh: Anthropic 确定 IPO 发行价
items.summary_en: Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per Class A share. The offering consists of 980 million shares, including 956,351,354 sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 sold by existing stockholders. Trading is expected to begin on Nasdaq under the symbol “ANT” on November 19, 2026, with closing expected the following day and an underwriter option for up to 147 million additional shares.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 将其 A 类普通股 IPO 发行价定为每股 83 美元。本次发行共 9.8 亿股，其中 Anthropic 出售 956,351,354 股，部分现有股东出售 23,648,646 股。股票预计于 2026 年 11 月 19 日以“ANT”为代码在纳斯达克开始交易，发行预计于次日完成，承销商另拥有最多追加购买 1.47 亿股的 30 天期权。

items.title_en: 350 years ago, Ole Rømer discovered that light has a finite speed
items.title_zh: 350 年前，奥勒·罗默发现光速有限
items.summary_en: In September 1676, Ole Rømer predicted that Jupiter's moon Io would emerge from the planet's shadow 10 minutes later than expected. He presented the prediction to members of the Académie des Sciences in Paris. The observation demonstrated that light takes time to travel.
items.summary_zh: 1676 年 9 月，奥勒·罗默预测木星卫星木卫一从行星阴影中出现的时间会比预期晚 10 分钟。他将这一预测提交给巴黎科学院成员。这一观测证明了光的传播需要时间。

items.title_en: "I can tell you wrote this yourself"
items.title_zh: “我看得出来这是你亲自写的”
items.summary_en: A supervisor told the author, “I can tell you wrote this yourself,” while reviewing a progress report. The roughly 10-page report concerned the control of flapping-wing micro aerial vehicles. The author had written about 5,000 words in 48 stressful hours after mistakenly setting the deadline a week early.
items.summary_zh: 导师在审阅作者的进度报告时说：“我看得出来这是你亲自写的。”这份约 10 页的报告主题是扑翼微型飞行器的控制。作者误把截止日期设早了一周，随后在紧张的 48 小时内写下了约 5000 字。

items.title_en: What is w2rt6byl5nf1opmc-a.com?
items.title_zh: w2rt6byl5nf1opmc-a.com 是什么？
items.summary_en: A website owner noticed a new backlink from w2rt6byl5nf1opmc-a.com while demonstrating a backlink monitor to a friend. After clicking it, the owner remembered that the site could log an IP address or contain a multi-day exploit chain, and was greeted by an unexpected page.
items.summary_zh: 一位网站所有者在向朋友演示反向链接监控器时，发现 w2rt6byl5nf1opmc-a.com 突然产生了一个新链接。点击后，他意识到该网站可能记录 IP 地址，甚至包含持续数日的攻击链，随后看到了一个出乎意料的页面。

items.title_en: Getting the mind to steer the body to steer you
items.title_zh: 让心智操控身体，再让身体引导你
items.summary_en: The discussion argues that people’s bodies often steer their behavior in daily life. It connects this idea with earlier writing about manifesting, personal agency, and gaining the benefits of wearables without owning one. The participants describe mindset as a central thread linking these topics.
items.summary_zh: 这段讨论认为，人们的身体在日常生活中往往会反过来引导自己的行为。它将这一想法与此前关于显化、个人能动性以及不购买设备也能获得可穿戴设备益处的文章联系起来。参与者认为，心态是串联这些主题的核心线索。

items.title_en: Ruby2ßhell: Pre-authentication RCE on stock Rails
items.title_zh: Ruby2ßhell：原生 Rails 上的预认证远程代码执行
items.summary_en: Ruby2Shell is a one-byte heap overflow in Ruby's string case-conversion code. In common Ruby web frameworks and self-hosted software, the flaw can be reached without authentication when affected configurations or application code process strings in a legacy encoding. The advisory lists popular software whose latest versions bundle an affected Ruby.
items.summary_zh: Ruby2Shell 是 Ruby 字符串大小写转换代码中的单字节堆溢出漏洞。在常见 Ruby Web 框架和自托管软件中，受影响的默认配置或处理旧式编码字符串的应用代码可能让攻击者无需认证触发该漏洞。公告列出了最新版本仍捆绑受影响 Ruby 的热门软件。

items.title_en: 15M web servers on one VM – smoltcp, DPDK, AF_XDP
items.title_zh: 一台虚拟机运行 1500 万个 Web 服务器——smoltcp、DPDK 与 AF_XDP
items.summary_en: The project aims to run 15 million web servers on one virtual machine with 10 GB of RAM and a single CPU core. It explores kernel bypass and moving the TCP/IP stack into user space, using technologies such as smoltcp, DPDK, and AF_XDP. The stated goal is to understand how far server density can be pushed, rather than to deploy a conventional web service.
items.summary_zh: 该项目的目标是在一台配备 10 GB 内存和单个 CPU 核心的虚拟机上运行 1500 万个 Web 服务器。项目探索内核旁路以及将 TCP/IP 协议栈移到用户态，并使用 smoltcp、DPDK 和 AF_XDP 等技术。其目标是研究服务器密度的极限，而不是部署传统的 Web 服务。

items.title_en: PostgreSQL 19
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 19
items.summary_en: PostgreSQL 19 introduces a new REPACK command that reclaims disk space and reorganizes table contents. REPACK can improve query performance, and REPACK (CONCURRENTLY) allows this work without blocking reads and writes to the table.
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 19 引入了新的 REPACK 命令，用于回收磁盘空间并重新组织表内容。REPACK 可以改善查询性能，而 REPACK（CONCURRENTLY）允许在不阻塞表读写的情况下完成这项工作。

items.title_en: How to CAD Almost Anything
items.title_zh: 如何为几乎任何东西创建 CAD 模型
items.summary_en: This workshop introduces computer-aided design through reverse-engineering projects involving objects such as mugs, bottles, rockets, jet-engine blades, test dummies, and animated scenes. It emphasizes planning, independent thinking, and choosing appropriate tools rather than simply following engineering drawings. The material also includes interactive examples and links to SolidWorks and Creo resources.
items.summary_zh: 这门工作坊通过对杯子、瓶子、火箭、喷气发动机叶片、测试假人和动画场景等物体进行逆向工程，介绍计算机辅助设计。课程强调规划、独立思考和选择合适工具，而不是机械地遵循工程图纸。材料还包含互动示例，以及 SolidWorks 和 Creo 资源链接。

items.title_en: Old Bitly links are being hijacked
items.title_zh: 旧 Bitly 链接正遭劫持
items.summary_en: Burger King and McDonald’s were not hacked. Instead, someone re-registered Bitly links posted in their 2011 tweets. The same person or group has replaced 57 of 97 links in old tweets by Donald Trump.
items.summary_zh: 汉堡王和麦当劳并未遭到黑客入侵。有人重新注册了它们在 2011 年推文中使用的 Bitly 链接。同样的问题还影响了唐纳德·特朗普旧推文中的 97 个链接，其中 57 个已被替换。

items.title_en: jQuery 4.1.0
items.title_zh: jQuery 4.1.0
items.summary_en: jQuery 4.1.0 was released, with the release notes listing an Ajax change that adds a responseURL field to jqXHR. The same announcement also references a jQuery 3.8.0 release. The update continues development of the JavaScript library across its newer and older release lines.
items.summary_zh: jQuery 4.1.0 已发布，更新说明列出了一项 Ajax 改动：为 jqXHR 添加 responseURL 字段。同一公告还提到了 jQuery 3.8.0 的发布。此次更新同时推进了该 JavaScript 库的新旧版本线。

items.title_en: Someone reported java4shell bug in September 2026
items.title_zh: 有人在 2026 年 9 月报告了 java4shell 漏洞
items.summary_en: An OpenJDK pull request reports a heap-corruption bug in the x86-64 AVX-512 VBMI Base64 decoder. The flaw appears when invalid input leaves a short padded tail, causing the decoder to calculate a negative output size and write beyond the logical output buffer before returning to Java. Valid inputs with lengths that are multiples of four do not trigger the issue.
items.summary_zh: 一份 OpenJDK 拉取请求报告了 x86-64 AVX-512 VBMI Base64 解码器中的堆损坏漏洞。当无效输入留下很短的填充尾部时，解码器可能计算出负的输出大小，并在返回 Java 之前写出逻辑输出缓冲区边界。长度为 4 的倍数的有效输入不会触发该问题。

items.title_en: Solid 2.0
items.title_zh: Solid 2.0
items.summary_en: Solid 2.0 has reached a stable release after five years of development. It adds asynchronous work in the reactive graph, server functions, agent-oriented diagnostics, and a smaller API. Solid's original fine-grained, signal-based approach has since become more common across frontend frameworks. The release builds on that model while simplifying the framework's interface.
items.summary_zh: Solid 2.0 在经过五年开发后达到稳定版本。它加入了响应式图中的异步能力、服务器函数、面向代理的诊断工具，并缩小了 API。Solid 最初采用的细粒度信号式方案如今已在多个前端框架中变得普遍。此次发布在延续这一模型的同时简化了框架接口。

items.title_en: OpenSSL: Buffer overflow in EVP_EncodeBlock() (CVE-2026-121481, CVSS 9.8)
items.title_zh: OpenSSL：EVP_EncodeBlock() 中的缓冲区溢出（CVE-2026-121481，CVSS 9.8）
items.summary_en: A proposed OpenSSL fix addresses a buffer overflow in EVP_EncodeBlock(), tracked as CVE-2026-121481 with a CVSS score of 9.8. The change makes the function return -1 for invalid inputs, including null buffers, negative lengths, and encoded sizes that do not fit in an int. The security advisory was still pending when the fix was proposed.
items.summary_zh: 一项拟议的 OpenSSL 修复针对 EVP_EncodeBlock() 中的缓冲区溢出漏洞，该漏洞编号为 CVE-2026-121481，CVSS 评分为 9.8。修复会让函数在输入无效时返回 -1，包括缓冲区为空、长度为负数或编码后大小无法放入 int 的情况。提出修复时，安全公告仍在等待发布。

items.title_en: The Birds of GTA 6: A Field Guide to Vice City and Leonida's Wildlife
items.title_zh: 《GTA 6》的鸟类：Vice City 与 Leonida 野生动物指南
items.summary_en: The field guide catalogs birds found in GTA 6's Leonida, from roseate spoonbills in the Grassrivers to gulls over Vice Beach. It covers how to find the species, how the bird-spotting mechanics work, and the accuracy of Rockstar's wildlife artwork.
items.summary_zh: 这份野外指南整理了《GTA 6》Leonida 中的鸟类，从 Grassrivers 的玫瑰琵鹭到 Vice Beach 上空的海鸥。内容涵盖鸟类寻找方法、观鸟机制，以及 Rockstar 对野生动物的还原程度。

items.title_en: Everything you need to survive and rebuild society
items.title_zh: 一套帮助你生存并重建社会的完整资料库
items.summary_en: This is a free, open-source survival library containing local AI tools, maps, and instructional videos. After setup, it works offline on Mac, Windows, and Linux.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个免费的开源生存资料库，包含本地 AI、地图和操作教学视频。完成设置后，它可在 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 上离线运行。

items.title_en: NINLIVE: The Nine Inch Nails live archive
items.title_zh: NINLIVE：九寸钉现场档案
items.summary_en: NINLIVE is a fan-run archive of Nine Inch Nails concerts, setlists, recordings, posters, and photos from 1988 onward. It now lets users stream live recordings from 1988 through 2026, in addition to downloading them. Users can log in with Discord to save and organize favorites.
items.summary_zh: NINLIVE 是一个由粉丝运营的九寸钉现场档案，收录自 1988 年以来的演唱会、歌单、录音、海报和照片。该站现在除了提供下载，还支持在线播放 1988 至 2026 年的现场录音。用户可以使用 Discord 登录，以保存和整理喜欢的录音。

items.title_en: Russia reportedly planned mass-casualty attack in Poland to be blamed on Ukraine
items.title_zh: 据报道，俄罗斯曾策划在波兰制造大规模伤亡并嫁祸乌克兰
items.summary_en: Russian intelligence services reportedly planned a sabotage operation on Polish territory near the border with Russia’s Kaliningrad Oblast. The operation was reportedly intended to cause mass casualties in late October or early November and be blamed on Ukraine. The report comes from the Polish newspaper Rzeczpospolita, as cited by European Pravda.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，俄罗斯情报部门曾计划在波兰境内、靠近俄罗斯加里宁格勒州边境的地区实施破坏行动。据称，该行动计划于 10 月下旬或 11 月上旬制造大规模伤亡，并将责任嫁祸给乌克兰。相关消息来自波兰报纸《共和国报》，由 European Pravda 引述。

items.title_en: The stochastic parrots have apparently proved the Riemann Hypothesis
items.title_zh: 随机鹦鹉似乎证明了黎曼猜想
items.summary_en: The post uses the phrase “stochastic parrots” while discussing the apparent claim that the Riemann Hypothesis has been proved. It quotes Bernhard Riemann’s 1859 remark that he had set aside the search for a rigorous proof. An update notes that many people on social media interpreted the phrase literally rather than as irony or sarcasm.
items.summary_zh: 文章用“随机鹦鹉”这一说法讨论黎曼猜想似乎已被证明的说法。文中引用了 Bernhard Riemann 1859 年的言论：他曾暂时放下寻找严格证明的工作。作者在更新中指出，许多社交媒体用户将这一说法按字面理解，而没有看出其中的反讽或讽刺意味。

items.title_en: We don't need more apps, we need better open source
items.title_zh: 我们不需要更多应用，而需要更好的开源软件
items.summary_en: AI has made it easy to build small applications over a weekend, such as habit trackers, to-do lists, and note-taking tools. The author argues that more of this energy should go toward improving the open-source software people already rely on, making it faster, lighter, and easier to run. The point is not to discourage people from building, but to redirect some of that effort toward shared infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 人工智能让人们可以在一个周末轻松构建习惯追踪器、待办事项和笔记应用等小型软件。作者认为，更多这类精力应投入到改进人们已经依赖的开源软件上，让它们更快、更轻量、更易运行。重点不是阻止人们开发新东西，而是将部分努力转向共享基础设施。

items.title_en: Software is breaking down at a systemic level
items.title_zh: 软件正在系统性崩坏
items.summary_en: The author argues that recent failures point to software problems at a systemic level. The examples cited are a two-day global Microsoft outage and an FAA ground stop that halted all flights in the United States. These events are presented as a recent combination of major technology and infrastructure disruptions.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，近期的多起故障表明软件正面临系统性问题。文章举出的例子包括持续两天的全球微软服务中断，以及导致美国所有航班停飞的 FAA 地面停飞令。这些事件被视为近期重大技术和基础设施中断的集中体现。

items.title_en: What is the best harness for each model?
items.title_zh: 每种模型最适合什么 harness？
items.summary_en: FrontierHarness Eval v1.1 tested 22 coding-agent harnesses with five models across the same 62 tasks, repeating each test four times for 27,280 runs. The best-value harness varied by model, and cost rankings also shifted substantially between models. With the model held constant, the most expensive harness cost 1.8 to 5 times more per task than the cheapest. The results suggest that changing models may also require reconsidering the harness.
items.summary_zh: FrontierHarness Eval v1.1 使用 5 个模型，在相同的 62 项任务上测试了 22 个编码代理 harness，每项测试重复 4 次，共运行 27,280 次。性价比最高的 harness 因模型而异，成本排名也会随模型大幅变化。在固定模型的情况下，最贵 harness 的单任务成本是最便宜者的 1.8 至 5 倍。结果表明，更换模型时可能也需要重新评估所用的 harness。

items.title_en: Chemistry is Actually Geometry
items.title_zh: 化学其实是几何学
items.summary_en: The piece is titled “Chemistry is Actually Geometry.” It presents chemistry through the lens of geometry.
items.summary_zh: 文章题为《化学其实是几何学》。它从几何学的角度看待化学。

items.title_en: Multiple vulnerabilities in Regexp and String case conversion
items.title_zh: Regexp 和字符串大小写转换中的多个漏洞
items.summary_en: Seven vulnerabilities have been found in Ruby’s regular expression engine and string case-conversion functionality. Proofs of concept show that some of them can trigger remote code execution. Ruby released versions 4.0.10, 3.4.13, and 3.3.14 to fix the issues and recommends upgrading; CVE identifiers have not yet been assigned.
items.summary_zh: Ruby 的正则表达式引擎和字符串大小写转换功能中发现了七个漏洞。概念验证表明，其中一些漏洞可用于触发远程代码执行。Ruby 已发布 4.0.10、3.4.13 和 3.3.14 修复这些问题，并建议用户升级；这些漏洞尚未分配 CVE 编号。

items.title_en: The 98% Slot Machine: How Paid Advertising Became an Extraction Tax
items.title_zh: 98% 的老虎机：付费广告如何变成一种抽取税
items.summary_en: The essay argues that advertising auctions are calibrated to pay out just enough to keep advertisers participating. It says auction winners do not necessarily earn profits, but instead gain the opportunity to act as unpaid fulfillment contractors for Google and Meta.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，广告竞价机制被调校到只支付足以让广告主继续参与的回报。它指出，竞价获胜者未必能获得利润，反而可能只是获得了为 Google 和 Meta 充当无偿履约承包商的机会。

items.title_en: Do not buy RAM, compress
items.title_zh: 别买内存，压缩它
items.summary_en: The author turned to zram after running out of memory while running increasingly parallel AI workloads. Zram compresses memory and is already used by Windows, macOS, and many Android devices, but it is not enabled by default in many Linux distributions. Fedora and Pop!_OS enable it, while Ubuntu generally does not and Amazon Linux limits it to smaller virtual machines.
items.summary_zh: 在运行并行度越来越高的 AI 工作负载时遇到内存不足后，作者转而使用 zram。zram 会压缩内存，Windows、macOS 和许多 Android 设备已经在使用这项技术，但不少 Linux 发行版默认未启用。Fedora 和 Pop!_OS 默认启用 zram，而 Ubuntu 通常没有启用，Amazon Linux 则只在较小的虚拟机上启用。

items.title_en: NSA Internal Network Down
items.title_zh: NSA 内部网络中断
items.summary_en: An internal network used by the National Security Agency is down.
items.summary_zh: 美国国家安全局使用的一套内部网络发生中断。

items.title_en: Grazing sheep in fields with solar arrays
items.title_zh: 在太阳能阵列田地放牧绵羊
items.summary_en: Two studies examine the growing practice of grazing sheep beneath solar arrays. One found that grazing at two sheep per hectare increased wild bees, honey bees, and lady beetles by 38% compared with mowing, driven mainly by an 83% rise in honey bees. The other study describes a decision-support tool to help farmers expand solar-grazing herds profitably.
items.summary_zh: 两项研究考察了在太阳能阵列下放牧绵羊这一日益普及的做法。其中一项发现，每公顷放牧两只绵羊时，野生蜜蜂、蜜蜂和瓢虫的数量比割草对照地增加 38%，主要原因是蜜蜂数量增加了 83%。另一项研究介绍了一种决策支持工具，帮助农民以盈利方式扩大太阳能牧羊规模。

items.title_en: If you stop writing code, you also get worse at reviewing it
items.title_zh: 停止写代码，也会让你的代码审查能力变差
items.summary_en: The author argues that software engineers, like practitioners in other fields, need hands-on practice to maintain and improve their skills. Reading about a skill is not equivalent to performing it, whether the skill involves technique, problem-solving, or muscle memory. The post questions why this principle is often treated differently in software engineering.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，软件工程师和其他领域的从业者一样，需要通过亲自实践来保持并提升技能。无论涉及技巧、解决问题还是肌肉记忆，阅读相关内容都不能替代实际操作。文章质疑了为什么这一原则在软件工程中常被区别对待。

items.title_en: OpenCode Browse
items.title_zh: OpenCode Browse
items.summary_en: OpenCode Browse lets OpenCode and other MCP clients operate a user’s real browser through an MCP server and Chromium extension. Agents can open tabs, read pages, click, type, take screenshots, record tabs, and use existing logins and extensions. For logins, 2FA prompts, or payments, the tab is handed back to the user and resumes after approval.
items.summary_zh: OpenCode Browse 通过 MCP 服务器和 Chromium 扩展，让 OpenCode 及其他 MCP 客户端操作用户的真实浏览器。代理可以打开标签页、读取页面、点击、输入、截图、录制标签页，并使用现有的登录状态和扩展。在登录、双重验证或付款环节，标签页会交还给用户，获得批准后再继续操作。

items.title_en: Codeberg.org Not Reachable
items.title_zh: Codeberg.org 无法访问
items.summary_en: The codeberg.org domain became entirely unreachable after disappearing from its registrar account. Codeberg said the domain had not expired, no suspicious logins appeared in its account history, and it was seeking support while preparing a workaround on codeberg.eu.
items.summary_zh: codeberg.org 域名在从注册商账户中消失后完全无法访问。Codeberg 表示域名并未过期，账户登录记录中也没有可疑登录；团队正在寻求客服协助，并准备在 codeberg.eu 上提供临时替代方案。

items.title_en: Harvard researchers find AI coding agents shifted the bottleneck to code review
items.title_zh: 哈佛研究人员：AI 编码代理将瓶颈转移到了代码审查
items.summary_en: A working paper covering 718 firms found that companies adopting AI coding agents produced about 30% more code. However, the amount of completed work did not measurably increase, and getting code through review took 49% longer. The study was written by Harvard Ph.D. candidates Fiona Chen and James Stratton and is not identified as peer-reviewed. Its measures suggest that reviewer time and approved work, not raw code output, are important when evaluating coding agents.
items.summary_zh: 一篇覆盖 718 家公司的工作论文发现，采用 AI 编码代理的企业产出的代码量增加了约 30%。但完成的工作量没有明显增长，代码通过审查所需的时间反而增加了 49%。论文作者是哈佛博士候选人 Fiona Chen 和 James Stratton，目前未显示已经过同行评审。研究结果表明，评估编码代理时应关注审查时间和最终获批的工作，而不仅是代码产量。

items.title_en: Interpreting claims that a theorem is correct because it was checked in Lean
items.title_zh: 如何理解“定理已在 Lean 中检查，因此正确”的说法
items.summary_en: The post explains how to interpret claims that a theorem is correct because it was checked in Lean. It argues that Lean code provides an important signal, but AI-generated code should undergo additional tests before being trusted. The discussion notes that such tests have not yet been systematically applied to many items in OpenAI’s 722-paper theorem dump, about 45% of which included Lean code, while three non-Leanified papers were later retracted for a sign error.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章解释了应如何理解“定理已在 Lean 中检查，因此正确”这一说法。文章认为，Lean 代码确实提供了重要信号，但由 AI 生成的代码在获得信任前仍应接受额外测试。文中指出，在 OpenAI 收录 722 篇数学论文、约 45% 附带 Lean 代码的定理汇编中，这类测试尚未得到系统执行；其中三篇未 Lean 化的论文后来因符号错误被撤稿。

items.title_en: Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations
items.title_zh: Navier–Stokes 方程的有限时间爆破解
items.summary_en: A repository contains the paper “Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations” by L. Alpöge and T. Buckmaster, together with an accompanying Lean 4 formalization. The formalization proves the stated theorems from a library while restricting the permitted axioms to propext, Quot.sound, and Classical.choice. Comparator files check that the theorem statements match the solutions.
items.summary_zh: 一个代码仓库收录了 L. Alpöge 和 T. Buckmaster 撰写的《Navier–Stokes 方程的有限时间爆破解》，以及配套的 Lean 4 形式化证明。该形式化代码通过一个库证明所述定理，并将允许使用的公理限制为 propext、Quot.sound 和 Classical.choice。比较文件用于检查定理陈述与解答是否一致。

items.title_en: Crows make decisions faster than we can
items.title_zh: “鸟脑”是个误称：乌鸦做决定比人类更快
items.summary_en: In a recent experiment, crows processed and responded to visual cues at twice the speed of humans and monkeys. The study, published in Science, provides a first quantitative measure of the neural speed of avian decision-making. The results show that the crows outperformed both human and nonhuman primate participants.
items.summary_zh: 在一项近期实验中，乌鸦处理并回应视觉线索的速度是人类和猴子的两倍。这项发表于《科学》的研究首次量化了鸟类决策的神经速度。结果显示，乌鸦的表现超过了人类和非人类灵长类参与者。

items.title_en: LLMs can read and write executables byte by byte from a hex dump
items.title_zh: LLM 可以逐字节读取和编写十六进制转储中的可执行文件
items.summary_en: An experiment tested whether a frontier LLM could work with compiled programs using only a hex dump, without tools and with a single reply. The model explained compiled code, modified executable bytes to add features, and produced working executables from scratch. The task is difficult because x86-64 instructions have variable lengths, jumps use relative byte offsets, and incorrect file headers prevent loading.
items.summary_zh: 一项实验测试了前沿 LLM 是否能仅凭十六进制转储、在没有工具且只能回复一次的情况下处理编译后的程序。模型解释了编译代码，直接修改可执行文件的字节来添加功能，并从头生成了可运行的可执行文件。由于 x86-64 指令长度可变、跳转使用相对字节偏移，且文件头字段出错就会导致程序无法加载，这项任务相当困难。

items.title_en: FFmpeg 9.1 'Gauss'
items.title_zh: FFmpeg 9.1“高斯”
items.summary_en: FFmpeg 9.1, codenamed “Gauss,” is available as a source-code release. The project provides instructions for retrieving the source through Git and notes that it distributes source code rather than compiled binaries.
items.summary_zh: 代号为“高斯”的 FFmpeg 9.1 以源代码形式发布。项目提供了通过 Git 获取源代码的说明，并注明其发布的是源代码而非编译后的二进制文件。

items.title_en: US SEC's Nvidia probe is examining potential accounting issues – sources
items.title_zh: 美国 SEC 对英伟达的调查正在审查潜在会计问题
items.summary_en: The US Securities and Exchange Commission is reportedly examining potential accounting issues involving Nvidia. The investigation is attributed to unnamed sources.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，美国证券交易委员会正在审查英伟达可能存在的会计问题。相关调查消息来自未具名消息人士。

items.title_en: Energy-Based Reasoners: 385x more efficient inference
items.title_zh: 能量型推理器：推理效率提升 385 倍
items.summary_en: Energy-Based Reasoners replace a learned recurrent transition with gradient descent on a learned energy function over latent reasoning states. The energy both guides iterative refinement and determines when to stop and which candidate answer to select. On Sudoku-Extreme, the model reached more than 99% accuracy with 1.8 million parameters and used up to 345 times fewer inference FLOPs than EqR at comparable accuracy.
items.summary_zh: 能量型推理器用在潜在推理状态上对学习到的能量函数执行梯度下降，取代传统的学习型循环转移。能量函数既引导迭代优化，也决定何时停止以及选择哪个候选答案。在 Sudoku-Extreme 测试中，该模型以 180 万参数取得超过 99% 的准确率，在准确率相近时推理 FLOPs 比 EqR 最多少 345 倍。

items.title_en: LLM assisted reverse engineering
items.title_zh: LLM 辅助逆向工程
items.summary_en: A reverse engineer describes using AI to accelerate hardware and software analysis after two decades of largely manual work. The current workflow points an agent at a binary and applies a set of dedicated agent skills, with much of the remaining process handled automatically. The approach is presented as a brief account of the author’s reverse-engineering process.
items.summary_zh: 一名逆向工程师介绍了如何借助 AI 加速硬件和软件分析，此前这项工作主要依靠人工完成。当前的工作流是将智能体指向待分析的二进制文件，并应用一组专用智能体技能，其余大部分流程由系统自动处理。作者将其作为自己逆向工程流程的简要介绍。

items.title_en: SSD prices may begin to decline in the latter half of 2027
items.title_zh: SSD 价格可能从 2027 年下半年开始下降
items.summary_en: SSD prices are expected to begin easing in the second half of 2027, while hard-drive prices may remain elevated into 2028. The forecast draws on TrendForce projections, Seagate and Western Digital earnings statements, and live retail-price tracking. Hard-drive supply is expected to take longer to improve because manufacturers have already sold much of their future output.
items.summary_zh: 预计 SSD 价格将从 2027 年下半年开始回落，而硬盘价格可能要到 2028 年仍维持高位。这一预测依据包括 TrendForce 的预期、希捷和西部数据的财报表述，以及实时零售价格追踪。硬盘供应改善所需时间更长，因为制造商已经提前售出了相当一部分未来产能。

items.title_en: Show HN: I made an audio-to-MIDI model 60x more efficient
items.title_zh: Show HN：我做了一个效率提升 60 倍的音频转 MIDI 模型
items.summary_en: The creator released dettato, an open-weight model for transcribing audio into MIDI. It reportedly outperforms MusiCтор 1.3B on every tested set while being roughly 60 times smaller. The model was trained without copyrighted recordings.
items.summary_zh: 作者发布了开权重音频转 MIDI 模型 dettato。据称，该模型在所有测试集上都优于 MusiCтор 1.3B，同时体积约小 60 倍。模型训练未使用受版权保护的录音。

items.title_en: The Secret ThinkPad Powerbutton Code to Bring Dead Laptops Back to Life (2007)
items.title_zh: 让死机 ThinkPad 起死回生的神秘电源键代码（2007）
items.summary_en: A new Lenovo ThinkPad z61t suddenly appeared completely dead shortly before a presentation. Its sleep and battery lights were off, the machine was unusually hot, and pressing the power button or reseating the battery had no effect. The owner then called IBM support, looking for a way to bring the laptop back to life.
items.summary_zh: 一台全新的 Lenovo ThinkPad z61t 在演讲前突然完全无法启动。睡眠灯和电池灯都不亮，机器异常发热，按电源键或重新插拔电池也没有反应。机主随后致电 IBM 支持，试图找出让笔记本恢复工作的办法。

items.title_en: A short explainer on how El Niño works [video]
items.title_zh: 简明视频解释厄尔尼诺如何运作
items.summary_en: A short video explains how El Niño works.
items.summary_zh: 一段简短视频解释了厄尔尼诺现象如何运作。

items.title_en: Genie 4 is now available
items.title_zh: Genie 4 现已开放使用
items.summary_en: Google is rolling out Genie 4, its new world model, to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers through Project Genie. Users can generate interactive worlds with real-time audio, edit environments using natural language, and share creations in a community gallery. Google AI Pro members can join a waitlist.
items.summary_zh: Google 正通过 Project Genie 向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅者开放新的世界模型 Genie 4。用户可以生成带实时音频的互动世界，使用自然语言实时编辑环境，并在社区画廊分享作品。Google AI Pro 用户可以加入候补名单。

items.title_en: Data Processing Incidents on Inference Providers
items.title_zh: 推理服务商的数据处理事件
items.summary_en: OpenRouter removed three providers, took 125 endpoints out of Zero Data Retention eligibility, and notified potentially affected customers after canary-token research found problems at inference providers. The research indicated that some providers’ data may have been compromised or that their stated data-handling policies were not being followed. OpenRouter said the findings did not show a breach or unauthorized access of its own systems.
items.summary_zh: 在金丝雀令牌研究发现推理服务商存在问题后，OpenRouter 下架了三家服务商，将 125 个端点移出“零数据留存”资格范围，并通知了可能受影响的客户。研究显示，部分服务商的数据可能遭到泄露，或其声明的数据处理政策没有得到遵守。OpenRouter 表示，这些发现并未显示其自身系统遭到入侵或未经授权访问。

items.title_en: Why 3dfx 1 cards had such a washed out color output?
items.title_zh: 为什么 3dfx 1 卡的颜色输出会如此泛白？
items.summary_en: The discussion attributes the washed-out appearance of NeXT and 3dfx output to attempts to handle color spaces correctly. Those choices generally made the systems look worse than competing products. The author notes that the underlying behavior was not fully understood until years later, including the mistaken intuition that a pixel value of 1.0 emits twice as many photons as a lower value.
items.summary_zh: 这段讨论将 NeXT 和 3dfx 画面泛白归因于它们试图正确处理色彩空间。这样的选择通常反而让它们看起来比竞争产品更差。作者表示，直到多年后才真正理解其中的原理，其中包括“像素值 1.0 会发出两倍光子”这一并不可靠的直觉。

items.title_en: What's New in PHP 8.6
items.title_zh: PHP 8.6 新特性
items.summary_en: PHP 8.6 is a major language update that adds partial function application, a Duration class, a Polling API, and a new clamp() function. The release also emphasizes more expressive code, stronger types, and scalable I/O.
items.summary_zh: PHP 8.6 是一次重要的语言更新，新增部分函数应用、Duration 类、Polling API 和 clamp() 函数。该版本还强调更具表现力的代码、更强的类型支持和可扩展 I/O。

items.title_en: Show HN: I built a game where you are an LLM's subagent
items.title_zh: Show HN：我做了一个让你成为大语言模型子代理的游戏
items.summary_en: Worker755 is a browser game in which an AI manager treats the player as its subagent. The manager is a real LLM, such as Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, or Kimi, with a task queue, read-only machine access, and a tool for spawning subagents. Players receive instructions in a terminal, have 90 seconds to act, and then receive feedback, corrections, incident reports, and a performance review.
items.summary_zh: Worker755 是一款浏览器游戏，玩家在其中扮演一个被 AI 管理器视为子代理的角色。管理器使用真实的大语言模型，例如 Claude、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、GLM 或 Kimi，并配有任务队列、只读的机器访问权限和生成子代理的工具。玩家会在终端收到指令，并有 90 秒执行；随后系统会反馈结果、提出修正、提交事故报告，最后给出绩效评估。

items.title_en: DreamCoder: Coding harness and IDE from the author of Mastering Emacs
items.title_zh: DreamCoder：Mastering Emacs 作者打造的编码工具链与 IDE
items.summary_en: DreamCoder is an AI coding harness and IDE created by the author of Mastering Emacs. The project has been in development for about fifteen months and is now being formally released. Its design is described as substantially different from familiar AI coding tools, alongside discussion of AI, Lisp, and Emacs.
items.summary_zh: DreamCoder 是《Mastering Emacs》作者打造的 AI 编码工具链和 IDE。该项目开发了约 15 个月，如今正式发布。作者称其设计与常见的 AI 编码工具有很大不同，并同时讨论了 AI、Lisp 和 Emacs 的关系。

items.title_en: How the Claude Code team thinks about verification
items.title_zh: Claude Code 团队如何思考验证
items.summary_en: The Claude Code team uses end-to-end, property-based, and differential tests to let coding agents verify their work with evidence. About 90% of the team’s code is written and reviewed by Claude, making verification especially important. Verification loops allow the team to delegate more work and run dozens or hundreds of agents in parallel instead of manually checking only one or two at a time.
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 团队使用端到端测试、性质测试和差分测试，让编码代理用证据验证自己的工作。团队约 90% 的代码由 Claude 编写和审查，因此验证尤为重要。验证循环让团队能够委派更多工作，并行运行几十甚至数百个代理，而不必每次只能手动检查一两个代理。

items.title_en: Google workers tell their employer not to punish schools that don't want AI
items.title_zh: Google 员工要求公司不要惩罚拒绝 AI 的学校
items.summary_en: Hundreds of Google workers are urging senior leadership to withdraw a policy that would deny schools access to Google Search if they disable Gemini AI tools next year. A Google staffer says executives view resistance to AI as evidence that schools do not “see the vision.” The proposed policy concerns schools using Chromebooks and Gemini tools.
items.summary_zh: 数百名 Google 员工要求高层撤回一项政策：如果学校明年关闭 Gemini AI 工具，可能会失去使用 Google 搜索的权限。一名 Google 员工称，高管认为学校抵制 AI 只是因为它们“不理解这一愿景”。这项政策涉及使用 Chromebook 和 Gemini 工具的学校。

items.title_en: Distributed, high-performance blob storage on SQLite
items.title_zh: 基于 SQLite 的分布式高性能 Blob 存储
items.summary_en: The team behind Kite built Blobasaur, a sharded, distributed blob-storage server on top of SQLite for high-throughput reads and writes. It stores JSON blobs ranging from a few kilobytes to several megabytes and serves thousands of reads and writes per second on commodity hardware with single-digit millisecond latency. The system stores customizable trading-screen layouts, templates, drawings, and other user metadata for a platform with about 20 million customers.
items.summary_zh: Kite 团队构建了 Blobasaur，这是一个基于 SQLite 的分片式分布式 Blob 存储服务器，用于处理高吞吐读写。它能够在普通硬件上以个位数毫秒延迟，每秒读写数千个从几 KB 到数 MB 不等的 JSON Blob。该系统用于存储约 2000 万用户的交易界面布局、模板、绘图和其他用户元数据。

items.title_en: GnuPG Security Advisory for GPGME
items.title_zh: GnuPG 发布 GPGME 安全公告
items.summary_en: GnuPG has released GPGME 2.3.1 to fix a critical security bug affecting all previous versions. A crafted OpenPGP key with an extremely long user ID can trigger a double-free, which may allow data exfiltration through signed data; remote code execution cannot be ruled out. GnuPG recommends updating immediately, and the vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-129975.
items.summary_zh: GnuPG 发布了 GPGME 2.3.1，以修复影响所有旧版本的严重安全漏洞。攻击者可利用包含超长用户 ID 的精心构造 OpenPGP 密钥触发 double free，并可能通过发送签名数据窃取应用数据；远程代码执行也无法排除。GnuPG 建议立即更新，该漏洞编号为 CVE-2026-129975。

items.title_en: Why is Gemini 4 Carbon taking so long?
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 为什么要花这么久？
items.summary_en: During a private benchmark, Gemini 4 Carbon took close to an hour to complete tasks that Opus and Astra routinely finished in a few minutes. The investigators traced each step of its runs to determine why it was so much slower. They report that others had also noticed the model's unusually long completion times.
items.summary_zh: 在一次内部基准测试中，Gemini 4 Carbon 花了近一小时完成任务，而 Opus 和 Astra 通常只需几分钟。研究人员逐步追踪了它的运行过程，以查明速度如此缓慢的原因。他们表示，其他人也注意到了该模型异常漫长的完成时间。

items.title_en: Archive Team is archiving the Apple Support Community
items.title_zh: Archive Team 将归档 Apple 支持社区（11 月 20 日关闭）
items.summary_en: Archive Team is archiving Apple Discussions, also known as the Apple Support Community and Apple Tech Exchange. The forum lets customers ask questions, share advice, and troubleshoot Apple products and services. The project is maintained by volunteers and depends on donations to cover its infrastructure costs.
items.summary_zh: Archive Team 正在归档 Apple Discussions，即 Apple 支持社区和 Apple Tech Exchange。这个论坛供用户提问、分享建议并排查 Apple 产品和服务的问题。该项目由志愿者维护，并依靠捐款承担基础设施成本。

items.title_en: Nintendo takes Picofly firmware down from GitHub [video]
items.title_zh: 任天堂从 GitHub 下架 Picofly 固件
items.summary_en: Nintendo has taken the Picofly firmware down from GitHub. The item also includes a video about the takedown.
items.summary_zh: 任天堂已将 Picofly 固件从 GitHub 下架。该条目还包含一段介绍此次下架的视频。

items.title_en: Comcast's "fiber-powered Wi-Fi" is cable, AT&T says in false advertising case
items.title_zh: AT&T 在虚假广告诉讼中称，Comcast 的“光纤 Wi‑Fi”其实使用的是有线网络
items.summary_en: AT&T alleges that Comcast marketed cable internet as “fiber-powered Wi-Fi.” AT&T is seeking the profits Comcast made from that advertising.
items.summary_zh: AT&T 指控 Comcast 将有线互联网宣传为“光纤驱动的 Wi‑Fi”。AT&T 要求 Comcast 交出其通过相关广告获得的利润。

items.title_en: Advice for the next 100 Rust GUIs
items.title_zh: 给未来 100 个 Rust GUI 的建议
items.summary_en: The post follows up on advice published four and a half years ago, noting that roughly 20 Rust GUI toolkits have since been announced and that AI has recently accelerated interest in Rust GUI development. It argues that high-performance Rust interfaces remain practical because many cross-platform applications suffer from poor performance, while platform toolkits have stagnated and Electron applications can be bloated. Rising RAM costs and growing mobile usage make that bloat more consequential.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章是四年半前相关建议的后续，指出此后约有 20 个 Rust GUI 工具包发布，并且 AI 最近进一步加速了人们对 Rust GUI 开发的兴趣。文章认为，高性能 Rust 界面仍然具有现实意义，因为许多跨平台应用性能不佳，平台自带工具包发展停滞，而 Electron 应用可能过于臃肿。内存成本上升和移动设备使用增加，也让这种臃肿的代价更加明显。

items.title_en: Nvidia was in trouble before the Jensen Huang mess
items.title_zh: 在 Jensen Huang 的混乱之前，英伟达就已陷入困境
items.summary_en: Nvidia helped enable the AI boom, in part because its recently ousted CEO Jensen Huang invested early in chips for AI training and anticipated technological shifts. As Huang leaves and CFO Colette Kress takes over, the company faces a growing group of competitors with advanced technologies. The timing leaves Nvidia under pressure as rivals catch up.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达推动了 AI 热潮，部分原因在于其最近被免职的 CEO Jensen Huang 提前投资 AI 训练芯片，并准确预判了技术变化。随着 Huang 离任、CFO Colette Kress 接任，公司正面对一批拥有先进技术且不断壮大的竞争者。在竞争对手追赶之际，这一变化让英伟达承受更大压力。

items.title_en: Making 8-page foldable zines from a single A4 sheet in the browser
items.title_zh: 在浏览器中用一张 A4 纸制作 8 页折叠小志
items.summary_en: An update to fanzines.app adds real-spread design, batch photo importing, printer-safe margins, and English and Spanish support. The app is designed around a simple fold-and-cut method that turns one A4 sheet into an eight-page booklet without staples or glue.
items.summary_zh: fanzines.app 的更新加入了按实际跨页设计、批量导入照片、打印安全边距，以及英语和西班牙语支持。该应用围绕一种简单的折叠和裁切方法设计，可将一张 A4 纸变成无需订书钉或胶水的 8 页小册子。

items.title_en: DaisyRose-27B
items.title_zh: DaisyRose-27B
items.summary_en: RadixArk has released DaisyRose-27B, its first model, built on Qwen3.8-27B and trained with reinforcement learning using Miles. It was trained on long-horizon agent tasks with sessions of up to 1 million tokens, using 1,200 curated tasks over 18 days on 144 H200 GPUs. Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 improved from 5.6% to 12.0%, and BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 checkpoints are available.
items.summary_zh: RadixArk 发布了首个模型 DaisyRose-27B，该模型基于 Qwen3.8-27B，并使用 Miles 进行强化学习训练。模型面向长期智能体任务训练，单次会话最多支持 100 万个 token；训练使用了 144 张 H200 GPU，在 18 天内完成了 1,200 个精选任务。Terminal-Bench 4.1 的 pass@1 从 5.6% 提升至 12.0%，同时提供 BF16、FP8 和 NVFP4 检查点。

items.title_en: Show HN: ExitPath – Open-source ways out of Slack, Notion and Microsoft 365
items.title_zh: Show HN：ExitPath——离开 Slack、Notion 和 Microsoft 365 的开源方案
items.summary_en: ExitPath helps users find and compare open-source alternatives to Slack, Notion, Microsoft 365, and other tools. It provides ratings, migration-difficulty scores, and step-by-step checklists. The project says that user activity stays in the browser.
items.summary_zh: ExitPath 帮助用户寻找和比较 Slack、Notion、Microsoft 365 等工具的开源替代品。它提供评价、迁移难度评分和分步检查清单。项目表示，用户操作不会离开浏览器。

items.title_en: If an App Asks for Full Disk Access or System and App Protection Override
items.title_zh: 如果应用要求完全磁盘访问权限或覆盖系统与应用保护
items.summary_en: The item addresses situations in which an app asks for Full Disk Access or an override of system and app protection.
items.summary_zh: 该条目介绍应用要求获得“完全磁盘访问权限”或绕过系统与应用保护的情况。

items.title_en: A Beginner's Guide to Local AI with Inkling, Qwen, and Unsloth
items.title_zh: 本地 AI 入门：Inkling、Qwen 与 Unsloth
items.summary_en: The guide explains how to set up a free, personal ChatGPT-like system on a home PC using Unsloth with Inkling or Qwen. It emphasizes that the system can remain private and be shared across a household. The approach is presented as an alternative to cloud providers amid concerns about model control, quality changes, rising costs, and privacy.
items.summary_zh: 这篇指南介绍了如何在家用电脑上使用 Unsloth 搭配 Inkling 或 Qwen，搭建免费的个人 ChatGPT 类系统。该系统可以保持私密，并供全家使用。文章将这种方案视为云服务的替代选择，原因包括模型控制、质量变化、成本上涨和隐私问题。

items.title_en: Tor Project Issues Rapid-Response DoS-Defense Fix Amid Sustained DDoS Attack
items.title_zh: Tor 项目在持续 DDoS 攻击下紧急发布防 DoS 修复
items.summary_en: The Tor Project released version 0.4.9.17 with a series of security fixes. One particularly important change improves relay defenses against denial-of-service attacks related to IPv6 handling. The rapid-response release follows an ongoing DDoS attack that has affected most relay operators.
items.summary_zh: Tor 项目发布了 0.4.9.17 版本，其中包含一系列安全修复。其中一项重要改动改进了中继节点针对 IPv6 处理相关拒绝服务攻击的防护。此次快速响应发布源于一场仍在持续的 DDoS 攻击，该攻击已影响大多数中继运营者。

items.title_en: The Cambridge Dictionary has named ‘human’ as the Word of the Year 2026
items.title_zh: 剑桥词典将“human”评为 2026 年度词汇
items.summary_en: Cambridge Dictionary has named “human” its Word of the Year for 2026. The choice reflects global debates about what it means to be human as AI blurs the boundary between people and machines. The dictionary defines “human” as having the qualities, faults, and feelings associated with people rather than gods, animals, or machines.
items.summary_zh: 剑桥词典将“human”评为 2026 年度词汇。这一选择反映了人工智能模糊人与机器边界之际，全球围绕“人类意味着什么”展开的讨论。词典将“human”定义为具有人类特有的品质、缺点和情感，而非神、动物或机器所具备的特征。

items.title_en: Show HN: Take Voyager 1 apart, down to a single memory chip
items.title_zh: Show HN：拆解旅行者 1 号，直到一块内存芯片
items.summary_en: An interactive project lets users explore Voyager 1 down to individual components, including a single memory chip. It also shows the current locations of both Voyager spacecraft, the 24 plutonium spheres in a nuclear battery, the Golden Record’s cover, and the ground dish listening to the probes. The project includes a four-minute film and describes how Voyager 1 was repaired by radio.
items.summary_zh: 一个互动项目允许用户逐层探索旅行者 1 号，直至单块内存芯片。项目还展示两艘旅行者探测器当前的位置、核电池中的 24 个钚球、金唱片封面，以及正在接收探测器信号的地面天线。项目另附一部四分钟影片，并介绍了如何通过无线电修复旅行者 1 号。

items.title_en: Backblaze Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy
items.title_zh: Backblaze 收集信息声明与隐私政策
items.summary_en: Backblaze's privacy notice explains how the company collects, uses, discloses, processes, and retains personal information, as well as how people can exercise their privacy rights. Backblaze is a US-based data-storage company offering Computer Backup for Mac and PC devices and B2 Cloud Storage for organizations and individuals.
items.summary_zh: Backblaze 的隐私声明说明了公司如何收集、使用、披露、处理和保留个人信息，以及用户如何行使隐私权。Backblaze 是一家总部位于美国的数据存储公司，为个人和组织提供面向 Mac 与 PC 设备的 Computer Backup，以及 B2 Cloud Storage 云存储服务。

items.title_en: Emacs Is My Browser
items.title_zh: Emacs 是我的浏览器
items.summary_en: The author has been using Emacs's EWW text-based browser more seriously as part of an effort to make Emacs the sole computing environment. After several days, EWW appeared sufficient for roughly 85–90% of browsing tasks, including many JavaScript-heavy sites. The author also says that EWW and other terminal browsers reduce the distractions and endless browsing loops common in modern graphical browsers.
items.summary_zh: 为了让 Emacs 成为唯一的计算环境，作者开始更认真地使用其文本浏览器 EWW。经过几天使用，作者认为 EWW 足以应对大约 85% 至 90% 的浏览需求，包括许多 JavaScript 密集型网站。作者还表示，EWW 及其他终端浏览器能减少现代图形浏览器中常见的干扰和无休止的浏览循环。

items.title_en: WebGL Flight Simulator with seed generated terrain
items.title_zh: 使用种子生成地形的 WebGL 飞行模拟器
items.summary_en: This free browser game lets players take off, explore a procedurally generated world, and land safely. Players can choose a biplane, turboprop, or jet in the hangar. It is built with DAI Studio.
items.summary_zh: 这款免费的浏览器游戏允许玩家起飞、探索程序生成的世界，并安全降落。玩家可以在机库中选择双翼机、涡桨飞机或喷气式飞机。游戏使用 DAI Studio 构建。

items.title_en: Open Social Web Alliance
items.title_zh: 开放社交网络联盟
