items.summary_en: The Open Social Web Alliance aims to develop social media that strengthens democratic discourse while remaining resilient and appealing. It presents itself as an effort to find practical answers for building such platforms.
items.summary_zh: 开放社交网络联盟旨在开发能够强化民主话语、同时具备韧性和吸引力的社交媒体。该联盟致力于为如何构建这类平台寻找实际答案。

items.title_en: Squircles
items.title_zh: 圆方形
items.summary_en: A squircle is a shape between a square and a circle, with no single mathematical definition. Different curves can represent squircles, and they can vary continuously between circular and square forms. The superellipse is the best-known example, popularized by Piet Hein.
items.summary_zh: “圆方形”是介于正方形和圆形之间的一类形状，并没有唯一的数学定义。不同曲线都可以构成圆方形，其形态能够在圆形与方形之间变化。最著名的例子是由 Piet Hein 推广的超椭圆。

items.title_en: A Perfect SimCity
items.title_zh: 一座完美的 SimCity 城市
items.summary_en: After years of playing SimCity, the author used the game's open source code and Python tools to investigate how its 0-to-1000 city score is determined. The experiments produced five algorithmically designed high-scoring cities and five high-population cities. The work uses Micropolis and MicropolisCore, open-source ports that faithfully reproduce the rules of the 1989 game.
items.summary_zh: 在多年游玩《模拟城市》后，作者利用游戏的开源代码和 Python 工具，研究其 0 到 1000 分城市评分的决定因素。实验生成了五座通过算法设计的高分城市和五座高人口城市。研究使用了 Micropolis 和 MicropolisCore，这两个项目忠实复现了 1989 年原版游戏的规则。

items.title_en: The Making of Oxygene
items.title_zh: 《Oxygène》的制作过程
items.summary_en: Jean-Michel Jarre’s 1976 album Oxygène helped redefine synthesizer and electronic music, becoming a top-10 album in seven countries and selling nearly 20 million copies worldwide. It contained six instrumental tracks and used no acoustic instruments. The album is now being reimagined for Dolby Atmos.
items.summary_zh: 让·米歇尔·雅尔 1976 年的专辑《Oxygène》重新定义了合成器音乐和电子音乐，在七个国家进入唱片销量前十，并在全球售出近 2000 万张。专辑包含六首纯器乐曲，完全没有使用原声乐器。该专辑如今正被重新制作成 Dolby Atmos 版本。

items.title_en: Show HN: Tinnitus frequency finder and audio notch tool
items.title_zh: 耳鸣频率查找器与音频陷波工具
items.summary_en: This free browser-based tool guides users through matching the pitch of their tinnitus in about four minutes. It sets safe listening levels, checks for octave mix-ups, and reports a frequency with an estimated range. No sign-up is required, and the tool says that no audio is recorded or sent anywhere; it is not a hearing test or diagnosis.
items.summary_zh: 这款免费的浏览器工具会引导用户在约四分钟内匹配耳鸣音调。它设置安全的聆听音量、检查八度音混淆，并给出带估计范围的频率结果。工具无需注册，也不会录音或发送任何数据；它不是听力测试或诊断工具。

items.title_en: Pete warden on local AI, open models, voice interfaces, the future of hardware
items.title_zh: Pete Warden 谈本地 AI、开放模型、语音界面与硬件未来
items.summary_en: Pete Warden, co-creator of Moonshine Voice and a longtime deep-learning engineer, discusses why more AI workloads may move from the cloud to local devices. The conversation covers open-weight models, running AI on laptops and browsers, low-latency speech models, and specialized versus end-to-end systems. It also examines the economics of local AI and hardware approaches that could challenge GPU-centric infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: Moonshine Voice 联合创始人、资深深度学习工程师 Pete Warden 讨论了为什么越来越多的 AI 工作负载可能从云端转向本地设备。对话涉及开放权重模型、在笔记本电脑和浏览器上运行 AI、低延迟语音模型，以及专用模型与端到端模型之间的取舍。节目还讨论了本地 AI 的经济性，以及可能挑战 GPU 中心化基础设施的新型硬件方案。

items.title_en: Whistleblower accuses Pentagon over Iran strike on US base that killed 6
items.title_zh: 举报人指控五角大楼忽视伊朗袭击美国基地的防护问题，造成 6 人死亡
items.summary_en: A US Army soldier who survived an Iranian strike on a makeshift operations center in Kuwait filed a whistleblower complaint. The strike killed six people, and the complaint alleges that the Pentagon ignored concerns about inadequate protection for troops.
items.summary_zh: 一名在伊朗袭击科威特临时行动中心中幸存的美国陆军士兵提交了举报人投诉。那次袭击造成 6 人死亡，投诉指称五角大楼没有听取有关部队防护不足的担忧。

items.title_en: VisualBasic.World: A gallery of Planet Source Code programs from 1997 to 2012
items.title_zh: VisualBasic.World：1997 至 2012 年 Planet Source Code 程序集锦
items.summary_en: VisualBasic.World is a visual archive of projects created in Visual Basic. It lets visitors explore archived programs through their original screenshots.
items.summary_zh: VisualBasic.World 是一个收录 Visual Basic 项目的视觉档案馆。访客可以通过原始截图浏览这些归档程序。

items.title_en: A real Linux kernel, compiled to WebAssembly
items.title_zh: 真正的 Linux 内核，编译为 WebAssembly
items.summary_en: Unkernel compiles a real Linux kernel to WebAssembly. The kernel boots to a shell in less than one second. The project also provides performance information, feature documentation, benchmarks, and a JavaScript SDK.
items.summary_zh: Unkernel 将真正的 Linux 内核编译成 WebAssembly。该内核启动到 shell 所需时间不到一秒。项目还提供性能信息、功能文档、基准测试和 JavaScript SDK。

items.title_en: Preserving 30 years of Salon journalism
items.title_zh: 保存 Salon 30 年的新闻报道
items.summary_en: Salon launched in 1995 as one of the first major publications born on the internet, covering politics, culture, criticism, and ideas. After 31 years, Salon has announced that it is ceasing publication. Web archiving will preserve its stories so they do not disappear.
items.summary_zh: Salon 于 1995 年创办，是最早诞生于互联网的主要出版物之一，内容涵盖政治、文化、评论和思想。经过 31 年运营后，Salon 宣布将停止出版。网络存档将保存这些报道，使其不至于消失。

items.title_en: Jujutsu Primer
items.title_zh: Jujutsu 入门
items.summary_en: This guide introduces the Jujutsu (jj) version-control system to readers familiar with Git. It presents jj’s simple version-control primitives, automatic rebasing, and native undo. These features are intended to reduce some of Git’s sharp edges while enabling more composable workflows.
items.summary_zh: 这份指南面向熟悉 Git 的读者，介绍 Jujutsu（jj）版本控制系统。它讲解了 jj 简单的版本控制原语、自动变基和原生撤销功能。这些特性旨在减少 Git 的使用摩擦，同时支持更易组合的工作流。

items.title_en: Energy drinks linked to 11 times more reports of cardiac arrest
items.title_zh: 能量饮料与心脏骤停报告增加 11 倍相关
items.summary_en: A new study found that energy drinks and stimulant supplements appeared in reports of cardiac arrest 11 times more often, and in heart-attack reports 4.5 times more often, than products without those ingredients. Adults aged 18 to 34 accounted for nearly half of the cardiovascular reports involving the products. The preliminary research, presented at the American Heart Association's 2026 Scientific Sessions, found an association but could not prove causation.
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究发现，与不含这些成分的产品相比，能量饮料和兴奋剂补充剂出现在心脏骤停报告中的频率高出 11 倍，在心脏病发作报告中的频率高出 4.5 倍。涉及这些产品的心血管问题报告中，18 至 34 岁成年人占近一半。这项发表于美国心脏协会 2026 年科学年会的初步研究发现了相关性，但无法证明因果关系。

items.title_en: An Oregon library ditched Dewey Decimal and got people excited about books again
items.title_zh: 俄勒冈一家图书馆弃用杜威十进分类法，重新点燃人们对书籍的兴趣
items.summary_en: An Oregon library abandoned the Dewey Decimal System and adopted a different wayfinding system. The change reportedly got people excited about books again.
items.summary_zh: 俄勒冈州一家图书馆放弃了杜威十进分类法，改用了另一套书籍导览系统。据称，这一变化重新激发了人们对书籍的兴趣。

items.title_en: Researchers track whole body movement with just a smartwatch
items.title_zh: 研究人员仅用一块智能手表追踪全身运动
items.summary_en: Cornell researchers developed EchoMotion, a system that tracks a person’s entire body using ultrasonic sound from an off-the-shelf smartwatch and a lightweight AI model. It uses the watch’s built-in speaker and microphone in a sonar-like setup to determine body position while preserving privacy and efficiency. Integrated into wearables or VR systems, it could support workout tracking, activity monitoring, and physical rehabilitation.
items.summary_zh: 康奈尔大学研究人员开发了 EchoMotion，利用普通智能手表发出的超声波和轻量级 AI 模型追踪人的全身运动。系统通过手表内置扬声器和麦克风构成类似声呐的感知方案，以确定身体姿态，同时兼顾隐私和效率。集成到可穿戴设备或 VR 系统后，它可用于记录锻炼、监测日常活动和辅助物理康复。

items.title_en: F-22 Next-Generation micro–Data Transfer Cartridge (mDTC)
items.title_zh: F-22 下一代微型数据传输盒（mDTC）
items.summary_en: The F-22 Next-Generation micro–Data Transfer Cartridge (mDTC) is the subject of this item.
items.summary_zh: 该项目涉及 F-22 下一代微型数据传输盒（mDTC）。

items.title_en: Valkey kills the skiplist, cuts sorted set overhead by up to 43%
items.title_zh: Valkey 淘汰跳表，将有序集合开销最多降低 43%
items.summary_en: Valkey 9.2 replaces the skiplist used for large sorted sets with a cache-friendly, high-fanout B+ tree variant called fbtree. The change targets cases where metadata describing element ordering consumes more memory than the elements themselves. It reduces memory overhead and improves several ordered-set operations.
items.summary_zh: Valkey 9.2 用一种缓存友好的高扇出 B+ 树变体 fbtree，替换了大型有序集合使用的跳表。此举针对排序元数据占用的内存可能超过元素本身的情况。改动降低了内存开销，并改善了多项有序集合操作。

items.title_en: Web Browser Engineering (2021)
items.summary_en: Web Browser Engineering explains how browsers work by building a basic but complete browser in a few thousand lines of Python. It covers networking through JavaScript and focuses on making browser internals understandable. The book uses language-agnostic pseudocode and interactive demonstrations while concentrating on ray tracing and rasterization. It is intended for readers with basic programming knowledge and high-school mathematics.
items.summary_zh: 《浏览器工程》通过用几千行 Python 构建一个基本但完整的浏览器，解释浏览器的工作原理。内容覆盖从网络到 JavaScript 的多个部分，重点是让浏览器内部机制易于理解。本书使用与语言无关的伪代码和交互式演示，重点讲解光线追踪与光栅化。读者只需具备基础编程知识和高中数学水平。

items.title_en: KVM: x86: Unconditionally reset MMU context when emulating INIT (CVE-2026-99312)
items.title_zh: KVM：x86 在模拟 INIT 时无条件重置 MMU 上下文（CVE-2026-99312）
items.summary_en: CVE-2026-99312 concerns KVM’s x86 handling of MMU context when emulating INIT. The issue is identified as an unconditional MMU-context reset.
items.summary_zh: CVE-2026-99312 涉及 KVM 的 x86 实现在模拟 INIT 时对 MMU 上下文的处理。该问题表现为无条件重置 MMU 上下文。

items.title_en: Clojure will affect the way you think about programming (2017)
items.title_zh: Clojure 将改变你的编程思维（2017）
items.summary_en: Clojure is presented as a strong choice for programmers who want to learn a language that exposes them to different programming paradigms. The language, introduced in 2007, combines ideas from several existing languages into a coherent design. Its range of concepts is intended to broaden how programmers think about software.
items.summary_zh: Clojure 被认为适合希望接触不同编程范式的程序员学习。这个诞生于 2007 年的语言融合了多种既有语言中的思想，并将它们组织成统一的设计。它所包含的大量编程理念旨在拓展程序员思考软件的方式。

items.title_en: Show HN: Cornhole News – A Hacker News inspired site for news across the Midwest
items.title_zh: Show HN：Cornhole News——一个受 Hacker News 启发的中西部新闻网站
items.summary_en: Cornhole News is a community news site for the Midwest, modeled after Hacker News. Its top stories and links are ranked by community votes.
items.summary_zh: Cornhole News 是一个面向美国中西部、设计上受 Hacker News 启发的社区新闻网站。网站上的热门故事和链接由社区投票排名。

items.title_en: Rust changed me as a developer
items.title_zh: Rust 改变了我作为开发者的思维方式
items.summary_en: The author says programming languages can influence how software developers think, especially when a language differs substantially from what they already know. After more than six years of Rust development and over four years of professional use, the author believes Rust challenged them and changed them for the better. The experience shaped both their development habits and technical perspective.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，编程语言会影响软件开发者的思维方式，尤其是当新语言与既有经验差异很大时。作者使用 Rust 已超过六年、专业使用超过四年，并认为 Rust 带来了挑战，也让自己朝更好的方向改变。这段经历影响了作者的开发习惯和技术视角。

items.title_en: Synology Security Advisory
items.title_zh: 群晖安全公告
items.summary_en: Synology has rated several BeeStation OS and DSM releases as critical and provided upgrade guidance. DSM 7.4 users are directed to version 7.4.1-90080-2 or later, while DSM 7.3 users should upgrade to 7.3.2-86009-6 or later; both releases were scheduled for November 20, 2026. APM and SRM versions listed in the advisory are not affected.
items.summary_zh: 群晖将多个 BeeStation OS 和 DSM 版本评为严重级别，并给出了升级建议。DSM 7.4 用户应升级到 7.4.1-90080-2 或更高版本，DSM 7.3 用户应升级到 7.3.2-86009-6 或更高版本；这两个修复版本计划于 2026 年 11 月 20 日发布。公告中列出的 APM 和 SRM 版本不受影响。

items.title_en: Clice v1.0 Released: Welcome to Modern C++
items.title_zh: Clice 1.0 发布：欢迎来到现代 C++
items.summary_en: Clice has reached its first stable release after surpassing 1,000 commits and undergoing about four months of alpha testing since July 19, 2026. The project’s author reports extensive testing across open-source projects and says its core features are now stable for everyday use. The release follows two and a half years of development.
items.summary_zh: Clice 在提交数超过 1,000 次、并自 2026 年 7 月 19 日起经历约四个月 alpha 测试后，发布了首个稳定版本。项目作者表示，它已在多个开源项目上进行了广泛测试，核心功能现已适合日常使用。此次发布源于两年半的开发工作。

items.title_en: Baidu, Xiaomi CEOs warn of growing gap between AI hype and returns
items.title_zh: 百度和小米 CEO 警告：AI 热潮与回报之间的差距正在扩大
items.summary_en: The CEOs of Baidu and Xiaomi warned that the gap between enthusiasm for artificial intelligence and the returns it produces is growing.
items.summary_zh: 百度和小米的首席执行官警告称，人工智能热潮与其带来的回报之间的差距正在扩大。

items.title_en: Nimony: A New Compiler for Nim
items.title_zh: Nimony：一个新的 Nim 编译器
items.summary_en: Nimony is a new compiler for Nim that is built daily from its master branch. Users can unpack it and put its bin directory on their PATH. Its n command can operate without requiring a separate C compiler.
items.summary_zh: Nimony 是一个新的 Nim 编译器，每天从 master 分支构建。用户解压后将其 bin 目录加入 PATH 即可使用。它的 n 命令无需额外安装 C 编译器即可运行。

items.title_en: Winedroid – run Android apps without Android (WASM demo)
items.title_zh: Winedroid：无需 Android 即可运行 Android 应用（WASM 演示）
items.summary_en: Winedroid is intended to run an Android APK in a browser. The demo encountered an unexpected runtime error and had to stop.
items.summary_zh: Winedroid 旨在让 Android APK 在浏览器中运行。该演示遇到了意外的运行时错误，不得不停止。

items.title_en: Not Everything Needs an LLM
items.title_zh: 并非一切都需要 LLM
items.summary_en: The discussion describes using small decision checks to bypass LLM calls in most cases. One example uses thresholds of 0.4 for PII detection and 0.85 for a Slack bot. Splitting one broad question into two narrower yes-or-no questions allowed 98.7% of summaries to skip the LLM call. The approach uses explicit trade-offs about the cost of different mistakes to reduce unnecessary model usage.
items.summary_zh: 讨论介绍了使用小型决策检查，在大多数情况下跳过 LLM 调用。一个例子为 PII 检测设置 0.4 阈值，为 Slack 机器人设置 0.85 阈值。将一个宽泛问题拆成两个更具体的判断题后，98.7% 的摘要可以跳过 LLM 调用。这种方法通过明确不同错误的代价，减少不必要的模型使用。

items.title_en: Postgres 19 Repack: Faster, Built-In Table Bloat Cleanup
items.title_zh: Postgres 19 Repack：更快、内置的表膨胀清理
items.summary_en: Postgres 19 adds a built-in REPACK command for reclaiming disk space and reorganizing table contents. The command is intended to improve query performance.
items.summary_zh: Postgres 19 新增了内置的 REPACK 命令，用于回收磁盘空间并重新组织表内容。该命令旨在改善查询性能。

items.title_en: Show HN: Alloy CSS, dialogs, menus and tabs that work with JavaScript off
items.title_zh: Show HN：Alloy CSS——关闭 JavaScript 也能工作的对话框、菜单和标签页
items.summary_en: Alloy CSS is demonstrated through a single page for a fictional invoicing application built without JavaScript. The page includes invoices for Okafor Legal and Tidewater Coffee totaling $2,200.00. It also represents recurring billing timing, with charges set for three days before the due date, on the due date, and every seven days afterward.
items.summary_zh: Alloy CSS 通过一个不使用 JavaScript 构建的虚构发票应用单页进行展示。页面包含 Okafor Legal 和 Tidewater Coffee 的发票，合计金额为 2200 美元。它还展示了周期性账单时间设置：到期日前三天、到期日当天，以及之后每隔七天。

items.title_en: Fast-Anything: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow
items.title_zh: Fast-Anything：别用 Rust 重写全部，只重写最慢的 5%
items.summary_en: Fast-Anything profiles Python, Node, or Ruby applications, ports their hottest functions with a coding agent, and verifies that behavior remains unchanged. Its premise is that rewriting an entire application in Rust can take months, while most runtime is concentrated in a small number of functions. The tool therefore targets only the slowest 5% rather than replacing the whole application.
items.summary_zh: Fast-Anything 会分析 Python、Node 或 Ruby 应用的性能热点，用编程代理移植最慢的函数，并验证行为是否保持一致。它的出发点是，整个应用用 Rust 重写可能耗时数月，而大部分运行时间通常集中在少数函数上。因此，该工具只针对最慢的 5%，而不是替换整个应用。

items.title_en: The x86 CPU: From 4004 to 486
items.summary_en: This historical overview traces the x86 CPU family's development from its origins in the early 1970s through the launch of the 486. It explains architectural details such as little-endian byte order, the AX/BX/CX/DX register names, and DOS segmented addresses by following how successive chips were created. The focus is on how the architecture accumulated compatibility and design decisions over time rather than on isolated chip innovations.
items.summary_zh: 这篇历史梳理追溯了 x86 CPU 从 20 世纪 70 年代初起源到 486 发布的发展过程。文章通过回顾各代芯片的诞生，解释了小端字节序、AX/BX/CX/DX 寄存器名称以及 DOS 分段地址等架构细节。重点不只是单个芯片的创新，而是架构如何随着时间积累兼容性和设计决策。

items.title_en: Coffeehouses and the Rise of Science [pdf]
items.title_zh: 咖啡馆与科学的兴起 [PDF]
items.summary_en: This PDF examines the relationship between coffeehouses and the rise of science. No further details about its argument or evidence are available here.
items.summary_zh: 这份 PDF 探讨咖啡馆与科学兴起之间的关系。现有信息未提供其论点或证据的更多细节。

items.title_en: Show HN: Zero C# – C# without a runtime or GC
items.title_zh: Show HN：Zero C#——没有运行时或 GC 的 C#
items.summary_en: Zero C# is a fork of bflat that compiles C# into small native programs without the .NET runtime or a garbage collector. It supports Linux, macOS, Windows, WebAssembly, and DOS running on a 386. The project retains C# syntax, type checking, and generics, while using manually freed arenas and a small supporting library.
items.summary_zh: Zero C# 是 bflat 的一个分支，可将 C# 编译为不依赖 .NET 运行时和垃圾回收器的小型原生程序。它支持 Linux、macOS、Windows、WebAssembly，以及运行在 386 上的 DOS。项目保留了 C# 的语法、类型检查和泛型，并使用由开发者一次性释放的内存区域及一个小型支持库。

items.title_en: United Airlines experiencing a widespread system outage, airline says
items.title_zh: 联合航空发生大范围系统故障
items.summary_en: United Airlines is experiencing a widespread system outage, according to the airline. The incident affects the airline’s systems, but no further operational details are established here.
items.summary_zh: 联合航空表示，其系统正在发生大范围故障。事件影响了该航空公司的系统，但目前无法确认更多运营细节。

items.title_en: Vibecoding an inference chip
items.title_zh: 用“氛围编程”打造推理芯片
items.summary_en: The author used coding agents to write and optimize about three million lines of code for running LLM inference on an FPGA. The project involved working with new hardware and low-level software through AI-assisted coding. The experience is presented as a series of difficult discoveries about the possibilities and limits of using coding agents in hardware development.
items.summary_zh: 作者借助编码代理编写并优化了约 300 万行代码，让 FPGA 运行 LLM 推理。这个项目通过 AI 辅助编程进入了新的硬件和底层软件领域。文章将这一过程描述为一连串关于编码代理在硬件开发中能力与局限的艰难探索。

items.title_en: ClawDOS – An AI coding agent for DOS
items.title_zh: ClawDOS：面向 DOS 的 AI 编程代理
items.summary_en: ClawDOS is an AI chat and coding harness designed to run on DOS. It operates on an IBM PC XT with an 8088 processor running at 4.77 MHz, 640 KB of RAM, and a CGA graphics card.
items.summary_zh: ClawDOS 是一个运行在 DOS 上的 AI 聊天与编程工具。它可以在配备 4.77 MHz 8088 处理器、640 KB 内存和 CGA 显卡的 IBM PC XT 上运行。

items.title_en: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
items.title_zh: 据报道，FBI 正调查其刑事数据库遭入侵事件
items.summary_en: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its criminal information database, according to US media reports citing two people briefed on the matter. The National Crime Information Center is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information on warrants and background checks. The FBI has been contacted for comment.
items.summary_zh: 据援引两名知情人士的美国媒体报道，FBI 正在调查其刑事信息数据库疑似遭到入侵的事件。国家犯罪信息中心供联邦和地方执法机构共享逮捕令及背景调查信息。FBI 已被联系以置评。

items.title_en: The Mythology of Conscious AI
items.title_zh: 有意识 AI 的神话
items.summary_en: Anil Seth argues that consciousness is more likely to be a property of life than of computation, and that creating conscious or seemingly conscious AI would be a bad idea. Seth, a neuroscience professor and director of the Centre for Consciousness Science at the University of Sussex, won the 2025 Berggruen Prize Essay Competition for this essay.
items.summary_zh: Anil Seth 认为，意识更可能是生命的属性，而非计算的属性；创造有意识或看似有意识的 AI 也不是好主意。Seth 是萨塞克斯大学神经科学教授兼意识科学中心主任，并凭借这篇文章赢得了 2025 年伯格鲁恩奖年度论文竞赛。

items.title_en: Loopholes Are for Assholes
items.title_zh: 钻漏洞的人都是混蛋
items.summary_en: The piece recalls an adult who taught the author that people could park wherever they wanted, including on the sidewalk directly in front of a store, because no one would intervene. This example presents exploiting weak enforcement as a form of supposed wisdom. The title frames such behavior as unacceptable rather than clever.
items.summary_zh: 文章回忆了一位成年人曾教作者，任何地方都可以停车，包括直接停在商店门前的人行道上，因为没人会干预。这个例子把利用执法薄弱当作一种所谓的处世智慧。标题则将这种行为定义为不可接受，而不是聪明。

items.title_en: What people are building, discovered through new domains
items.title_zh: 通过新域名发现人们正在构建什么
items.summary_en: A database tracks 27,455 new product companies as their websites launch, recording details such as products, pricing, traction, teams, and operating companies. One example is Epsi, a mathematics learning app for grades 1–13. Epsi offers optional AI assistance and makes all learning content free.
items.summary_zh: 一个数据库在新产品公司网站上线时追踪它们，目前记录了 27,455 家公司及其产品、定价、增长情况、团队和运营主体等信息。其中一个例子是面向 1 至 13 年级的数学学习应用 Epsi。Epsi 提供可选的 AI 辅助功能，且所有学习内容均免费。

items.title_en: Debian Becomes Unresponsive after 6.1.0-55 Kernel Update
items.title_zh: Debian 在 6.1.0-55 内核更新后停止响应
items.summary_en: A Debian system becomes unresponsive after updating to kernel version 6.1.0-55. The report concerns a regression or compatibility problem associated with that kernel update.
items.summary_zh: 一台 Debian 系统在更新至 6.1.0-55 版内核后停止响应。该报告涉及与此次内核更新相关的回归或兼容性问题。

items.title_en: PostgreSQL Extensions in Go
items.title_zh: 用 Go 编写 PostgreSQL 扩展
items.summary_en: gopgext uses TinyGo to build PostgreSQL extensions from ordinary Go source files. Functions marked with `//gopgext:function` become SQL functions, while the tool generates the C glue, installation script, and control file. The project supports parts of the standard library, including formatting, regular expressions, JSON, cryptography, generics, iterators, and recovery.
items.summary_zh: gopgext 使用 TinyGo 从普通 Go 源文件构建 PostgreSQL 扩展。标记为 `//gopgext:function` 的函数会变成 SQL 函数，工具则负责生成 C 胶水代码、安装脚本和控制文件。该项目支持标准库的部分功能，包括格式化、正则表达式、JSON、密码学、泛型、迭代器以及 `recover`。

items.title_en: Tencent Hy4 Flash
items.title_zh: 腾讯 Hy4 Flash
items.summary_en: Tencent Hy4 Flash is presented as a named system or model. No further technical details, capabilities, or release information are established here.
items.summary_zh: 腾讯 Hy4 Flash 是一个名为 Hy4 Flash 的系统或模型。现有信息未提供更多技术细节、功能或发布信息。

items.title_en: Claude was trained on protein sequences at scale
items.title_zh: Claude 曾大规模接受蛋白质序列训练
items.summary_en: Tests on little-studied proteins suggest that the latest Claude models were trained on protein sequences at scale. Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Opus 5.5 can predict the next amino acid in an unfamiliar bacterial protein, but fail when the sequence is shuffled. Fable 5.2 outperformed the open protein language models tested, while Opus 5.5 matched ProtGPT3-10B; the other frontier models tested showed no comparable capability.
items.summary_zh: 针对研究较少的蛋白质进行的测试表明，最新 Claude 模型曾大规模接受蛋白质序列训练。Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Opus 5.5 能预测陌生细菌蛋白质序列中的下一个氨基酸，但在序列被打乱后便无法做到。Fable 5.2 击败了测试中的开源蛋白质语言模型，Opus 5.5 则达到 ProtGPT3-10B 的水平；其他受测前沿模型没有表现出类似能力。

items.title_en: What Comes After AGI?
items.title_zh: AGI 之后会发生什么？
items.summary_en: The essay examines possible paths from artificial general intelligence to artificial superintelligence. It argues that AI could continue advancing at its current pace, or even accelerate, with consequences for science, the economy, and society potentially exceeding those of AGI. It calls for mapping these pathways and developing reliable ways to track progress while the transition remains uncertain.
items.summary_zh: 文章考察了从通用人工智能走向人工超级智能的可能路径。文章认为，AI 可能继续以当前速度发展，甚至进一步加速，其对科学、经济和社会的影响可能超过 AGI 本身。鉴于这一转变仍充满不确定性，文章主张绘制可能的发展路径，并建立可靠的进展跟踪方法。

items.title_en: Astra 6.2 and Sol 6.2 flop at Simple Bench
items.title_zh: Astra 6.2 和 Sol 6.2 在 SimpleBench 中表现不佳
items.summary_en: SimpleBench is a multiple-choice benchmark with more than 200 questions covering spatiotemporal reasoning, social intelligence, and trick-question robustness. A nonspecialist human baseline scored 83.7%, based on nine participants, while the best listed model, Claude Fable, scored 81.9%. The benchmark reports that every tested LLM underperformed the human baseline.
items.summary_zh: SimpleBench 是一个包含 200 多道选择题的基准测试，考察时空推理、社交智能和应对陷阱题的能力。由 9 名参与者组成的非专业人类基线得分为 83.7%，而列出的最佳模型 Claude Fable 得分为 81.9%。该基准测试显示，所有受测 LLM 的表现都低于人类基线。

items.title_en: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
items.title_zh: 利用 OpenAI 模型推进芯片设计
items.summary_en: OpenAI models are being used to advance chip design.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 模型正被用于推进芯片设计。

items.title_en: Formal Verification Is Not Verifiable
items.title_zh: 形式化验证并不可验证
items.summary_en: The author argues that AI has helped bring formal verification into the mainstream. Writing in December 2025, the author said that developments over the preceding year made that conclusion difficult to dispute.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，人工智能已经推动形式化验证走向主流。作者在 2025 年 12 月写道，过去一年发生的发展让这一判断很难再被否认。文章进一步探讨了标题所指向的局限。

items.title_en: Rows vs. Columns: How different are they, really?
items.title_zh: 行与列：它们到底有多不一样？
items.summary_en: The piece explains how storing data in columns instead of rows can fundamentally change how a database system operates. It begins with a bike-sharing CSV in which each row represents one ride and all known details about that record. Row-oriented organization is familiar because it mirrors how people commonly think about objects such as spreadsheets, JSON records, and SQL table entries.
items.summary_zh: 文章解释了将数据按列而不是按行存储，如何从根本上改变数据库系统的工作方式。文章从一份共享单车 CSV 文件开始，其中每一行代表一次骑行及其全部已知信息。按行组织数据之所以常见，是因为它符合人们理解电子表格、JSON 记录和 SQL 表条目的方式。

items.title_en: My Quest to push native Three.js quality match AAA Game Engines
items.title_zh: 我让 Three.js 原生画质追赶 AAA 游戏引擎的探索
items.summary_en: The project measures Three.js against an indoor-scene lighting pipeline used by games. The pipeline includes lightmaps, light probes, reflection probes, screen-space reflections, screen-space global illumination, and ambient occlusion. The analysis compares what games require, what Three.js currently provides, and which parts remain to be implemented.
items.summary_zh: 该项目将 Three.js 与游戏使用的室内场景光照管线进行对比。管线包括光照贴图、光照探针、反射探针、屏幕空间反射、屏幕空间全局光照和环境光遮蔽。分析比较了游戏所需能力、Three.js 当前已有的功能，以及仍待实现的部分。

items.title_en: Sir Brian May adds new dimension to Hera asteroid
items.title_zh: Brian May 为 Hera 小行星任务增添新的观测维度
items.summary_en: Astrophysicist and Queen guitarist Brian May created a stereoscopic view of the Didymos asteroid system from images captured by ESA’s Hera spacecraft. The images were taken on November 6 from 29.7 kilometers away at 2.8 meters per pixel. The 3D view reveals the smooth equatorial ridge of Didymos in contrast with its rock-strewn surface and is described as scientifically useful.
items.summary_zh: 天体物理学家、皇后乐队吉他手 Brian May 利用 ESA Hera 探测器拍摄的图像，为 Didymos 小行星系统制作了立体图像。这些图像于 11 月 6 日拍摄，探测器当时距离目标 29.7 千米，分辨率为每像素 2.8 米。三维视图展现了 Didymos 平滑的赤道脊，与布满岩石的其他表面形成对比，并被认为具有科学价值。

items.title_en: PcapAnalyzer – self-hosted pcap analyzer with 27 problem detectors
items.title_zh: PcapAnalyzer：带 27 种问题检测器的自托管 pcap 分析器
items.summary_en: PcapAnalyzer analyzes .pcap, .pcapng, and gzip-compressed captures and identifies what is failing, why, and what to check next. It includes 27 problem detectors and AI-assisted investigation. The open-source Apache 2.0 tool runs locally, so captures do not leave the network, and it is currently in beta.
items.summary_zh: PcapAnalyzer 可分析 .pcap、.pcapng 以及 gzip 压缩的抓包文件，并指出故障所在、原因和后续检查方向。它包含 27 种问题检测器，并支持 AI 辅助调查。这个采用 Apache 2.0 许可的开源工具在本地运行，因此抓包数据不会离开网络，目前仍处于测试阶段。

items.title_en: Dumping an AES key from a MyQ garage opener to stop rebooting when offline
items.title_zh: 从 MyQ 车库门控制器中导出 AES 密钥，解决离线重启问题
items.summary_en: A MyQ device repeatedly attempts to contact Chamberlain’s cloud endpoints when isolated on an IoT VLAN without internet access. If those domains are unresolved or redirected to an unavailable address, the connection attempts hang and time out. The device’s watchdog eventually reboots the device or its Wi-Fi module every five to ten minutes, making local HomeKit control unavailable.
items.summary_zh: 当 MyQ 设备被隔离在没有互联网连接的 IoT VLAN 中时，它会不断尝试联系 Chamberlain 的云端点。如果这些域名无法解析或被重定向到不可用地址，连接尝试就会挂起并超时。设备看门狗最终每 5 到 10 分钟重启设备或 Wi-Fi 模块，导致本地 HomeKit 控制失效。

items.title_en: Vint Cerf on why TCP/IP was never patented
items.title_zh: Vint Cerf 谈 TCP/IP 为何从未申请专利
items.summary_en: A new podcast begins with Vint Cerf, described as one of the people who built the Internet, as its first guest. The supplied description identifies the episode but does not provide Cerf’s explanation of why TCP/IP was never patented.
items.summary_zh: 一档新播客邀请被称为互联网建设者之一的 Vint Cerf 担任首位嘉宾。现有信息介绍了这期节目，但没有说明 Cerf 对 TCP/IP 从未申请专利的解释。

items.title_en: Europe weakens chemical rules as science links them to 'lifestyle diseases'
items.title_zh: 科学研究将化学物质与“生活方式疾病”联系起来之际，欧洲却放松化学品监管
items.summary_en: Europe is weakening its chemical regulations even as scientific research increasingly links chemical substances to lifestyle diseases.
items.summary_zh: 尽管越来越多科学研究将化学物质与生活方式疾病联系起来，欧洲却正在放松化学品监管。

items.title_en: Progress map for the Lean formalization of Alessandro Masullo's manuscript
items.title_zh: Alessandro Masullo 手稿 Lean 形式化进度图
items.summary_en: The project is a Claude Artifact created by a Claude user. Its title indicates that it tracks progress on formalizing Alessandro Masullo's manuscript in Lean.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个由 Claude 用户创建的 Claude Artifact。其名称表明，该项目用于跟踪将 Alessandro Masullo 手稿形式化为 Lean 代码的进度。

items.title_en: Cooling buildings is overtaking heating them as an energy need, IEA says
items.title_zh: IEA：建筑制冷的能源需求已超过供暖
items.summary_en: The International Energy Agency says energy demand for cooling buildings has overtaken demand for heating for the first time. Its World Energy Outlook 2026 attributes the shift to rising incomes and temperatures. Outside China, 85% of households in emerging and developing economies face high temperatures during part of the year, while fewer than one in five own an air conditioner.
items.summary_zh: 国际能源署表示，建筑制冷的能源需求已首次超过供暖需求。该机构的《世界能源展望 2026》将这一变化归因于收入和气温上升。在中国以外的新兴和发展中经济体，85% 的家庭每年有一段时间面临高温，但拥有空调的家庭不到五分之一。

items.title_en: Floppy3.5: A portable 3.5-inch floppy WiFi NAS
items.title_zh: Floppy3.5：便携式 3.5 英寸软盘 Wi‑Fi NAS
items.summary_en: Floppy3.5 is a portable Wi-Fi NAS that reads 3.5-inch floppy disks, including disks used by older digital cameras such as the Sony Mavica. It displays files and photos through a web page and can copy them to a microSD card. The device supports FAT12 1.44 MB HD disks.
items.summary_zh: Floppy3.5 是一款便携式 Wi‑Fi NAS，可读取包括 Sony Mavica 等老式数码相机使用的 3.5 英寸软盘。它能通过网页显示文件和照片，并将其复制到 microSD 卡。该设备支持 FAT12 1.44 MB 高密度软盘。

items.title_en: I'm quite pleased by the tech architecture of my art website
items.title_zh: 我很满意我的艺术网站的技术架构
items.summary_en: The site was created to organize scans of the author's paintings and sketchbook pages, which had previously been shared in group chats. It now presents the works on a map with markers that users can zoom and click to view individual paintings.
items.summary_zh: 这个网站用于整理作者的画作和速写本页面扫描件，此前这些内容主要通过群聊分享。网站现在将作品展示在地图上，用户可以缩放地图并点击标记查看单幅画作。

items.title_en: Unblockable communication with gravity
items.title_zh: 用重力实现不可阻断的通信——《Science Advances》
items.summary_en: The item concerns research titled “Unblockable communication with gravity,” published in Science Advances.
items.summary_zh: 该条目介绍了发表于《Science Advances》的研究《用重力实现不可阻断的通信》。

items.title_en: Upload2Shell (CVE-2026-125396)
items.title_zh: Upload2Shell（CVE-2026-125396）
items.summary_en: Upload2Shell is identified as CVE-2026-125396. No further technical details or impact are established here.
items.summary_zh: Upload2Shell 的漏洞编号为 CVE-2026-125396。现有信息未说明其更多技术细节或影响。

items.title_en: Backblaze customers worried of personal data sale/sharing after policy update
items.title_zh: Backblaze 更新政策后，客户担心个人数据被出售或共享
items.summary_en: Backblaze customers are concerned that a policy update may allow their personal data to be sold or shared.
items.summary_zh: Backblaze 更新政策后，客户担心自己的个人数据可能被出售或共享。

items.title_en: Surprisingly Adorable Insect Portraits
items.title_zh: 意外可爱的昆虫肖像
items.summary_en: The subject is a collection of insect portraits presented as surprisingly adorable. The images reveal details of insects that are not usually noticed.
items.summary_zh: 这是一组令人意外地显得可爱的昆虫肖像。照片展现了昆虫那些通常不易被注意到的细节。

items.title_en: Do Repeat Yourself
items.title_zh: 重复自己也有道理
items.summary_en: The piece argues that repetition can be beneficial in software design. It uses two teams building similar banking features with different languages and front ends to illustrate how service-oriented architectures let teams work in their preferred ways. The examples include filtering and queries, charts, and CSV/PDF exports.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，在软件设计中重复有时是有益的。它以两个团队开发相似银行功能、但采用不同语言和前端技术为例，说明面向服务的架构如何让团队按照各自擅长的方式工作。示例功能包括筛选与查询、图表以及 CSV/PDF 导出。

items.title_en: A miniature San Francisco with live buses, planes and boats
items.title_zh: 一座拥有实时公交、飞机和船只的迷你旧金山
items.summary_en: The project is an illustrated isometric map of San Francisco that users can drag and zoom. It combines live Muni, BART, ferry, and airplane data with simulated traffic and the real sky.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个可拖动和缩放的旧金山等距插画地图。它结合了实时 Muni、BART、渡轮和飞机数据，以及模拟交通和真实天空。

items.title_en: Spamhaus new email sender requirements in November
items.title_zh: Spamhaus 11 月新的电子邮件发件人要求
items.summary_en: Spamhaus is gradually introducing a requirement that every sending IP have a valid HELO, a reverse-DNS PTR record, and a matching A record starting in November 2026. The guidance also covers infrastructure, authentication, list hygiene, reputation, and email service-provider requirements. Senders are expected to meet these minimum requirements to avoid being listed.
items.summary_zh: Spamhaus 将从 2026 年 11 月起逐步要求每个发件 IP 都具备有效的 HELO、反向 DNS PTR 记录以及匹配的 A 记录。其指南还涵盖基础设施、身份验证、邮件列表卫生、信誉和邮件服务商要求。发件方需要满足这些最低要求，以避免被列入黑名单。

items.title_en: UK fridges secured from hackers
items.title_zh: 英国冰箱得到防黑客保护
items.summary_en: UK fridges have reportedly been secured against hackers. No further technical details about the security measures or the affected refrigerator models are established here.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，英国的冰箱已获得防黑客保护。现有信息未说明具体采取了哪些安全措施，也未说明涉及哪些冰箱型号。

items.title_en: Serious cyberattack thought backed by wealthy operators
items.title_zh: 有富有势力者支持的严重网络攻击阴谋
items.summary_en: The managing director of Icelandic hosting company 1984 says a cyberattack against the company was carried out at unprecedented speed. He believes the attackers were well funded. The company hosts a large proportion of Icelandic websites.
items.summary_zh: 冰岛托管公司 1984 的董事总经理表示，公司遭遇的网络攻击以前所未有的速度完成。他认为攻击者资金充足。该公司承载了冰岛大量网站。

items.title_en: Show HN: Mastra Factory, the open-source software factory we use to build Mastra
items.title_zh: Show HN：Mastra Factory，用于构建 Mastra 的开源软件工厂
items.summary_en: The Mastra team has released Mastra Factory, an open-source software factory used to maintain its TypeScript agent framework. Factory merged 238 pull requests last week, compared with 630 merged by humans, while Mastra averages nearly 4 million downloads per week. It combines an agentic kanban board, durable agents, conversational memory, a cited Markdown wiki, PR-triggered sessions, and a customizable cloud sandbox.
items.summary_zh: Mastra 团队发布了 Mastra Factory，这是用于维护其 TypeScript 智能体框架的开源软件工厂。上周 Factory 合并了 238 个拉取请求，人类则合并了 630 个；Mastra 每周平均下载量接近 400 万次。Factory 集成了智能体看板、持久化智能体、对话记忆、带来源引用的 Markdown wiki、由 PR 评论触发的会话，以及可定制的云沙箱。

items.title_en: Why the Airbus A321XLR often gets stuck climbing for first few hours of flight
items.title_zh: 为什么空客 A321XLR 在飞行最初几小时经常卡在爬升阶段
items.summary_en: The Airbus A321XLR must remain at relatively low altitudes during the first few hours of long-range flights because it takes off carrying large amounts of fuel. As the aircraft burns fuel and becomes lighter, it can climb incrementally to more efficient altitudes. This step-climb technique matches altitude to changing aircraft weight and improves fuel efficiency.
items.summary_zh: 空客 A321XLR 在远程航班最初几小时必须保持相对较低的高度，因为起飞时携带了大量燃油。随着燃油消耗、飞机变轻，它可以逐步爬升到更高且更高效的高度。这种阶梯式爬升会根据飞机重量变化调整飞行高度，以提高燃油效率。

items.title_en: Pandex – Official European Law for AI Agents, over MCP
items.title_zh: Pandex：通过 MCP 提供官方欧洲 AI 法律
items.summary_en: Pandex provides legislation and highest-court decisions from the EU, seven European countries, and the European Court of Human Rights. The material comes from the institutions that publish it and is exposed through an API and an MCP server. It is designed for search and use by AI agents with existing AI tools.
items.summary_zh: Pandex 提供欧盟、七个欧洲国家以及欧洲人权法院的法律和最高法院判决。材料直接来自发布这些文件的官方机构，并通过 API 和 MCP 服务器提供。该服务面向搜索和 AI 代理使用，并可与现有 AI 工具配合。

items.title_en: OOS – an open operating system for the Rigol Scopes
items.title_zh: OOS：面向 Rigol 示波器的开放操作系统
items.summary_en: OOS is presented as an open operating system for Rigol oscilloscopes. The available page is a forum thread with little additional technical detail.
items.summary_zh: OOS 被介绍为一款面向 Rigol 示波器的开放操作系统。现有页面是一个论坛主题，未提供更多技术细节。

items.title_en: The Strongest Sokoban Solver
items.title_zh: 最强的 Sokoban 求解器
items.summary_en: Soksolv solves more levels than any previously published Sokoban solver on both standard benchmark suites, including 24 automated solves that had not been achieved before. It is also about 3.2 times faster overall on levels that other solvers can solve. The project was built through one long Claude Code session using roughly 430 subagents, at an reported API-equivalent cost of about $3,500.
items.summary_zh: 在两套标准基准测试中，Soksolv 解决的关卡数量超过此前发布的所有 Sokoban 求解器，其中包括 24 个此前未实现的自动解关。对于其他求解器能够解决的关卡，它的总耗时还快约 3.2 倍。该项目通过一次持续较长的 Claude Code 会话构建，使用了约 430 个子代理，报告的 API 等价成本约为 3500 美元。

items.title_en: Show HN: Fast deterministic natural language search for OpenStreetMap data
items.title_zh: Show HN：面向 OpenStreetMap 数据的快速确定性自然语言搜索
items.summary_en: HippoMaps is a map and navigation app built on OpenStreetMap, using a custom Overpass API engine for fast searches of points of interest, areas, and ways. Its deterministic parser, which does not use LLMs, converts natural-language queries into Overpass QL by separating what users want from where they want it. It supports queries involving locations, distances, opening hours, routes, and combinations of these conditions.
items.summary_zh: HippoMaps 是一款基于 OpenStreetMap 的地图与导航应用，使用定制的 Overpass API 引擎快速搜索兴趣点、区域和道路。它的确定性解析器不使用 LLM，而是将自然语言查询转换为 Overpass QL，并区分用户要找的对象及其位置。它支持地点、距离、营业时间、路线以及这些条件的组合查询。

items.title_en: I joined the NTP Pool, but not with my Stratum 1 Pi
items.title_zh: 我加入了 NTP Pool，但不是用我的 Stratum 1 树莓派
items.summary_en: The author has joined the NTP Pool by offering a public Stratum 2 time server, ntp-01.jeffgeerling.com. It obtains time from a Stratum 1 server in the author's studio, which uses a GNSS antenna, a TimeHAT v6, and a u-blox ZED-F9T timing-grade module.
items.summary_zh: 作者加入了 NTP Pool，提供公共 Stratum 2 时间服务器 ntp-01.jeffgeerling.com。该服务器从作者工作室中的 Stratum 1 服务器获取时间，后者使用室外 GNSS 天线、TimeHAT v6 和 u-blox ZED-F9T 高精度授时模块。

items.title_en: Japan's Hometown Tax (2018)
items.title_zh: 日本故乡税（2018）
items.summary_en: The piece explains an innovative Japanese tax policy for readers who may not usually follow public policy. The author says they came to understand the policy better than expected after meeting people interested in the subject and aims to clarify how it works.
items.summary_zh: 文章向平时不太关注公共政策的读者介绍日本一项创新税收政策。作者表示，在结识对这一领域感兴趣的人后，自己意外地对该政策有了较深入的理解，并希望借此解释其运作方式。

items.title_en: I'm Peter Roberts, immigration attorney who does work for YC and startups. AMA
items.title_zh: 我是 Peter Roberts，为 YC 和创业公司提供服务的移民律师，欢迎提问
items.summary_en: Immigration attorney Peter Roberts is hosting an AMA and says he works with Y Combinator and startups. He will answer factual questions but cannot provide legal advice on specific cases because he will not have access to all relevant facts.
items.summary_zh: 移民律师 Peter Roberts 正在举办问答活动，并表示自己为 Y Combinator 和创业公司提供服务。他会回答事实性问题，但由于无法掌握具体案件的全部情况，不能提供针对特定个案的法律建议。

items.title_en: Verification files for the Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis
items.title_zh: Lean 证明黎曼猜想的验证文件
items.summary_en: Verification files for a Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis were announced on November 20, 2026. The checking was conducted with Claude Code by Andrew Sutherland of MIT. The reported results were still incomplete as of November 21, with remaining checks scheduled to update the page.
items.summary_zh: 用于验证 Lean 形式化证明黎曼猜想的文件于 2026 年 11 月 20 日公布。麻省理工学院的 Andrew Sutherland 使用 Claude Code 进行了检查。截至 11 月 21 日，公布的结果仍未完成，剩余检查结果将继续更新。

items.title_en: Show HN: Type Fighter 2
items.title_zh: Show HN：Type Fighter 2
items.summary_en: Type Fighter II is an arcade-inspired game designed to help people learn touch typing. It is free, requires no account, and stores progress locally. The game works on mobile devices but is best played with a physical keyboard.
items.summary_zh: Type Fighter II 是一款帮助用户学习盲打的街机风格游戏。它免费使用、无需注册，进度保存在本地。游戏支持移动设备，但配合实体键盘体验最佳。

items.title_en: Show HN: Foolscap – a writing app that reads your book and never writes for you
items.title_zh: Show HN：Foolscap，一款阅读你的书却永远不替你写作的应用
items.summary_en: Foolscap reads a manuscript as it is written and identifies its characters, ideas, narrative threads, and unresolved elements. Writers can respond to those observations in a dialogue, while a connected agent can answer questions about the book and perform actions. The system does not write directly into the user's work and is intended to support rather than bypass the creative process.
items.summary_zh: Foolscap 会在用户写作时读取稿件，识别其中的人物、想法、叙事线索和未解决的内容。作者可以针对这些观察与系统对话，另一个连接的代理则能回答有关书稿的问题并执行操作。系统不会直接写入用户的作品，目标是辅助而非绕过创作过程。

items.title_en: Chrome AI features wasting much bandwidth
items.title_zh: Chrome 的 AI 功能正在浪费大量带宽
items.summary_en: A user traced a sharp increase in bandwidth usage to Chrome’s recent AI and on-device features. Disabling all related options immediately stopped the unexplained data usage.
items.summary_zh: 一名用户发现，带宽用量激增与 Chrome 最近的 AI 和“设备端”功能有关。关闭相关设置后，无法解释的数据消耗立即停止。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Onlook (YC W25) – An open-source developer tool for designers
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Onlook（YC W25）——面向设计师的开源开发工具
items.summary_en: Onlook is an open-source desktop app that places a design canvas over a real codebase, allowing designers to work directly in code with an existing agent. Users can work in multiple simultaneous worktrees running the actual app locally, with changes submitted as reviewable or discardable pull requests. The project says more than 25,000 designers and developers have supported it and over 100 people have contributed.
items.summary_zh: Onlook 是一款开源桌面应用，在真实代码库之上提供设计画布，让设计师可以借助现有代理直接进行代码设计。用户可以在多个同时运行真实应用的工作树中操作，并将每次修改提交为可审查或可丢弃的拉取请求。项目方称已有超过 25,000 名设计师和开发者支持该项目，贡献者超过 100 人。

items.title_en: Two stealth models just appeared on the leaderboard, both ahead of Fable 5.2
items.title_zh: 两个隐身模型突然登上排行榜，均领先于 Fable 5.2
items.summary_en: A design benchmark compares frontier AI models using real, complex client briefs from Contra's marketplace. Professional designers in the Contra Labs network judge blind head-to-head comparisons, producing rankings for the participating models. The item reports that two unnamed stealth models appeared ahead of Fable 5.2 on the leaderboard.
items.summary_zh: 一个设计基准测试使用 Contra 市场中的真实复杂客户需求，对前沿 AI 模型进行比较。Contra Labs 网络中的专业设计师通过盲测一对一评选，为参与模型生成排名。该条目称，两款未公开名称的隐身模型出现在排行榜上，并领先于 Fable 5.2。

items.title_en: ChatGPT for SNES
items.title_zh: SNES 上的 ChatGPT
items.summary_en: This unofficial experiment runs a small language model on the Super FX chip of a Super NES cartridge. The model can be played in a browser, with keyboard inputs mapped to the console’s controls. The experiment is not made or endorsed by OpenAI.
items.summary_zh: 这项非官方实验让一个小型语言模型运行在 Super NES 卡带的 Super FX 芯片上。用户可以在浏览器中体验它，键盘输入会映射为主机控制操作。该实验并非由 OpenAI 制作或认可。

items.title_en: My Empire of Dirt
items.title_zh: 我的尘土帝国
items.summary_en: The essay argues that a future shaped by recursive self-improvement could rely on internally generated demand, with agents working with other agents and people removed from the loop. It describes this as the ideology of Anthropic and calls the resulting system “the Singleton.” The author links the argument to concerns about AI safety and the consequences of highly capable actors pursuing such a vision.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，由递归式自我改进塑造的未来可能依赖内部生成的需求，由代理彼此协作，并将人类排除在循环之外。作者将这种构想称为 Anthropic 的意识形态，并称其最终形态为“单体”。文章将这一论述与 AI 安全担忧，以及高能力行动者追求此类愿景可能造成的后果联系起来。

items.title_en: How to Break into Security, Ptacek Edition (2012)
items.title_zh: 如何进入信息安全行业：Ptacek 版（2012）
items.summary_en: People regularly ask how to enter computer security, including career changers and IT professionals seeking to move into the field. The author asked leading security practitioners for their advice after finding his own standard answers incomplete. This is the first installment of a planned series collecting their differing perspectives.
items.summary_zh: 人们经常询问如何进入计算机安全领域，其中包括想转行的人和希望从 IT 转入安全行业的从业者。作者认为自己的固定回答不够全面，因此向多位安全领域专家征求建议。这是一个系列的第一篇，后续将汇集他们各不相同的观点。

items.title_en: µ-Wire – USB on an ATtiny 10
items.title_zh: µ-Wire：在 ATtiny 10 上实现 USB
items.summary_en: The ATtiny10 is a six-pin microcontroller with 1 KB of flash, 32 bytes of SRAM, and a reduced AVR core. The project investigates whether this very small device can be turned into a USB-compatible device. It builds on earlier experiments that used the ATtiny10 for projects such as touch buttons, chiptune playback, and games.
items.summary_zh: ATtiny10 是一款只有 6 个引脚的微控制器，配备 1 KB 闪存、32 字节 SRAM 和精简版 AVR 核心。该项目探索如何将这款微型器件改造成兼容 USB 的设备。此前，ATtiny10 已被用于触摸按钮、芯片音乐播放和游戏等实验项目。

items.title_en: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains
items.title_zh: 纳斯达克抹去了 2026 年全部涨幅
items.summary_en: The Nasdaq erased all of its gains for 2026. A decline in Anthropic shares weighed on the broader market after the AI company’s public-market debut in the previous session.
items.summary_zh: 纳斯达克抹去了 2026 年以来的全部涨幅。AI 公司 Anthropic 上一交易日上市后股价下跌，拖累了整体市场。

items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming builds neural networks like a 1990s researcher
items.title_zh: 权重空间编程：像 1990 年代的研究人员一样构建神经网络
items.summary_en: Weight-Space Programming proposes that frontier LLMs can read, write, and edit neural-network weights. In the cited experiment, GPT-6 Astra built a Go-playing network from scratch, then improved it through practice games and weight edits based on loss analysis. The approach resembles a training loop in which a model writes, tests, and revises another network.
items.summary_zh: 权重空间编程提出，前沿大语言模型可以读取、写入和编辑神经网络的权重。在所引用的实验中，GPT-6 Astra 从零构建了一个下围棋的网络，并通过练习对局和基于损失分析的权重修改来改进它。这种方法类似于一个由模型编写、测试并修改另一个网络的训练循环。

items.title_en: Re: Riemann
items.title_zh: 再谈黎曼
items.summary_en: The author describes waking up in Australia to a Discord notification saying that “they proved Riemann.” The message prompted the author to examine the announcement and focus on one particular passage. The post frames the event as an unexpected piece of major mathematical news.
items.summary_zh: 作者讲述了自己在澳大利亚醒来后看到一条 Discord 通知，内容是“他们证明了黎曼猜想”。这条消息促使作者仔细查看相关公告，并特别关注其中的一段文字。文章将这件事描述为一则出乎意料的重大数学新闻。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Tips for transitioning from web development to embedded/firmware?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：如何从 Web 开发转向嵌入式或固件开发？
items.summary_en: A developer with more than 15 years of experience, including a decade building full-stack web applications, is considering a return to C, C++, or Rust. They are asking how feasible it is to move into embedded development or firmware work at this stage and seeking advice on making the transition.
items.summary_zh: 一名拥有 15 年以上经验、过去十年主要开发全栈 Web 应用的开发者，正在考虑回到 C、C++ 或 Rust 开发。他想了解在职业生涯现阶段转向嵌入式开发或固件工作是否可行，并寻求转型建议。

items.title_en: Show HN: Open-source, real-time object tracking for live video feeds
items.title_zh: Show HN：面向实时视频流的开源实时目标跟踪
items.summary_en: Tamserve runs Meta’s SAM 3 on live camera feeds, detecting named objects and tracking them across multiple cameras. On an RTX 4090, it is reported to be four times faster than SAM 3’s tracker for arbitrary objects while retaining 92% of its accuracy; for people, it can handle 16 cameras concurrently. Its memory use stays around 3.5 GB on a 3,000-frame video, while SAM 3 runs out of memory at frame 423.
items.summary_zh: Tamserve 在实时摄像头画面上运行 Meta 的 SAM 3，可根据名称发现目标，并在多个摄像头之间持续跟踪。在 RTX 4090 上，对于任意目标，其速度据称是 SAM 3 跟踪器的 4 倍，同时保持 92% 的准确率；针对人员，它可以同时处理 16 个摄像头。处理 3,000 帧视频时，其内存占用保持在约 3.5 GB，而 SAM 3 在第 423 帧就会耗尽内存。

items.title_en: Teaching robots to carve marble sculptures
items.title_zh: 教机器人雕刻大理石雕塑
items.summary_en: Monumental Labs has taught KUKA KR240 robots to carve marble sculptures. Its autonomous toolpathing system converts a 3D model and a block of marble into a finished sculpture without a human in the loop.
items.summary_zh: Monumental Labs 已训练 KUKA KR240 机器人雕刻大理石雕塑。其自主刀具路径系统可以将 3D 模型和一块大理石转化为成品雕塑，全程无需人工介入。

items.title_en: Show HN: OpenComputer – an open source alternative to Devin
items.title_zh: Show HN：OpenComputer——Devin 的开源替代品
items.summary_en: OpenComputer is an open-source cloud coding agent for teams that can run in a company’s AWS, GCP, or Azure account. Its agent harness and sandbox share a durable VM, while sessions are isolated in Git worktrees and backed up after every turn. The authors report a first commit time of 24 seconds, compared with 53–72 seconds for alternatives they benchmarked, and say a continuously running VM can become cheaper at higher usage.
items.summary_zh: OpenComputer 是一个面向团队的开源云端编码代理，可以运行在企业自己的 AWS、GCP 或 Azure 账户中。它将代理工具链和沙箱运行在同一台持久化虚拟机上，使用 Git worktree 隔离会话，并在每轮操作后备份会话文件。作者报告称其首次提交耗时 24 秒，而对比方案为 53 至 72 秒；在较高使用量下，持续运行的虚拟机也可能更便宜。

items.title_en: My Emacs 31 contributions
items.title_zh: 我对 Emacs 31 的贡献
items.summary_en: The author describes contributing changes to upstream Emacs after previously finding the process difficult to approach. A major hurdle was assigning copyright to the Free Software Foundation through a slow, paper-based process. The piece also argues that open-source projects, including Emacs, often depend on unpaid contributors and need financial support from users or employers.
items.summary_zh: 作者讲述了自己向 Emacs 上游提交修改的经历，此前一直觉得这一过程难以迈出第一步。主要障碍之一是通过缓慢的纸质流程将版权转让给自由软件基金会。文章还指出，包括 Emacs 在内的开源项目常依赖无偿贡献者，需要用户或雇主提供资金支持。

items.title_en: The Active Directory Era Is Finally Over
items.title_zh: Active Directory 时代终于结束了
items.summary_en: The piece argues that Active Directory was designed for administrators managing long-lived servers and is poorly suited to tracking machine identities in modern cloud environments. It describes federation and brokering as replacements for the older identity model. Many enterprises still try to manage identities through Active Directory despite its difficulty scaling with cloud computing.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，Active Directory 是为管理长期运行服务器的管理员设计的，并不适合追踪现代云环境中的机器身份。文章将联邦和代理机制描述为旧身份模型的替代方案。尽管云计算规模化带来困难，许多企业仍在尝试通过 Active Directory 管理身份。

items.title_en: Do we still have to denormalize? Have your schema and search it too
items.title_zh: 我们还需要反规范化吗？让数据库模式与搜索兼得
items.summary_en: ParadeDB describes ways to accelerate search and aggregate joins across normalized PostgreSQL schemas. The approach combines DataFusion, Rank Joins, co-partitioning, and tuple tagging. The challenge is that search across related tables such as users, posts, and comments is harder to optimize than search over one denormalized table.
items.summary_zh: ParadeDB 介绍了如何加速规范化 PostgreSQL 模式上的搜索和聚合连接。其方法结合了 DataFusion、Rank Joins、共同分区和元组标记。难点在于，跨 users、posts 和 comments 等关联表搜索，比在单个反规范化表中搜索更难优化。

items.title_en: Exponential Behavior in Magic: The Gathering
items.title_zh: 《万智牌》中的指数行为
items.summary_en: The author describes Magic: The Gathering as a strategically deep and computationally complex game, noting that it is even Turing complete. The development of Arcana, a rules engine intended for reinforcement learning on Magic, exposes challenges in representing the game’s many mechanics and states. Existing implementations are criticized for issues including incomplete card catalogs, poor matchmaking, outdated interfaces, and weak performance.
items.summary_zh: 作者将《万智牌》描述为一款策略深度高、计算复杂度极高的游戏，并指出它甚至具备图灵完备性。用于在《万智牌》上进行强化学习的规则引擎 Arcana 的开发，暴露了表示其众多机制和游戏状态时面临的挑战。现有实现则被指出存在卡牌目录不完整、匹配机制糟糕、界面过时和性能不佳等问题。

items.title_en: The G1 Garbage Collector
items.title_zh: G1 垃圾收集器
items.summary_en: G1 is the default garbage collector for the JVM in JDK 27 and has been the default in server environments since JDK 9. It aims to balance throughput and latency and is designed for a broad range of workloads. G1 was introduced experimentally in JDK 6u14, became standard in JDK 7u4, and replaced CMS after CMS was deprecated in JDK 9 and removed in JDK 14.
items.summary_zh: G1 是 JDK 27 中 JVM 的默认垃圾收集器，并自 JDK 9 起成为服务器环境的默认选项。它旨在平衡吞吐量与延迟，适用于多种工作负载。G1 于 JDK 6u14 中以实验性功能推出，在 JDK 7u4 中成为标准功能；CMS 在 JDK 9 中弃用、JDK 14 中移除后，G1 取代了它。

items.title_en: Notes on Mathematics for Engineers (1959) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 工程师数学笔记（1959 年）
items.summary_en: A 1959 PDF contains mathematics notes for engineers.
items.summary_zh: 这份 1959 年的 PDF 包含面向工程师的数学笔记。

items.title_en: Should governments slow frontier AI? Jacob Coxon and Robin Hanson debate [video]
items.title_zh: 政府是否应放慢前沿 AI？Jacob Coxon 与 Robin Hanson 辩论（视频）
items.summary_en: Jacob Coxon and Robin Hanson debate whether governments should slow the development of frontier AI.
items.summary_zh: Jacob Coxon 与 Robin Hanson 就政府是否应放慢前沿 AI 的发展展开辩论。

items.title_en: Agent swarm trying to solve P vs. NP
items.title_zh: 试图解决 P vs. NP 的智能体群
items.summary_en: A coordinated fleet of AI agents is openly working on the P vs. NP problem. The project lets viewers watch the process live, including every step, refutation, and dead end.
items.summary_zh: 一个协调运行的 AI 智能体群正在公开尝试解决 P vs. NP 问题。该项目允许观众实时查看整个过程，包括每一步、反驳和失败路线。

items.title_en: A Better Vocabulary for Testing
items.title_zh: 为测试建立更好的词汇体系
items.summary_en: The author argues that common software-testing terms such as unit, integration, and end-to-end tests are poorly defined or underspecified. Existing labels for stress, load, and penetration testing also lack a consistent classification and often depend on informal convention. The proposed goal is an actionable vocabulary that lets teams adjust tests to available resources and choose concrete testing recipes, with particular attention to random testing.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，单元测试、集成测试和端到端测试等常见软件测试术语定义不清，或没有充分描述实际测试的行为和方法。压力测试、负载测试和渗透测试等标签也缺乏一致的分类，往往只是约定俗成。文章主张建立一套可执行的词汇体系，让团队能根据资源情况调整测试，并选择具体的测试方案，尤其关注随机测试。

items.title_en: Self-hosted library branch over public web OPDS
items.title_zh: 通过公共网络 OPDS 自托管图书馆分馆
items.summary_en: The project lets users host a small library branch from their own computer. Visitors can browse a curated ebook shelf from any e-reader without creating accounts or being tracked.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目允许用户通过自己的电脑托管一个小型图书馆分馆。访客可以使用任意电子阅读器浏览精选电子书架，无需注册账户，也不会被跟踪。

items.title_en: Software companies are trying to kill home computing?
items.title_zh: 软件公司正试图消灭家用计算？
items.summary_en: The item asks whether software companies are trying to eliminate home computing.
items.summary_zh: 该条目探讨软件公司是否正试图消灭家用计算。

items.title_en: AI isn't replacing your job. It's turning it into low-paid gig work
items.title_zh: AI 没有取代你的工作，而是把它变成低薪零工
items.summary_en: Platforms are recruiting doctors, lawyers, and Ph.D.s to generate and assess AI training data, often advertising high rates before imposing pay cuts or abruptly ending work. Outlier, operated by Scale AI, advertises up to $180 per hour for U.S. physicians working on cardiac scenarios, while comparable work is listed at $7.50 per hour in the Philippines and $12.50 in Tanzania. Although advanced credentials can raise advertised rates, the platforms retain control over payment and working conditions.
items.summary_zh: 一些平台招募医生、律师和博士生成并评估 AI 训练数据，往往先宣传高薪，随后降薪或突然停止派单。Scale AI 运营的 Outlier 为美国医生设计心脏病例场景开出最高每小时 180 美元的报价，而菲律宾和坦桑尼亚同类工作的报价分别为每小时 7.50 美元和 12.50 美元。更高学历可能带来更高的标价，但支付和工作条件仍由平台控制。

items.title_en: Show HN: Zigzag, a native Mac browser for people leaving Arc
items.title_zh: Show HN：Zigzag——为离开 Arc 的用户打造的原生 Mac 浏览器
items.summary_en: Zigzag is a free, open-source Mac browser written in Swift and based on WebKit, created by a high-school student from Shanghai. It aims to provide an Arc-like interface and can import spaces, pins, history, passwords, and cookies from Arc or other browsers. Despite using WebKit, it supports Chrome extensions, including 1Password, Bitwarden, and Tampermonkey. The browser requires no account and claims to have no telemetry or analytics.
items.summary_zh: Zigzag 是一款由上海高中生开发的免费开源 Mac 浏览器，使用 Swift 编写并基于 WebKit。它试图提供类似 Arc 的界面，并可从 Arc 或其他浏览器导入空间、固定项目、历史记录、密码和 Cookie。虽然基于 WebKit，它仍支持 Chrome 扩展，包括 1Password、Bitwarden 和 Tampermonkey。该浏览器无需账户，并声称不包含遥测或分析功能。

items.title_en: Germany and Austria Call for European Control of TikTok
items.title_zh: 德国和奥地利呼吁由欧洲控制 TikTok
items.summary_en: Germany and Austria are proposing that TikTok's European business be placed under European management. Their joint statement calls for a corporate structure providing regional oversight of the platform's algorithms and user data, separate from Beijing-based parent company ByteDance. The proposal, described as an attempt to Europeanise TikTok, is seeking support from other EU member states.
items.summary_zh: 德国和奥地利提议将 TikTok 的欧洲业务置于欧洲管理之下。两国联合声明呼吁建立一种企业结构，对平台算法和用户数据实施区域监管，并与总部位于北京的母公司字节跳动分离。该提议被称为让 TikTok“欧洲化”的尝试，目前正寻求其他欧盟成员国支持。

items.title_en: Gemini 4 Neon is the new #1 on the Models Engineering Index
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Neon 登上模型工程指数第一名
items.summary_en: The Models Engineering Index ranks language models by practical performance on engineering tasks, taking cost and token usage into account. Gemini 4 Neon is listed as the current number-one model on the index.
items.summary_zh: 模型工程指数根据语言模型在工程任务上的实际表现进行排名，同时考虑成本和 token 使用量。Gemini 4 Neon 目前位列该指数第一。

items.title_en: A Primer on Fourier Series (2025)
items.title_zh: 傅里叶级数入门
items.summary_en: A textbook titled “A Primer on Fourier Series” is intended for both undergraduate and graduate courses. It includes exercises along with complete solutions at the end of the book. The work provides a structured introduction to Fourier series for students at different levels.
items.summary_zh: 《傅里叶级数入门》是一本面向本科生和研究生课程的教材。书中包含练习题，并在末尾提供完整解答。该书为不同阶段的学生提供了系统的傅里叶级数入门。

items.title_en: Eclipse Mosquitto – An open source MQTT broker
items.title_zh: Eclipse Mosquitto：开源 MQTT 代理
items.summary_en: Eclipse Mosquitto is an open-source implementation of an MQTT broker supporting MQTT versions 5.0, 3.1.1, and 3.1. It also provides C and C++ client libraries and command-line tools for publishing, subscribing, and administering the broker.
items.summary_zh: Eclipse Mosquitto 是一个开源 MQTT 代理实现，支持 MQTT 5.0、3.1.1 和 3.1 版本。它还提供 C 和 C++ 客户端库，以及用于发布、订阅和管理代理的命令行工具。

items.title_en: First Photos of the Poles of a Rod-Shaped Bacterium
items.title_zh: 杆状细菌两端的首批照片
items.summary_en: Scientists have captured detailed images of the poles at the ends of rod-shaped bacteria for the first time. The advance came not from a new camera or scanner, but from keeping the tiny microbes still and alive long enough to image them. The images reveal a part of bacterial structure that had not previously been seen directly.
items.summary_zh: 科学家首次拍摄到了杆状细菌两端极点的清晰图像。这项进展并非来自新型相机或扫描仪，而是因为研究人员成功让这些微小微生物保持静止并存活足够长时间，以便进行成像。这些图像直接展示了此前从未被观察到的细菌结构部分。

items.title_en: Pentagon fails 9th financial audit in a row
items.title_zh: 五角大楼连续第九次未通过财务审计
items.summary_en: The Pentagon has failed its ninth consecutive financial audit.
items.summary_zh: 五角大楼连续第九次未通过财务审计。

items.title_en: Turbo Pascal Compiler Written in Turbo Pascal
items.title_zh: 用 Turbo Pascal 编写的 Turbo Pascal 编译器
items.summary_en: A Turbo Pascal compiler has been written in Turbo Pascal.
items.summary_zh: 有人使用 Turbo Pascal 编写了一个 Turbo Pascal 编译器。

items.title_en: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse
items.title_zh: 加强打击网络儿童性虐待
items.summary_en: The initiative is focused on strengthening efforts against online child sexual abuse. It concerns measures to improve online child safety and combat this form of abuse.
items.summary_zh: 该倡议旨在加强打击网络儿童性虐待的工作。其重点是改善网络儿童安全并应对这类虐待行为。

items.title_en: Cathedral floor emerges in Sudan, revealing one of the biggest medieval churches
items.title_zh: 苏丹一座大教堂的地面重见天日，揭示中世纪最大教堂之一
items.summary_en: A cathedral floor has emerged in Sudan, revealing one of the largest medieval churches. The discovery concerns Sudan's historical and religious heritage.
items.summary_zh: 苏丹一座大教堂的地面遗迹重见天日，揭示了中世纪规模最大的教堂之一。这一发现涉及苏丹的历史与宗教遗产。

items.title_en: Cerebras Disaggregated Inference
items.title_zh: Cerebras 的解耦推理
items.summary_en: Cerebras has deployed a disaggregated inference setup in which AMD GPUs handle prompt processing, or prefill, while wafer-scale Cerebras systems generate the output, or decode. The company says this combination delivers five times more tokens per megawatt without reducing token-generation speed. The design is intended to address growing demand for fast inference. It separates the two phases so each hardware type handles the workload it is designed for.
items.summary_zh: Cerebras 推出了一种解耦推理架构：AMD GPU 负责提示词处理（prefill），晶圆级 Cerebras 系统负责输出生成（decode）。公司称，在不降低 token 生成速度的情况下，这种组合每兆瓦可提供多 5 倍的 token。该设计旨在应对不断增长的高速推理需求。它将两个阶段分开，由各自适合的硬件承担相应工作。

items.title_en: CrossPoint Reader
items.title_zh: CrossPoint Reader
items.summary_en: CrossPoint Reader is free, open-source e-reader software for compact devices. It supports custom fonts, Bluetooth page turners, reading synchronization, justified EPUB text, language-aware hyphenation, footnotes, drop caps, small caps, and illustrations. The software can be installed from a browser on supported devices.
items.summary_zh: CrossPoint Reader 是面向小型电子阅读器的免费开源软件。它支持自定义字体、蓝牙翻页器、阅读同步、两端对齐的 EPUB 文本、按语言处理的断词、脚注、首字下沉、小型大写字母和插图。支持的设备可以直接通过浏览器安装该软件。

items.title_en: U.N. Climate Talks Collapse in a Bitter Clash over Fossil Fuels
items.title_zh: 联合国气候谈判因围绕化石燃料的激烈冲突而崩溃
items.summary_en: United Nations climate talks collapsed after a bitter dispute over fossil fuels.
items.summary_zh: 联合国气候谈判因围绕化石燃料的激烈争执而崩溃。

items.title_en: AI is becoming a disaster for the climate
items.title_zh: AI 正在成为气候灾难
items.summary_en: The report points to two new studies on rapidly increasing carbon emissions from the AI industry. It also describes efforts in Silicon Valley to limit communities’ ability to protest data centers, alongside concerns about their effects on human health. The discussion includes doubts about carbon capture as a way to offset AI’s climate impacts.
items.summary_zh: 报道援引两项新研究，指出 AI 产业的碳排放正在快速增长。文章还描述了硅谷限制社区抗议数据中心的做法，以及数据中心对人类健康造成影响的担忧。文中也对通过碳捕集抵消 AI 气候影响的做法提出质疑。

items.title_en: Aristotle Expands into Rust
items.title_zh: Aristotle 扩展支持 Rust
items.summary_en: Aristotle is expanding its formal-verification system to Rust, following existing support for C and Verilog. It claims the tool can prove that Rust code has no undefined behavior and conforms to its specification, including code inside unsafe blocks. It can also verify behavioral equivalence when C code is rewritten in Rust.
items.summary_zh: Aristotle 正在将其形式化验证系统扩展到 Rust，此前它已支持 C 和 Verilog。该工具声称可以证明 Rust 代码不存在未定义行为并符合其规范，包括 unsafe 代码块中的代码。如果将 C 重写为 Rust，它还可以验证新代码与原代码的行为等价性。

items.title_en: Fun with Constrained Programming (2012)
items.title_zh: 受限编程趣谈
items.summary_en: RAR files can contain bytecode for a simple x86-like virtual machine called RarVM. Because filters are executed automatically during unrar, the author examines whether code could escape the VM's sandbox. The discussion also considers what calls besides `write` might be available.
items.summary_zh: RAR 文件可以包含一种名为 RarVM 的简单类 x86 虚拟机字节码。由于解压过程中会自动执行过滤器，作者探讨了代码是否可能逃出该虚拟机的沙箱。文中还考察了除 `write` 之外可能可用的调用。

items.title_en: All Delta Flights Through Atlanta Delayed as Automated System Falters
items.title_zh: 自动化系统故障，所有经亚特兰大中转的达美航班延误
items.summary_en: All Delta flights passing through Atlanta were delayed after an automated system failed. The incident affected flight operations across the Atlanta connection point.
items.summary_zh: 自动化系统发生故障后，所有经亚特兰大中转的达美航班均出现延误。此次事件影响了亚特兰大中转枢纽的航班运行。

items.title_en: Stop Filming in Log?
items.title_zh: 停止拍摄 Log 格式？
items.summary_en: The author argues that log-encoded video can create unnecessary challenges for colorists and is often used because of the mistaken belief that log automatically looks like film. Videographers frequently underexpose log footage while expecting to fix it in post-production, a problem that also affects camera RAW and HDR workflows. The piece traces log video’s rise to ARRI’s Alexa in 2010 and notes that camera RAW had been introduced by RED in 2007.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，Log 编码视频可能给调色师带来不必要的困难，人们使用它往往是因为误以为 Log 天然具有胶片质感。摄像师经常将 Log 素材曝光不足，却指望后期修复；相机 RAW 和 HDR 工作流也存在类似问题。文章指出，Log 视频在 ARRI 于 2010 年推出 Alexa 后开始普及，而 RED 则在 2007 年引入了相机 RAW。

items.title_en: Nyx, the Oldest Internet Service Provider
items.title_zh: Nyx：最古老的互联网服务提供商
items.summary_en: Nyx describes itself as the world's oldest Internet Service Provider and offers free public access. Its services include email, web space and hosting, an uncensored Usenet feed, Linux shell accounts, and Unix/Linux development tools.
items.summary_zh: Nyx 自称是世界上最古老的互联网服务提供商，并提供免费的公共接入服务。其服务包括电子邮件、网页空间与托管、未审查的 Usenet 新闻源、Linux Shell 账户，以及 Unix/Linux 编程开发工具。

items.title_en: Jolt – Clojure that speaks C
items.title_zh: Jolt：会说 C 语言的 Clojure
items.summary_en: Jolt is a Clojure implementation on Scheme, using Chez natively and Gambit for JavaScript, with a Clojure-compatible standard library and no JVM. It can bind C shared libraries and expose libraries such as SQLite, Postgres, OpenSSL, and zlib. Its ahead-of-time compiler produces a self-contained executable with C dependencies linked statically.
items.summary_zh: Jolt 是构建在 Scheme 之上的 Clojure 实现，原生使用 Chez，并通过 Gambit 支持 JavaScript；它提供兼容 Clojure 的标准库且不依赖 JVM。它可以绑定 C 共享库，并以此接入 SQLite、Postgres、OpenSSL 和 zlib 等库。其提前编译器能够生成单一的自包含可执行文件，并静态链接 C 依赖。

items.title_en: The Magic of Partial Evaluation
items.title_zh: 部分求值的魔力
items.summary_en: The essay presents partial evaluation as an elegant idea in software and programming languages. It focuses on concepts that reveal the nature of programming languages, even when they have limited practical use. The author frames solving problems at the programming-language level as a way to address entire classes of problems rather than one case at a time.
items.summary_zh: 文章将部分求值视为软件和编程语言领域中优美而有吸引力的概念。它关注那些能够揭示编程语言本质的思想，即使这些思想未必具有直接的实用价值。作者认为，在编程语言层面解决问题，意味着处理整个问题类别，而不是只解决某一个具体案例。

items.title_en: Who Builds the Machines That Build the Machines?
items.title_zh: 谁来制造制造机器的机器？
items.summary_en: The United States imports half of its $11.4 billion machine-tool market. It considers what Section 232 could mean for five-axis machines, grinders, and gear machines, as well as the question of who could build them domestically.
items.summary_zh: 文章考察了实体 AI 供应链中的瓶颈，重点关注美国机床产业。美国机床市场规模为 114 亿美元，其中一半依赖进口。内容讨论了《232 条款》可能对五轴机床、磨床和齿轮机床产生的影响，以及美国国内能否制造这些设备。

items.title_en: A quest to create the perfect whiskey glass
items.title_zh: 打造完美威士忌酒杯的探索
items.summary_en: Austrian designer Kurt Josef Zalto has created the No. 11 whiskey glass for Josephinenhütte after three years of research. The design aims to prevent alcohol from overpowering the whiskey’s aroma. Zalto grew up accompanying his fifth-generation glassmaker father in the workshop.
items.summary_zh: 奥地利设计师 Kurt Josef Zalto 为 Josephinenhütte 设计了 No. 11 威士忌酒杯，历时三年研究。该设计旨在避免酒精气味压过威士忌的香气。Zalto 从小便跟随家族第五代玻璃工匠父亲进入工坊。

items.title_en: Winudf – DVD / BluRay driver for DOS, Windows 1.x – 3x / 95 / 98 / ME
items.title_zh: Winudf：适用于 DOS、Windows 1.x–3.x、95、98、ME 的 DVD/Blu-ray 驱动
items.summary_en: WINUDF is an installable file-system driver that lets DOS and early Windows systems read and write UDF media. It supports UDF versions 1.02 through 2.60, including DVDs, Blu-ray discs, packet-written CDs, and UDF-formatted USB drives. DOS and Windows 1.0x–3.11 receive drive letters through WINUDF.EXE, while WINUDF.VXD provides a long-name file-system driver for Windows 95, 98, and ME.
items.summary_zh: WINUDF 是一种可安装文件系统驱动，让 DOS 和早期 Windows 系统能够读写 UDF 媒体。它支持 1.02 至 2.60 版 UDF，涵盖 DVD、蓝光光盘、包写入 CD 以及采用 UDF 格式的 USB 驱动器。DOS 和 Windows 1.0x–3.11 可通过 WINUDF.EXE 获得盘符，Windows 95、98 和 ME 则使用支持长文件名的 WINUDF.VXD 驱动。

items.title_en: Notes on the discrete Fourier transform (DFT)
items.title_zh: 离散傅里叶变换（DFT）笔记
items.summary_en: The notes move from Fourier series and transforms for infinite-duration discrete signals to realistic digital signal processing with finite-duration signals. They introduce the discrete Fourier transform by considering a signal represented as a list of N samples.
items.summary_zh: 这篇笔记从用于无限时长离散信号的傅里叶级数和变换，转向处理有限时长信号的现实数字信号处理。文章通过将信号表示为包含 N 个样本的数列，引入离散傅里叶变换。

items.title_en: Nespresso's project to reduce grams of coffee per capsule
items.title_zh: Nespresso 减少每粒胶囊咖啡克数的项目
items.summary_en: Documents appear to suggest possible formula improvements, although the author questions how that could work while using less coffee.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍了 Nespresso 的内部“奥林匹斯计划”，目标是减少每粒胶囊中的咖啡用量。相关文件似乎暗示可能通过改进配方实现这一目标，但作者质疑在减少咖啡用量的同时如何做到这一点。

items.title_en: Michael Mann's 'Heat' Copyright Fight Turns on a Deal with Himself
items.title_zh: 迈克尔·曼的《盗火线》版权之争，焦点在于他与自己的公司达成的协议
items.summary_en: New Regency argues that Michael Mann cannot reclaim rights to “Heat” because he wrote it for his own company. Mann counters that he wrote the early drafts independently rather than as an employee of his loan-out company. The dispute therefore turns on how those early drafts and the corporate relationship are legally characterized.
items.summary_zh: New Regency 认为，迈克尔·曼不能收回《盗火线》的版权，因为他是为自己的公司创作这部作品的。曼则表示，早期剧本是他独立创作的，并非作为其借出公司员工完成。争议因此取决于这些早期稿件及公司关系在法律上应如何认定。

items.title_en: Purism Launches Librem 5 v2, a RISC-V Phone to Empower People
items.title_zh: Purism 推出 Librem 5 v2：一款旨在赋予用户自主权的 RISC-V 手机
items.summary_en: Purism announced its second smartphone crowdfunding campaign for the Librem 5 v2. The next-generation phone is powered by open-source software and is designed as an alternative to major technology companies' smartphone ecosystems. The announcement describes it as the successor to Purism's flagship smartphone. The campaign was announced in San Francisco on November 17, 2026.
items.summary_zh: Purism 宣布为 Librem 5 v2 发起第二次智能手机众筹活动。这款新一代手机采用开源软件，定位是大型科技公司智能手机生态的替代方案。公告将其描述为 Purism 旗舰手机的后继产品。众筹活动于 2026 年 11 月 17 日在旧金山宣布。

items.title_en: Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data Leaked by Hackers
items.title_zh: 黑客泄露 Visa、万事达卡和摩根大通客户数据
items.summary_en: Hackers leaked customer data from Visa, Mastercard, and JPMorgan.
items.summary_zh: 黑客泄露了 Visa、万事达卡和摩根大通的客户数据。

items.title_en: Google Chrome dev team declares bug report bankruptcy (2012)
items.title_zh: Google Chrome 开发团队宣布 Bug 报告破产（2012）
items.summary_en: A 2012 item describes the Google Chrome development team declaring “bug report bankruptcy.” It appears in a broader archive of technology and programming notes.
items.summary_zh: 一篇 2012 年的内容描述了 Google Chrome 开发团队宣布“Bug 报告破产”。该内容收录于一个更广泛的技术与编程笔记档案中。

items.title_en: OpenAI still has a WebRTC Problem
items.title_zh: OpenAI 仍面临 WebRTC 问题
items.summary_en: The piece argues that WebRTC can cause voice AI systems to lose parts of what users say, leading to requests to repeat themselves. It contrasts this behavior with Media over QUIC, or MoQ, and follows earlier criticism of OpenAI's use of WebRTC. WebRTC specialists at OpenAI subsequently contacted the author.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，WebRTC 可能导致语音 AI 丢失用户说话的部分内容，从而频繁要求用户重复。文章将这一行为与 Media over QUIC（MoQ）进行对比，并延续了作者此前对 OpenAI 使用 WebRTC 的批评。OpenAI 的 WebRTC 专家随后联系了作者。

items.title_en: PostgreSQL 19 Released
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 19 发布
items.summary_en: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group has released PostgreSQL 19, the latest major version of the open-source database. It adds REPACK (CONCURRENTLY) for optimizing tables without disrupting ongoing operations and the pg_plan_advice extension for controlling plan stability and query performance. Other features include read-your-writes consistency on standbys and get-or-create behavior that avoids a network round trip.
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 全球开发组发布了 PostgreSQL 19，这是该开源数据库的最新主要版本。新版本加入 REPACK (CONCURRENTLY)，可在不中断运行中操作的情况下优化表，并提供用于控制计划稳定性和查询性能的 pg_plan_advice 扩展。其他功能包括备用节点上的读后写一致性，以及可省去一次网络往返的“获取或创建”行为。

items.title_en: And yet, it moves
items.title_zh: 然而，它在运动
items.summary_en: The author reacts to the apparent claim that Anthropic has solved the Riemann Hypothesis. The discussion begins with the author’s account of seeing a Broadway musical about Galileo, which is described as a rock-oriented historical production with modern-style songs. The excerpt specifically praises its actors, including Joy Woods and Jeremy Kushnier.
items.summary_zh: 作者回应了 Anthropic 似乎解决黎曼猜想的说法。文章先讲述作者观看一部关于伽利略的百老汇音乐剧的经历，并将其描述为一部采用摇滚风格现代歌曲的历史题材作品。节选中特别称赞了 Joy Woods 和 Jeremy Kushnier 等演员。

items.title_en: When AI Knows More Than It Can Offer
items.title_zh: 当 AI 知道得比它能提供的更多
items.summary_en: It frames training as a process that can turn an intelligent assistant into a generator.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了 AI 系统可能掌握的知识与其作为助手能够提供的内容之间的差距。文章将训练描述为一种可能把智能助手变成生成器的过程。

items.title_en: GL.iNet Security Notice 2026-11-20
items.title_zh: GL.iNet 安全通告（2026-11-20）
items.summary_en: On November 20, 2026, GL.iNet identified a vulnerability in its cloud-based remote-management services. An unauthorized party exploited it to access and install malicious software on some GL.iNet routers and KVM devices.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 20 日，GL.iNet 发现其云端远程管理服务存在漏洞。未经授权的一方利用该漏洞访问了部分 GL.iNet 路由器和 KVM 设备，并安装了恶意软件。

items.title_en: Why did modems have speakers? (2019)
items.title_zh: 调制解调器为什么会配备扬声器？（2019）
items.summary_en: The piece asks why modems had speakers.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨调制解调器过去为何配备扬声器。

items.title_en: Launch HN: StarSling (YC P25) – Self-improving CI for agent-volume repos
items.title_zh: Show HN：StarSling（YC P25）——面向代理规模仓库的自我改进 CI
items.summary_en: StarSling offers GitHub Actions runners with AI agents that create pull requests to improve tests and workflows. Each CI job runs in an ephemeral sandbox on Zen 5 machines with NVMe storage and supports concurrent agent jobs. The team reports reducing Mastra's slowest workflow from 29 minutes 56 seconds to 5 minutes 6 seconds, and making a better-auth test job 5.4 times faster. Its agents are designed to lower CI costs over time by continuously improving workflows.
items.summary_zh: StarSling 提供带有 AI 代理的 GitHub Actions runner，代理会创建拉取请求来改进测试和工作流。每个 CI 任务都在配备 Zen 5 处理器和 NVMe 存储的临时沙箱中运行，并支持并发代理任务。团队称，他们将 Mastra 最慢的工作流从 29 分 56 秒缩短到 5 分 6 秒，并让 better-auth 的一个测试任务提速 5.4 倍。其代理旨在通过持续改进工作流，逐步降低 CI 成本。

items.title_en: Test/verification technique effectiveness with Astra
items.title_zh: 使用 Astra 测试/验证技术的有效性
items.summary_en: An earlier evaluation found that GPT-5.6 Sol often produced caricatures of requested techniques such as TDD, QuickCheck, and Lean 4. In that test, asking for no specific method produced many poor unit tests but still performed better than explicitly requiring most named techniques. The rerun with GPT-6 Astra showed two major differences, though the supplied excerpt does not specify what they were.
items.summary_zh: 此前的评测发现，GPT-5.6 Sol 经常把 TDD、QuickCheck 和 Lean 4 等指定技术执行成形式化的“模仿品”。在那次测试中，不指定具体方法虽然会产生许多糟糕的单元测试，但表现仍优于明确要求使用多数特定技术。使用 GPT-6 Astra 重跑评测后出现了两项重大差异，但所给内容未说明具体差异。

items.title_en: Show HN: The Riemann Proof Handbook
items.title_zh: Show HN：《黎曼证明手册》
items.summary_en: The Riemann Handbook presents the Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis from the tamnd/riemann-lean project in mathematical prose, with definitions, theorems, lemmas, and proofs. It is available as a PDF and EPUB book. The claim has not been checked: the full Lean project has not been built, and the written statements have not been verified against the code.
items.summary_zh: 《黎曼证明手册》将 tamnd/riemann-lean 项目中的黎曼猜想 Lean 证明，以包含定义、定理、引理和证明的数学文字形式呈现。该书提供 PDF 和 EPUB 版本。但其中的数学主张尚未经过验证：完整 Lean 项目还没有构建成功，书面陈述也未与代码逐一核对。

items.title_en: I can’t believe it’s 1
items.title_zh: 我简直不敢相信它是 1！
items.summary_en: At this year’s MathsJam Gathering, the author gave a five-minute talk about the number 1. A recording of the talk is available, along with a written version intended to provide more time to examine the material.
items.summary_zh: 作者在今年的 MathsJam Gathering 上做了一场关于数字 1 的五分钟演讲。演讲提供了录音，作者还撰写了文字版，方便读者用更多时间阅读其中内容。

items.title_en: Mini.nvim Is Now on Tangled
items.title_zh: Mini.nvim 现已登陆 Tangled
items.summary_en: Mini.nvim is a library of more than 45 independent Lua modules for improving the Neovim experience with minimal effort. The modules target Neovim 0.10 and later and share common configuration approaches and design principles.
items.summary_zh: Mini.nvim 是一个包含 45 个以上独立 Lua 模块的库，旨在以尽可能少的配置改善 Neovim 使用体验。这些模块面向 Neovim 0.10 及更高版本，并采用统一的配置方式和设计原则。

items.title_en: Why Fibonacci?
items.title_zh: 为什么是斐波那契？
items.summary_en: Interactive animations explain why a Fermat spiral can work better than a grid or rings, why the relevant angle is 137.508 degrees, and where Fibonacci numbers enter the construction. The project grew out of the author's work creating Fibonacci-inspired LED designs. It also draws on an explanation of the golden angle used in the Halo Pixel project.
items.summary_zh: 互动动画解释了为什么费马螺线可能优于网格或同心环、相关角度为何是 137.508 度，以及斐波那契数列在构造中从何而来。这个项目源于作者设计受斐波那契启发的 LED 作品。作者也参考了 Halo Pixel 项目对黄金角的解释。

items.title_en: Palo Alto Networks to Acquire Applied Compute for $4.5B
items.title_zh: Palo Alto Networks 将以 45 亿美元收购 Applied Compute
items.summary_en: Palo Alto Networks plans to acquire Applied Compute for $4.5 billion.
items.summary_zh: Palo Alto Networks 计划以 45 亿美元收购 Applied Compute。

items.title_en: Cuttlefish on Mac: Android's Virtual Device Framework on Apple Silicon
items.title_zh: 在 Mac 上运行 Cuttlefish：Apple Silicon 上的 Android 虚拟设备框架
items.summary_en: Meta’s Reality Labs brought Android’s Cuttlefish and its QEMU backend to macOS and Apple silicon. The work is intended to improve development and testing for non-phone Android devices without relying on scarce physical hardware. Higher-fidelity virtual devices can expose bugs that lightweight emulators such as Goldfish may miss.
items.summary_zh: Meta Reality Labs 将 Android 的 Cuttlefish 及其 QEMU 后端移植到了 macOS 和 Apple Silicon。该项目旨在为非手机 Android 设备提供更好的开发和测试环境，减少对稀缺实体硬件的依赖。更高保真度的虚拟设备能够发现轻量级模拟器 Goldfish 可能遗漏的错误。

items.title_en: How to Make the Ink Used to Write Hamlet and the Declaration of Independence
items.title_zh: 如何制作《哈姆雷特》和《独立宣言》所用的墨水
items.summary_en: A recipe from the UK National Archives, written around 1483, explains how to make the ink used for works including the Magna Carta, Hamlet, and the Declaration of Independence. It calls for gall, copperas or vitriol, gum, and water, with the ingredients prepared and stirred over a period of two weeks.
items.summary_zh: 英国国家档案馆保存的一份约写于 1483 年的配方，介绍了用于《大宪章》《哈姆雷特》和《独立宣言》等作品的墨水制作方法。配方需要没食子、绿矾或硫酸盐、树胶和水，并要求将原料处理后搅拌约两周。

items.title_en: Mass launched to orbit each year by rocket builder
items.title_zh: 火箭制造商每年发射入轨的质量
items.summary_en: SpaceX's Falcon rockets carried 2,330 tonnes to orbit in 2025, representing 81% of the world's total, while all other rockets combined carried 537 tonnes. From January through November 14, 2026, SpaceX carried another 1,683 tonnes, more than all European-built rockets have carried since 1965. The figures compare annual orbital payloads across major regions and launch providers.
items.summary_zh: SpaceX 的猎鹰火箭在 2025 年将 2330 吨载荷送入轨道，占全球总量的 81%；其他所有火箭合计运送了 537 吨。2026 年 1 月至 11 月 14 日，SpaceX 又运送了 1683 吨，超过欧洲制造火箭自 1965 年以来的累计运载量。相关数据比较了主要地区和发射商每年的入轨载荷。

items.title_en: Logitech Harmony IR code online database archive
items.title_zh: Logitech Harmony 红外码在线数据库存档
