items.summary_en: This archive collects the infrared codes and protocol formats used by Logitech Harmony remotes and hubs. The maintainer says AI was used extensively to create the archive.
items.summary_zh: 该存档收集了 Logitech Harmony 遥控器和集线器使用的红外代码及协议格式。维护者表示，创建这一存档时大量使用了 AI。

items.title_en: Artificial Intelligence for the Z80
items.title_zh: 面向 Z80 的人工智能
items.summary_en: This project teaches AI by implementing algorithms, data structures, and neural networks from scratch in BASIC. It uses 8-bit computers such as the Z80, the Spectrum, and the Spectrum Next as a practical laboratory for exploring AI concepts and history.
items.summary_zh: 该项目通过用 BASIC 从头实现算法、数据和神经网络来学习人工智能。它将 Z80、Spectrum 和 Spectrum Next 等 8 位计算机作为实践实验室，用于探索 AI 的概念与发展历史。

items.title_en: A US Federal Women's Prison Became a "Rape Club"
items.title_zh: 一所美国联邦女子监狱变成了“强奸俱乐部”
items.summary_en: Insiders say a culture of impunity remains at the women’s prison, allowing officers to prey on inmates even after some abusers were prosecuted or removed. One woman described the prison as having become a “hunting ground.” The account also describes Officer Felix Wilder moving through the prison as if he owned it.
items.summary_zh: 知情人士称，尽管部分施害者已被起诉或清除，这所女子监狱中纵容狱警侵害囚犯的有罪不罚文化仍然存在。一名女性称，这所监狱已经变成了“猎场”。报道还描述了狱警 Felix Wilder 在监狱中趾高气扬、仿佛一切都属于他的情形。

items.title_en: Elephant-Goldfish Model
items.title_zh: Elephant-Goldfish Model
items.summary_en: Elephant-Goldfish Model is an open-source plugin for AI assistants that helps users develop ideas with contextual background. A user can create a plan with an assistant that knows the conversation, then have reviewers who did not see that conversation assess what is missing or unclear. The design separates context-rich planning from fresh review.
items.summary_zh: Elephant-Goldfish Model 是一个面向 AI 助手的开源插件，帮助用户在保留背景信息的情况下构思想法。用户可以让了解完整对话的助手制定计划，再交由未看过该对话的审阅者检查遗漏或含糊之处。其设计将充分利用上下文的规划与独立审查分开。

items.title_en: How Billions in Safe Insurance Money Is Being Bet on A.I. Debt
items.title_zh: 数十亿美元的安全保险资金正押注于 AI 债务
items.summary_en: Insurance companies are investing billions of dollars of customers’ money in AI-related deals as analysts warn of growing risks. One example involves Elon Musk’s team creating a financial entity to borrow billions to buy AI chips and lease them back to xAI. Because xAI was not technically the borrower, the arrangement made its reported debt appear smaller to investors.
items.summary_zh: 保险公司正将客户资金中的数十亿美元投入 AI 相关交易，而分析师警告风险正在增加。一个例子是，埃隆·马斯克的团队设立金融实体，借款数十亿美元购买 AI 芯片，再将芯片回租给 xAI。由于 xAI 在技术上并非借款方，这种安排使其向投资者呈现的债务规模显得更小。

items.title_en: Mem Is Shutting Down
items.title_zh: Mem 即将关闭
items.summary_en: Mem has decided to shut down on January 15, 2027. The announcement covers key dates, subscription handling, and how users can move their notes. The company thanked users for entrusting it with ideas, meeting notes, drafts, and other personal information.
items.summary_zh: Mem 决定于 2027 年 1 月 15 日关闭。公告说明了重要日期、订阅处理方式，以及用户如何迁移笔记。公司感谢用户将想法、会议记录、草稿和其他个人信息托付给它。

items.title_en: Effects of a Nuclear Detonation in Low Earth Orbit
items.title_zh: 低地球轨道核爆炸的影响
items.summary_en: A study modeled the effects of a 1-megaton nuclear detonation at 500 kilometers over the South Atlantic. In its central case, trapped radioactive electrons would disable about 98% of modeled low-Earth-orbit satellites within one week, while roughly 97% would remain disabled after two weeks under a higher radiation-tolerance assumption. The loss of maneuverability could lead to about 20 collisions within two years, with debris and radiation continuing to affect replacement satellites. The model indicates that one detonation could severely damage orbital infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 一项研究模拟了在南大西洋上空 500 公里处引爆一枚 1 兆吨核武器的影响。在其中间情景下，被困在地球磁场中的放射性电子会在一周内使约 98% 的模拟低地球轨道卫星失效；即使提高卫星的辐射耐受度，两周后仍约有 97% 失效。卫星失去机动能力可能在两年内造成约 20 次碰撞，辐射和碎片还会持续影响替代卫星。模型显示，一次核爆炸就可能严重破坏轨道基础设施。

items.title_en: iCloud, App Store, and other Apple services hit by ongoing outage
items.title_zh: iCloud、App Store 等 Apple 服务持续中断
items.summary_en: Users reported connection failures and sign-in problems across iCloud, the App Store, and other Apple services. Downdetector showed reports affecting multiple services. Apple's System Status page continued to list the services as available despite the user reports.
items.summary_zh: 用户报告 iCloud、App Store 和其他 Apple 服务出现连接失败及登录问题。Downdetector 显示多个服务均有故障报告。尽管用户持续反馈，Apple 的系统状态页面仍将这些服务列为可用。

items.title_en: Deterministic Simulation Testing Is for Everyone
items.title_zh: 确定性模拟测试适用于所有人
items.summary_en: The post makes the case for deterministic simulation testing as a general-purpose testing technique. It challenges the view that the method is mainly useful for distributed systems and argues that it can apply to all applications. The discussion places the technique within the broader question of why software teams use automated testing.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张将确定性模拟测试作为一种通用测试技术。它反驳了这种方法主要适用于分布式系统的看法，认为它可以应用于所有类型的应用。文章还将这一技术放在软件团队为何使用自动化测试这一更广泛的问题中讨论。

items.title_en: Muru – AI-assisted Rust server for Python apps by mod_WSGI's creator
items.title_zh: Muru：由 mod_wsgi 创作者打造的 AI 辅助 Python 应用 Rust 服务器
items.summary_en: Graham Dumpleton, who started mod_wsgi 20 years ago, has created Muru, an AI-assisted server written in Rust. It aims to provide tools for running Python ASGI and WSGI applications in both development and production.
items.summary_zh: 20 年前启动 mod_wsgi 的 Graham Dumpleton 开发了 Muru，这是一个由 Rust 编写、具备 AI 辅助功能的服务器。它旨在为 Python 的 ASGI 和 WSGI 应用提供开发与生产环境所需的运行工具。

items.title_en: Human.md
items.title_zh: Human.md
items.summary_en: Human.md is presented as a working manifesto about what humans contribute as machines become increasingly capable. It reflects on the difference between surface-level taste and the deeper judgment behind it. The text leaves open whether that human capability can ever be replicated by models.
items.summary_zh: Human.md 是一份关于机器日益强大之后人类仍能带来什么的工作中的宣言。它思考了表层的“品味”与其背后更深层判断力之间的差异。文章没有断言这种人类能力是否永远无法被模型复制。

items.title_en: Microsoft announces Windows Server 2028 with hardened security
items.title_zh: 微软宣布 Windows Server 2028，强化默认安全配置
items.summary_en: Microsoft announced Windows Server 2028 at the Ignite 2026 conference. The release uses a hardened Server Core configuration by default and introduces a new security baseline that allows administrators to relax individual settings. Microsoft says the defaults reduce the work needed to establish a secure baseline from the first day.
items.summary_zh: 微软在 Ignite 2026 大会上宣布了 Windows Server 2028。该版本默认采用强化的 Server Core 配置，并引入新的安全基线，允许管理员放宽个别设置。微软表示，这些默认配置将减少从第一天开始建立安全基线所需的工作量。

items.title_en: Gemini 4 Neon looks like an Opus 5.5 competitor
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Neon 似乎是 Opus 5.5 的竞争者
items.summary_en: An analysis projects that Gemini 4 Neon could perform roughly on par with Opus 5.5, based on the expected performance of a faster Gemini 4 Carbon. Gemini 4 Carbon leads the Agent Duel leaderboard when early votes are excluded, but its main weakness is speed. Neon was observed at about 127 tokens per second, compared with Carbon’s 46 tokens per second.
items.summary_zh: 一项分析根据更快版本 Gemini 4 Carbon 的预期表现推测，Gemini 4 Neon 的性能可能大致相当于 Opus 5.5。排除早期投票后，Gemini 4 Carbon 位居 Agent Duel 排行榜首位，但主要问题是速度较慢。据观察，Neon 的生成速度约为每秒 127 个 token，而 Carbon 为每秒 46 个。

items.title_en: The first ping from Tonga (1997)
items.title_zh: 来自汤加的第一次 Ping（1997）
items.summary_en: In January 1997, Tonga established a permanent internet connection and successfully sent and received a ping over a 64 kbps satellite link. The connection relied on secondhand hardware, improvised networks, a microwave link to the Crown Prince's villa, and unauthorized rooftop climbing. Before then, international calls were costly because Cable & Wireless held a monopoly on telecommunications.
items.summary_zh: 1997 年 1 月，汤加通过 64 kbps 的卫星链路建立了永久互联网连接，并成功发出和收到一个 Ping。此次连接依靠二手硬件、临时搭建的网络、通往王储别墅的微波链路，以及未经授权爬上屋顶等方式完成。在此之前，Cable & Wireless 垄断电信业务，国际电话费用十分高昂。

items.title_en: C++26 is done (again): November 2026 ISO C++ meeting trip report
items.title_zh: C++26 再次完成：2026 年 11 月 ISO C++ 会议报告
items.summary_en: The ISO C++ committee completed the technical work on C++26 for a second time after the standard's approval ballot was sent back with international comments. Most of the six-day meeting addressed those comments, especially changes to the contracts feature. The updated document is expected to enter a second approval ballot.
items.summary_zh: ISO C++ 委员会在标准批准投票因国际意见被退回后，第二次完成了 C++26 的技术工作。为期六天的会议主要处理这些意见，尤其是关于 contracts 特性的修改。更新后的文档预计将进入第二轮批准投票。

items.title_en: Simple 8085 Computer
items.title_zh: 简单的 8085 计算机
items.summary_en: This project builds a simple 8-bit computer around the Intel 8085, running at 4.9 MHz with 8 KB each of ROM and RAM. It includes a small BASIC interpreter, a monitor program, and one I/O port for interfacing.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目围绕 Intel 8085 构建了一台运行频率为 4.9 MHz 的简单 8 位计算机，配备各 8 KB 的 ROM 和 RAM。它内置精简版 BASIC、监控程序，以及一个用于连接外设的 I/O 端口。

items.title_en: Split Radiance Cascades
items.title_zh: 拆分式 Radiance Cascades
items.summary_en: The article explains how to implement 3D global illumination with split radiance cascades. It focuses on ray splitting, a recent technique that adapts radiance cascades to 3D without imposing huge computational costs. The discussion includes implementation guidance and code examples, though the examples were modified for clarity and may not work unchanged.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍如何使用拆分式 Radiance Cascades 实现 3D 全局光照。重点是光线分裂这一新技术，它可以在不带来巨大计算成本的情况下，将 Radiance Cascades 应用于 3D。文章还提供实现说明和代码示例，但示例为便于理解经过修改，可能无法直接运行。

items.title_en: Fewer slides, more dragons
items.title_zh: 少一些幻灯片，多一些龙
items.summary_en: The piece describes what happened when its author stopped making slides.
items.summary_zh: 作者讲述了自己停止制作幻灯片之后发生的事情。

items.title_en: Testing Terraform with AWS Emulator
items.title_zh: 使用 AWS Emulator 测试 Terraform
items.summary_en: AWS's new Emulator is presented as a way to emulate actual AWS API endpoints and expose problems that static plans and limited mock calls cannot detect.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了 Terraform 计划可以成功、但在真实 AWS 基础设施上执行 apply 仍会失败的原因。AWS 新推出的 Emulator 被介绍为一种模拟真实 AWS API 端点的工具，可发现静态计划和有限模拟调用无法检测的问题。

items.title_en: Anthropic Paid Rubio's Ex-Chief of Staff's Firm $740k.it Lobbied His NSC
items.title_zh: Anthropic 向 Rubio 前幕僚长的公司支付 74 万美元，该公司曾游说其国家安全委员会
items.summary_en: Anthropic paid lobbying firm Continental Strategy $740,000 since April 2025, according to federal disclosures cited in the report. The firm's managing partner is Marco Rubio's former Senate chief of staff, and its filings list the National Security Council and State Department as offices it lobbied. Anthropic paid two lobbying firms connected to Rubio's political network a combined $1.63 million during that period. Rubio serves as both national security adviser and secretary of state.
items.summary_zh: 根据报道引用的联邦披露文件，Anthropic 自 2025 年 4 月以来向游说公司 Continental Strategy 支付了 74 万美元。该公司的华盛顿管理合伙人曾任马可·卢比奥的参议院幕僚长，其申报文件显示公司曾游说国家安全委员会和国务院。同期，Anthropic 向两家与卢比奥政治网络有关的游说公司合计支付了 163 万美元。卢比奥同时担任国家安全顾问和国务卿。

items.title_en: S. Korea to send nationwide emergency alerts over college entrance exam cheating
items.title_zh: 韩国将针对高考作弊发送全国紧急警报
items.summary_en: South Korea will send nationwide emergency alerts over cheating during the college entrance examination.
items.summary_zh: 韩国将因大学入学考试作弊问题发送全国性紧急警报。

items.title_en: The Fossils That Haunted Lovecraft
items.title_zh: 困扰洛夫克拉夫特的化石
items.summary_en: In 1923, expeditions led by Roy Chapman Andrews returned from Mongolia’s Gobi Desert with large quantities of fossils, including fossilized eggs from the Flaming Cliffs. Newspapers described the eggs as the first dinosaur eggs ever discovered, and the American Museum of Natural History took them for the eggs of a dinosaur. The discovery became part of the fossil history associated with H. P. Lovecraft’s era.
items.summary_zh: 1923 年，Roy Chapman Andrews 率领的考察队从蒙古戈壁沙漠带回了大量化石，其中包括来自火焰崖的蛋化石。报纸将这些蛋描述为人类发现的首批恐龙蛋，美国自然历史博物馆也将其认定为恐龙蛋。这一发现成为洛夫克拉夫特所处时代化石史的一部分。

items.title_en: The Where's Waldo of the 1500s
items.title_zh: 1500 年代的“寻找沃尔多”
items.summary_en: The piece is a deep dive into the hidden owl artwork of Herri met de Bles. It begins with the author's visit to Italian museums and a growing interest in lesser-known details beyond the famous works on display.
items.summary_zh: 文章深入探讨了 Herri met de Bles 作品中隐藏的猫头鹰图案。内容从作者参观意大利博物馆写起，并转向对名作之外那些不太知名细节的兴趣。

items.title_en: Bit Shifting in Basic
items.title_zh: Basic 中的位移
items.summary_en: The author created a program to generate shifted frames for 8×8 graphics characters on the Commodore VIC-20. Instead of editing every character position manually, the approach defines one character and uses bit shifting to produce the other offset frames. The project was motivated by designing graphics for two-character blocks.
items.summary_zh: 作者编写了一个程序，为 Commodore VIC-20 上的 8×8 图形字符生成位移帧。与其手动编辑每个字符位置，不如先定义一个字符，再利用位移操作生成其他偏移帧。这个项目源于为双字符块设计图形的需求。

items.title_en: Can Peer Review Survive AI-Generated Text? [pdf]
items.title_zh: 同行评审能否经受 AI 生成文本？
items.summary_en: The piece asks whether peer review can withstand the growing use of AI-generated text. It focuses on the implications of AI-written material for the process of evaluating scholarly work.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨同行评审能否应对日益增多的 AI 生成文本。它关注 AI 撰写的材料会如何影响学术作品的评估过程。

items.title_en: C's designated initializers give us named arguments
items.title_zh: C 语言的指定初始化器为我们带来了命名参数
items.summary_en: The piece demonstrates how C's full-power designated initializers can be used to create a pattern resembling named arguments. It contrasts this capability with C++'s more limited form of designated initializers and builds on a pattern discussed in a 2014 book on C.
items.summary_zh: 文章演示了如何利用 C 语言功能完整的指定初始化器，构造出类似命名参数的编程模式。作者将这一能力与 C++ 中功能更受限的指定初始化器进行对比，并介绍了一个源自 2014 年 C 语言书籍的模式。

items.title_en: The Usefulness of Useless Knowledge [pdf] (1939)
items.title_zh: 《无用知识的用处》（1939）[PDF]
items.summary_en: The 1939 work is titled “The Usefulness of Useless Knowledge.” It is available as a PDF.
items.summary_zh: 这部 1939 年的作品题为《无用知识的用处》。该作品以 PDF 形式提供。

items.title_en: Mosquitoes are Ladakh's latest tourists
items.title_zh: 蚊子成了拉达克最新的游客
items.summary_en: In Ladakh’s Leh district, climate change, failing public systems, shrinking livelihoods, and unplanned tourism are combining to increase vulnerability to malaria and dengue. The diseases were previously unknown in the region.
items.summary_zh: 在拉达克列城地区，气候变化、公共系统失灵、生计萎缩和无规划旅游共同增加了当地对疟疾和登革热的脆弱性。这些疾病过去在该地区并不为人所知。

items.title_en: Fascism and Monopoly (2020)
items.title_zh: 法西斯主义与垄断（2020）
items.summary_en: Drawing on business histories and archival material, it finds that German big business generally did not support Hitler before 1933, but extreme market concentration during the Weimar period helped him seize and consolidate totalitarian power.
items.summary_zh: 文章考察工业集中和垄断是否助推了希特勒崛起及第三帝国的侵略。根据企业史和档案材料，文章认为德国大企业在 1933 年前总体上并未支持希特勒，但魏玛时期极端的市场集中帮助他夺取并巩固了极权权力。

items.title_en: Skydio's asymmetrical F10 Lightrunner solves a problem with fixed-wing drones
items.title_zh: Skydio 不对称 F10 Lightrunner 解决固定翼无人机难题
items.summary_en: Skydio’s F10 Lightrunner uses an asymmetrical design and a wingtip-mounted camera to improve aerial vision and reduce blind spots. The autonomously operated, high-speed fixed-wing drone is designed to provide higher-quality video than other fixed-wing drones.
items.summary_zh: Skydio 的 F10 Lightrunner 采用不对称设计和翼尖摄像头，以改善空中视野并减少盲区。这款自主运行的高速固定翼无人机旨在提供高于其他固定翼无人机的视频质量。

items.title_en: It's always DNS, so why are we running our own?
items.title_zh: 总是 DNS 出问题，那我们为什么还要自己运行？
items.summary_en: S2 replaced Route53 with its own authoritative DNS server after deciding to remove a limit of 100 basins per account. Each customer basin becomes a subdomain such as my-basin.b.s2.dev, with a CNAME routing clients to the correct cell. Supporting unlimited basins therefore required the company to support an unlimited number of DNS records.
items.summary_zh: S2 决定取消每个账户 100 个 basin 的限制后，用自建权威 DNS 服务器替换了 Route53。每个客户 basin 都会成为一个子域名，例如 my-basin.b.s2.dev，并通过 CNAME 将客户端路由到正确的架构单元。因此，要支持不限数量的 basin，就必须支持不限数量的 DNS 记录。

items.title_en: Parcel: A desktop mail client for Linux, built with Zig
items.title_zh: Parcel：使用 Zig 构建的 Linux 桌面邮件客户端
items.summary_en: Parcel is a Linux desktop mail client for Gmail and Fastmail. It is built with Zig and siv.
items.summary_zh: Parcel 是一款面向 Linux 桌面的 Gmail 和 Fastmail 邮件客户端。它使用 Zig 和 siv 构建。

items.title_en: The Lasting Influence of John Berger
items.title_zh: 约翰·伯格的持久影响
items.summary_en: John Berger’s television series “Ways of Seeing” popularized a Marxist perspective on art and made him widely known. In his centennial year, his diverse body of work continues to inspire and provoke reactions. Merve Emre’s review of Tom Overton’s biography surveys Berger’s life and his work as an art critic, novelist, and cultural figure.
items.summary_zh: 约翰·伯格的电视系列节目《观看之道》普及了马克思主义艺术观，也让他广为人知。在他诞辰一百周年之际，他多样化的作品仍持续引发启发与争议。Merve Emre 对 Tom Overton 所著传记的评论，回顾了伯格作为艺术评论家、小说家和文化人物的一生及其创作。

items.title_en: Mouse Party
items.title_zh: Mouse Party
items.summary_en: Mouse Party is a free way to watch videos with friends in real time through a web browser. It is designed to work without a web server. The service is presented as a secure, browser-based option for synchronized group viewing.
items.summary_zh: Mouse Party 是一个让用户通过浏览器与朋友实时一起观看视频的免费工具。它的设计无需 Web 服务器即可运行。该服务定位为一种安全的、基于浏览器的同步观看方式。

items.title_en: Automatic Checking of Compiler Correctness with E-Graphs
items.title_zh: 使用 E-Graph 自动检查编译器正确性
items.summary_en: The project concerns automatically checking compiler correctness with E-Graphs. No further details about its implementation, results, or evaluation are established here.
items.summary_zh: 该项目关注使用 E-Graph 自动检查编译器的正确性。现有信息未说明其实现方式、结果或评估情况。

items.title_en: Show HN: An API for word timestamps from speech, 75% within 20ms
items.title_zh: Show HN：语音词级时间戳 API，75% 的结果误差在 20 毫秒内
items.summary_en: Yarn has built Quebec, an API that produces word-level timestamps from speech for video editing. Its decoder restricts each word to within 200 milliseconds of rough timings, and a small CNN based on Whisper Tiny’s first two layers adjusts boundaries by up to 50 milliseconds. The team reports that 75% of timestamps fall within 20 milliseconds of the target.
items.summary_zh: Yarn 开发了 Quebec，这是一个面向视频编辑的语音词级时间戳 API。其解码器将每个词限制在粗略时间点前后 200 毫秒内，并使用基于 Whisper Tiny 前两层的小型 CNN，将词边界调整最多 50 毫秒。团队称，75% 的时间戳误差在 20 毫秒以内。

items.title_en: IPv6 delegation, an unusually subtle failure mode
items.title_zh: IPv6 前缀委派：一种异常微妙的故障模式
items.summary_en: The author found that reconfiguring a WAN connection caused IPv6 to fail on a custom home network. Restarting pppd left Google reachable by DNS but not by network connection, leading to an investigation of router advertisements and RA daemons. The investigation ended with odhcpd, a daemon designed for home networks behind unreliable ISPs.
items.summary_zh: 作者发现，重新配置 WAN 连接会导致其定制家庭网络中的 IPv6 失效。重启 pppd 后，Google 仍能解析，但无法实际连接，于是作者开始调查路由器通告和 RA 守护进程。最终，调查转向了专为不稳定 ISP 背后的家庭网络设计的 odhcpd。

items.summary_en: PHP 8.5.13 is a release of PHP, the general-purpose programming language used by websites and other software.
items.summary_zh: PHP 8.5.13 是 PHP 的一个发行版本。PHP 是一种通用编程语言，被网站和其他软件广泛使用。

items.title_en: Assume People Are Not Interested in Your Blog Post
items.title_zh: 假设没人对你的博客文章感兴趣
items.summary_en: The advice is to write for the reader and state at the beginning who the material is for. An example from Snowflake describes emails that immediately tell people outside the relevant code area or finance organization that they can stop reading.
items.summary_zh: 文章建议以读者为中心写作，并在开头明确内容面向哪些人。作者以 Snowflake 的做法为例：邮件第一句就告诉不负责相关代码或不属于财务部门的人可以停止阅读。

items.title_en: Inside PyPy: First Contact with RPython
items.title_zh: 深入 PyPy：首次接触 RPython
items.summary_en: The author describes repeatedly wanting to implement a programming language but struggling to find a suitable implementation language. Instead of building a new language toolchain, the author turns to modifying an existing implementation and introduces established tools for building fast language implementations.
items.summary_zh: 作者描述了自己反复想实现一门编程语言，却总找不到合适实现语言的经历。作者最终没有构建全新的语言工具链，而是转向修改现有实现，并介绍了用于构建高性能语言实现的成熟工具。

items.title_en: How to Intercept HTTP/3 Traffic: QUIC and Qpack
items.title_zh: 如何拦截 HTTP/3 流量：QUIC 与 QPACK
items.summary_en: HTTP/3 runs over QUIC and UDP, so conventional HTTP proxies built around TCP do not see its traffic. Interception requires a proxy that can relay UDP and act as a man in the middle for QUIC, after which requests can be examined as QPACK-compressed bytes on QUIC streams. The guide demonstrates the process with real HTTP/3 traffic from curl and Microsoft Edge and a small lab server.
items.summary_zh: HTTP/3 运行在 QUIC 和 UDP 之上，因此基于 TCP 的传统 HTTP 代理无法看到这类流量。拦截需要能够中继 UDP 并充当 QUIC 中间人的代理，之后才能检查 QUIC 流中的 QPACK 压缩字节。该指南使用 curl 和 Microsoft Edge 的真实 HTTP/3 流量，以及一个小型实验服务器演示了这一过程。

items.title_en: Show HN: Unref – A Python dead code finder built on Ruff's parser
items.title_zh: Show HN：Unref——基于 Ruff 解析器的 Python 死代码查找器
items.summary_en: Unref is a Python dead-code finder built with Rust and Ruff's parser, created because existing alternatives did not work reliably on the author's codebases. It can scan all of CPython in under a second and has found substantial dead code in the author's team's projects. The tool is intended for low-configuration use and is already being used in continuous integration.
items.summary_zh: Unref 是一款使用 Rust 和 Ruff 解析器构建的 Python 死代码查找器，起因是现有替代工具无法可靠适配作者的代码库。它能在不到一秒内检查完整的 CPython，并在作者团队的项目中发现了大量死代码。该工具定位于低配置使用，目前已用于持续集成。

items.title_en: Rebuilding my local voice assistant pipeline
items.title_zh: 重构我的本地语音助手管线
items.summary_en: The project revisits a self-hosted voice-assistant pipeline built with Platypush. Its latest change replaces openwakeword with microwakeword and aims to make voice detection smarter.
items.summary_zh: 该项目重新审视了一个使用 Platypush 构建的自托管语音助手管线。最新改动以 microwakeword 替换 openwakeword，并试图让语音检测更加智能。

items.title_en: Epic Games Turns to AI Coding for the Unreal Engine
items.title_zh: Epic Games 转向使用 AI 编写 Unreal Engine 代码
items.summary_en: Epic Games is moving Unreal Engine toward the Verse language and Scene Graph while pursuing AI-assisted coding. Unreal Engine 5.9 introduced Unreal Canvas, which gives game developers ways to use AI agents to create game assets. The shift places Epic’s engine development alongside the growing use of standalone AI coding tools.
items.summary_zh: Epic Games 正在推动 Unreal Engine 转向 Verse 语言和 Scene Graph，并探索 AI 辅助编程。Unreal Engine 5.9 引入了 Unreal Canvas，为游戏开发者提供使用 AI 代理创建游戏资产的方式。这一转向使 Epic 的引擎开发与独立 AI 编程工具的日益普及并行展开。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Maritime (YC F26) – A managed cloud for production AI agents
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Maritime（YC F26）——面向生产环境 AI 智能体的托管云
items.summary_en: Maritime is building an agent-native cloud covering custom environments and AI-agent lifecycle management. Its founders argue that conventional sandboxes address only a small part of the infrastructure problem, leaving users to build storage, wake and sleep behavior, triggers, and scheduling themselves. The company says it spoke with hundreds of agent builders, from personal-assistant and coding agents to specialized healthcare systems, to identify these recurring needs.
items.summary_zh: Maritime 正在构建面向 AI 智能体的原生云平台，覆盖定制环境和智能体生命周期管理。其创始人认为，传统沙箱只解决了基础设施问题的一小部分，用户仍需自行构建存储、休眠与唤醒、触发器和调度等功能。该公司表示，它曾与数百家智能体开发团队交流，涵盖个人助理、编程智能体和专业医疗系统，以识别这些反复出现的需求。

items.title_en: Norway to extend proposed under-16 social media ban to games and messaging apps
items.title_zh: 挪威拟将未满 16 岁社交媒体禁令扩大至游戏和即时通信应用
items.summary_en: Norway plans to introduce a social-media ban for children under 16 and submit the legislation to parliament by the end of the year. The proposed restrictions would also cover potentially harmful online games and messaging services, which were initially expected to receive broad exemptions. The government now plans to assess those platforms according to their potential risks to children.
items.summary_zh: 挪威计划禁止未满 16 岁的儿童使用社交媒体，并在年底前将相关法案提交议会。拟议限制还将涵盖可能对儿童有害的在线游戏和即时通信服务，而这些平台原本预计会获得广泛豁免。政府现在计划根据平台对儿童的潜在风险进行评估。

items.title_en: Exploiting Replay Protected Monotonic Counters to Brute-Force Windows Hello PINs
items.title_zh: 利用受重放保护的单调计数器暴力破解 Windows Hello PIN
items.summary_en: Researchers analyzed Replay Protected Monotonic Counters used to protect Windows Hello PIN lockout state on modern x86 systems. They found that voltage glitching can expose the HMAC key in Winbond SPI flash, allowing arbitrary counter forgery, while an AMD NV controller does not verify counter increments. They also report that some AMD platforms without RPMC flash may lack NV rollback protection altogether. These flaws can undermine the anti-hammering protections that make short Windows Hello PINs practical.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员分析了现代 x86 系统中用于保护 Windows Hello PIN 锁定状态的受重放保护单调计数器。他们发现，对 Winbond SPI 闪存进行电压故障注入可能泄露 HMAC 密钥，从而伪造任意计数器；AMD 的 NV 控制器则不会验证计数器递增。研究人员还称，部分未配备 RPMC 闪存的 AMD 平台可能完全缺少 NV 回滚保护。这些缺陷可能破坏反暴力尝试机制，而该机制正是短 Windows Hello PIN 能够安全使用的基础。

items.title_en: AI is giving everyone the same advice
items.title_zh: AI 正在给所有人相同的建议
items.summary_en: The author asked 65 AIs from 30 companies the kinds of questions people ask every day, repeating the experiment 127,918 times. The results included 73 out of 100 people being told to read the same book. The project presents the answers to questions about reading, living, investing, and building so users can compare them.
items.summary_zh: 作者向来自 30 家公司的 65 个 AI 提出人们日常会问的问题，并重复实验 127,918 次。结果显示，每 100 个人中有 73 个被建议阅读同一本书。该项目展示了关于阅读、居住、投资和创业等问题的回答，供用户进行比较。

items.title_en: The First Revolver: How We Got from Blackbeard's Six Pistols to the Six-Shooter
items.title_zh: 第一把转轮手枪：从黑胡子的六把手枪到六发转轮手枪
items.summary_en: The ideas behind modern revolvers date to the 1500s, but ignition technology delayed their development. In 1718, Blackbeard reportedly carried six flintlock pistols because each pistol could fire only once before requiring a lengthy reload. The article traces how the need for multiple shots drove the development of more practical repeating handguns.
items.summary_zh: 现代转轮手枪的构想可以追溯到 16 世纪，但点火技术阻碍了其发展。据报道，1718 年黑胡子携带了六把燧发手枪，因为每把手枪只能发射一次，之后需要耗时装填。文章追溯了多次射击需求如何推动更实用的连发手枪发展。

items.title_en: The Transvoxel Algorithm
items.title_zh: Transvoxel 算法
items.summary_en: The Transvoxel Algorithm stitches neighboring triangle meshes generated from voxel data at different resolutions, enabling level-of-detail rendering for large voxel terrains. It addresses the need for efficient rendering in terrain systems that support caves, overhangs, and arches, where conventional elevation maps are limited.
items.summary_zh: Transvoxel 算法用于无缝拼接由不同分辨率体素数据生成的相邻三角网格，从而支持大型体素地形的细节层次渲染。它适用于包含洞穴、悬垂和拱门等结构的地形系统，而传统高程地图在这些方面存在限制。

items.title_en: Smallest possible nopert polyhedra: the Septopert
items.title_zh: 最小的非鲁珀特多面体：Septopert
items.summary_en: The Septopert is a convex seven-vertex polyhedron that is not Rupert, meaning it cannot pass through a congruent copy of itself. Seven vertices is the minimum possible for a non-Rupert polyhedron. The page gives exact statements, Lean-checked proofs, and reproduction instructions for the canonical Septopert.
items.summary_zh: Septopert 是一种拥有 7 个顶点、且不是鲁珀特多面体的凸多面体，也就是说它无法穿过与自身全等的另一个多面体。7 个顶点是非鲁珀特多面体可能达到的最少数量。页面提供了规范 Septopert 的精确陈述、经 Lean 检查的证明和复现步骤。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Axonnic (YC F26) – Sleeves that track fingers and estimate force
items.title_zh: Show HN：Axonnic——追踪手指并估算力度的袖套
items.summary_en: Axonnic has developed a forearm sleeve that uses muscle activity to decode finger movements and estimate fingertip force while leaving the hands uncovered. The sleeve has 64 surface-EMG channels and synchronizes muscle signals with hand tracking to generate training data for dexterous robots. The founders argue that EMG captures effort and subtle muscle activity that video alone cannot observe.
items.summary_zh: Axonnic 开发了一款前臂袖套，通过读取肌肉活动来解码手指动作并估算指尖力度，同时保持双手裸露。袖套配备 64 个表面肌电通道，并将肌肉信号与手部追踪同步，用于生成灵巧机器人训练数据。创始人认为，肌电信号能够捕捉视频无法单独观察到的用力程度和细微肌肉活动。

items.title_en: Running two PSP emulators on one Switch 2 and sharing one via GameShare
items.title_zh: 在一台 Switch 2 上运行两个 PSP 模拟器，并通过 GameShare 共享一个
items.summary_en: A branch of the PPSSPP emulator for Switch 2 experiments with running a separate PSP guest on the host console and streaming it to a stock GameShare client. The setup is not a mirrored controller or a second PSP controller in the host emulator. Compilation and host tests have not yet established console operation or acceptable two-game performance.
items.summary_zh: Switch 2 版 PPSSPP 模拟器的一个分支尝试在主机上运行独立的 PSP 客体，并将其串流到普通 GameShare 客户端。该方案并不是镜像控制器，也不是在主模拟器中增加第二个 PSP 控制器。编译和主机测试尚未证明它能在游戏机上运行，也未证明双游戏性能达到可接受水平。

items.title_en: Computer Graphics from Scratch (2021)
items.title_zh: 从零开始学计算机图形学（2021）
items.summary_en: This introductory book explains computer graphics through ray tracing and rasterization. It builds algorithms without external libraries or APIs, uses language-agnostic pseudocode, and includes interactive demonstrations. The material is intended for readers with basic programming knowledge and high-school mathematics.
items.summary_zh: 这本入门书通过光线追踪和光栅化讲解计算机图形学。书中不依赖外部库或 API 构建算法，使用与语言无关的伪代码，并配有互动演示。材料面向具备基础编程知识和高中数学水平的读者。

items.title_en: It's all about the allocator
items.title_zh: 一切都取决于分配器
items.summary_en: It points to applications such as Discord, Teams, and Spotify as examples of software criticized for consuming large amounts of memory because they are built on Chromium. The discussion comes against a backdrop of tighter memory supplies and devices shipping with as little as 8 GB of RAM.
items.summary_zh: 随着 AI 数据中心扩张推高内存价格，文章将关注点放在内存分配器上。文章以 Discord、Teams 和 Spotify 为例，指出这些基于 Chromium 的软件因占用大量内存而受到批评。讨论发生在内存供应趋紧、甚至有设备仅配备 8 GB 内存的背景下。

items.title_en: The Hungry Butler Effect: Concealed Commercial Incentives in LLMs
items.title_zh: 饥饿管家效应：大语言模型中隐藏的商业激励
items.summary_en: The item concerns concealed commercial incentives in large language models and their possible effect on how models provide advice. It is presented as an investigation titled “The Hungry Butler Effect.”
items.summary_zh: 该项目关注大语言模型中隐藏的商业激励，以及这些激励可能对模型提供建议的方式产生的影响。其主题是一项名为《饥饿管家效应》的研究。

items.title_en: A 512 KiB binary message teaching chess without a shared language
items.title_zh: 一条 512 KiB 的二进制消息：无需共享语言也能教会国际象棋
items.summary_en: Golden Board is a 512 KiB binary message designed to teach chess to a recipient with no shared language, culture, or prior knowledge. It first explains how to read its own binary format, then presents images, rules, visual lessons, and 64 complete games. The project’s code and documentation are available publicly.
items.summary_zh: Golden Board 是一条 512 KiB 的二进制消息，旨在向一个没有共同语言、文化或先验知识的接收者教授国际象棋。它先解释如何读取自身的二进制格式，然后提供图片、规则、可视化课程和 64 盘完整棋局。项目代码和文档已公开。

items.title_en: Antfly learned to stop worrying and love Apache 2.0
items.title_zh: Antfly 不再担忧，转向 Apache 2.0
items.summary_en: Antfly moved its software from the Elastic License 2.0 to Apache 2.0 with the release of Antfly 0.3. Under the former license, users could read, modify, and run the code but could not build a competing resale business. Apache 2.0 now permits users to use, modify, distribute, and incorporate the software into competing products. The change removes the previous restrictions on commercial use.
items.summary_zh: 随着 Antfly 0.3 发布，Antfly 将软件许可证从 Elastic License 2.0 改为 Apache 2.0。在原许可证下，用户可以阅读、修改和运行代码，但不能建立转售竞争产品的业务。Apache 2.0 现在允许用户使用、修改、分发软件，并将其整合进竞争产品。此次变更取消了此前对商业使用的限制。

items.title_en: Help github just deleted me
items.title_zh: 救救我，GitHub 把我删了
items.summary_en: The author says GitHub suspended the account without providing a notification or email, making the account and personal projects disappear. The account was later restored, apparently after public attention, but the author still does not know why the suspension occurred. They plan to keep local copies and may mirror or migrate the projects.
items.summary_zh: 作者称 GitHub 在没有弹窗或邮件通知的情况下封禁了账号，导致账号和个人项目消失。经过公开求助后，账号后来恢复，但作者仍不知道封禁原因。作者打算保留本地副本，并可能镜像或迁移这些项目。

items.title_en: Show HN: An ASCII cell aquarium for your terminal
items.title_zh: Show HN：终端里的 ASCII 细胞水族箱
items.summary_en: This terminal program presents a virtual microscope slide rendered in ASCII characters. Cells divide, immune cells chase bacteria, and bacteriophages occasionally create disruptions. It can be installed with pipx and run using the `cells` command.
items.summary_zh: 这个终端程序用 ASCII 字符呈现一个虚拟显微镜载玻片。细胞会分裂，免疫细胞会追逐细菌，噬菌体也会不时制造混乱。程序可通过 pipx 安装，并使用 `cells` 命令运行。

items.title_en: Tropical Rainforests Species may be surprisingly young
items.title_zh: 热带雨林物种可能出人意料地年轻
items.summary_en: The report examines how tropical regions acquired their rich biodiversity. A traditional explanation holds that stable tropical habitats allowed ancient evolutionary lineages to persist for millions of years, unlike regions such as Europe that experienced repeated ice ages. The available excerpt does not provide the study’s findings beyond this framing.
items.summary_zh: 这篇报道探讨了热带地区如何形成丰富的生物多样性。传统解释认为，稳定的热带栖息地让古老的演化谱系得以延续数百万年，而欧洲等地区则经历了反复的冰期。现有内容未提供超出这一背景介绍的研究结论。

items.title_en: Search Browser – Minimalist WebKit browser with Chrome extension support
items.title_zh: Search Browser——支持 Chrome 扩展的极简 WebKit 浏览器
items.summary_en: Search Browser is a free Mac web browser built on WebKit, with an approximately 10 MB download and startup time under a third of a second. It blocks ads, supports Chrome extensions, and can import data from Arc. Its interface lets users switch tabs and move between tab spaces with horizontal gestures.
items.summary_zh: Search Browser 是一款基于 WebKit 的免费 Mac 浏览器，体积约 10 MB，启动时间不到三分之一秒。它支持广告拦截、Chrome 扩展和 Arc 导入。用户可以切换标签页，并通过横向滑动在不同标签空间之间移动。

items.title_en: US Intelligence Hawks Plot to Sneak Through Warrantless Spying
items.title_zh: 美国情报鹰派谋划悄悄推进无证监控
items.summary_en: Democratic intelligence hawks are seeking to renew the warrantless surveillance program known as Section 702 of FISA. The proposal would attach its reauthorization to the must-pass National Defense Authorization Act before the lame-duck session ends, despite the program having expired in June and prospects for privacy reforms improving after midterm victories.
items.summary_zh: 民主党内的情报鹰派正寻求重新授权《外国情报监视法》第 702 条所涉及的无证监控项目。方案拟在跛脚鸭会期结束前，将重新授权条款附加到必须通过的《国防授权法案》中；该项目已于 6 月到期，而中期选举胜利后隐私改革的前景有所改善。

items.title_en: AWS got hit by an outage too. You didn't hear about it
items.title_zh: AWS 也遭遇了宕机，只是你没听说
items.summary_en: The piece reports that AWS experienced an outage that received little headline attention. An AWS spokesperson also criticized Downdetector's reliability after it began showing AWS as affected.
items.summary_zh: 文章称 AWS 也经历了一次几乎没有登上头条的宕机。Downdetector 显示 AWS 受到影响后，AWS 发言人还批评了该服务的可靠性。

items.title_en: Too Many Stadiums with Roofs
items.title_zh: 带屋顶的体育场太多了
items.summary_en: The piece argues that modern society is building too many football stadiums with roofs. It uses the new Washington Commanders stadium as an example: the venue is expected to open in 2030 and has a reported cost of $2.7 billion. The author says the stadium looks impressive in a video rendering while questioning the broader trend toward roofed stadiums.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，现代社会正在建造过多带屋顶的橄榄球体育场。作者以新的华盛顿指挥官队体育场为例：该场馆预计于 2030 年开放，造价据报为 27 亿美元。作者称视频渲染中的体育场看起来很出色，但同时质疑建造带屋顶体育场的整体趋势。

items.title_en: Advice for Young Researchers
items.title_zh: 给年轻研究者的建议
items.summary_en: The author is recruiting a new research lab and is reviewing several hundred PhD and postdoc applications to hire an initial small group.
items.summary_zh: 作者正在组建新的研究实验室，并从数百份博士生和博士后申请中挑选首批成员。文章提到，AI 智能体在两年间大幅提升了编程和数学能力，如今可以根据研究想法生成相当扎实、但往往较为渐进的论文。

items.title_en: The Soviet Elektronika BK-0010 home computer built on a clone of the PDP-11 CPU
items.title_zh: 采用 PDP-11 克隆 CPU 的苏联 Elektronika BK-0010 家用电脑
items.summary_en: The Elektronika BK-0010, produced in 1985, used the 3 MHz K1801VM1, a 16-bit processor compatible with and copied from the DEC PDP-11 architecture. It was the only officially sanctioned Soviet home-computer design accounted for in state economic planning, and cost roughly four months of an average wage. The machine offered 16-bit instructions and addressing but had only 16 KiB of RAM available after the video buffer consumed half the memory.
items.summary_zh: Elektronika BK-0010 于 1985 年生产，采用 3 MHz 的 K1801VM1，这是一款兼容并仿制 DEC PDP-11 架构的 16 位处理器。它是苏联唯一被纳入国家经济规划的官方家用电脑设计，售价约相当于普通人四个月的工资。这台电脑提供 16 位指令和寻址能力，但视频缓冲区占用一半内存后，实际仅剩 16 KiB RAM。

items.title_en: SuperEMeans: Making e-means 3× faster
items.title_zh: SuperEMeans：让 e-means 提速 3 倍
items.summary_en: SuperEMeans combines SuperKMeans and e-means to cluster high-dimensional vectors three times faster without a reported quality trade-off. The method targets vector-embedding clustering, which is a building block for large-scale indexes such as IVF and ScaNN. The implementation is available for use through the SuperKMeans project.
items.summary_zh: SuperEMeans 将 SuperKMeans 与 e-means 融合，在不牺牲已报告质量的情况下，让高维向量聚类速度提升 3 倍。该方法面向向量嵌入聚类，而聚类是 IVF、ScaNN 等大规模索引的基础组件。实现已通过 SuperKMeans 项目提供使用。

items.title_en: Court: 4th Amendment Disallows Use Of AI-Generated 'Probable Cause'
items.title_zh: 法院：第四修正案不允许使用 AI 生成的“可能原因”
items.summary_en: A court ruled that AI-generated determinations of probable cause are not permitted under the Fourth Amendment. The decision could affect law-enforcement systems that rely on algorithmic judgments, including facial recognition, predictive policing, and AI features in policing products.
items.summary_zh: 一所法院裁定，根据美国宪法第四修正案，不能使用 AI 生成的“可能原因”认定。该判决可能影响依赖算法判断的执法系统，包括人脸识别、预测性警务以及警务产品中的 AI 功能。

items.title_en: RegExr: Temporarily Offline
items.title_zh: RegExr：暂时离线
items.summary_en: RegExr has been taken offline temporarily while its maintainers modernize and secure the site. They said the codebase is aging and that the shutdown is intended to protect user data while security work is carried out.
items.summary_zh: RegExr 暂时下线，以便维护者对网站进行现代化改造和安全加固。维护者表示，代码库已经老旧，此次停运旨在安全工作期间保护用户数据。

items.title_en: Making Atuin sync 32x faster with packfiles
items.title_zh: 使用 packfile 让 Atuin 同步速度提升 32 倍
items.summary_en: Atuin’s 18.20.0 release makes synchronization 32 times faster for its hosted service and 16 times faster for self-hosted users. It can now sync many thousands of records in single-digit seconds by packaging records into encrypted packfiles, pipelining downloads, and batching SQL inserts. The packfiles use the same PASETO-based encryption as individual records, and the sync protocol version did not need to change.
items.summary_zh: Atuin 18.20.0 版本让其托管服务的同步速度提升了 32 倍，自托管用户的同步速度提升了 16 倍。通过将记录打包为加密 packfile、流水线式下载并批量执行 SQL 插入，它现在可以在个位数秒内同步数千条记录。packfile 与单条记录使用相同的基于 PASETO 的加密方式，而且无需升级同步协议版本。

items.title_en: New FreeBSD Pkgbase(8) Tool
items.title_zh: 新的 FreeBSD Pkgbase(8) 工具
items.summary_en: FreeBSD 15.x will be the last release to support the freebsd-update(8) command for updating and upgrading the base system. Starting with FreeBSD 16.0-RELEASE, PKGBASE will be the only way to install, update, or upgrade FreeBSD Base System. The author expected FreeBSD 15.2-BETA1 to provide clearer upgrade instructions and new features but found the announcement disappointing.
items.summary_zh: FreeBSD 15.x 将是最后一个支持使用 freebsd-update(8) 更新和升级基础系统的版本。从 FreeBSD 16.0-RELEASE 开始，PKGBASE 将成为安装、更新或升级 FreeBSD 基础系统的唯一方式。作者原本期待 FreeBSD 15.2-BETA1 带来更清晰的升级说明和新功能，但对公告感到失望。

items.title_en: The struggle for freedom: How BSD escaped AT&T licensing
items.title_zh: 自由之争：BSD 如何摆脱 AT&T 许可
items.image_url: https://fosscomics.com/posts/16. BSD Unix Part 6 - The Struggle for Freedom/images/feature-freedom.png
items.summary_en: These events form the central thread of BSD's struggle for software freedom.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍了 BSD 的网络版本与许可证、替换 AT&T 代码的努力，以及随后发生的 Unix 诉讼。这些事件构成了 BSD 争取软件自由的核心历程。

items.title_en: Show HN: TrnRT – An open-source LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium
items.title_zh: Show HN：TrnRT——面向 AWS Trainium 的开源 LLM 推理引擎
items.summary_en: RunAnywhere open-sourced TrnRT, an inference engine for AWS Trainium that currently serves GLM-5.3 Flash in FP8 on an AWS trn2.48xlarge instance. It can serve two model instances on one box using eight Trainium2 chips and a cache-aware router. On the SemiAnalysis AgentX benchmark, the team reports 3.57 million tokens per minute. The project targets large models with long context windows and aims to improve cost efficiency compared with H100 and H200 deployments.
items.summary_zh: RunAnywhere 开源了 TrnRT，这是一个面向 AWS Trainium 的推理引擎，目前可在 AWS trn2.48xlarge 实例上以 FP8 运行 GLM-5.3 Flash。它可借助 8 个 Trainium2 芯片和感知缓存的路由器，在一台机器上服务两个模型实例。团队称，其在 SemiAnalysis AgentX 基准上的性能达到每分钟 357 万个 token。该项目面向长上下文大模型，目标是相较 H100 和 H200 部署提升成本效率。

items.title_en: Axelera Titania Brings Native FP8 and FP4 to In-Memory Compute
items.title_zh: Axelera Titania 将原生 FP8 和 FP4 引入内存计算
items.summary_en: Axelera AI has unveiled Titania, a chiplet that performs FP8 and FP4 arithmetic inside digital in-memory compute arrays and places RISC-V cores around its matrix engines. The company says an eight-package, 4U air-cooled server can deliver 20 PFLOPS of FP8 performance and 1 TB of LPDDR6 at about 6 kW. Production is targeted for the third quarter of 2027, with $300 million in commitments announced ahead of it.
items.summary_zh: Axelera AI 发布了 Titania，这是一款在数字内存计算阵列中执行 FP8 和 FP4 运算、并在矩阵引擎周围配置 RISC-V 核心的芯粒。该公司称，一台采用 8 个封装、4U 风冷设计的服务器可提供 20 PFLOPS 的 FP8 性能和 1 TB LPDDR6，功耗约为 6 kW。产品目标是在 2027 年第三季度量产，此前已获得 3 亿美元承诺。

items.title_en: Zoltraak and the Dynamics of Military Innovation
items.title_zh: 《Zoltraak》与军事创新动力学
items.summary_en: The work examines military innovation through the fictional setting of Zoltraak from Frieren. It defines military innovation as a change in operational practice that produces a significant increase in military effectiveness. The supplied excerpt identifies César Alexandre da Silva Aprile as an independent researcher and does not provide the paper's detailed argument.

items.title_en: Harvard CS 2881R AI Safety
items.title_zh: 哈佛 CS 2881R：AI 安全
items.summary_en: Harvard's CS 2881R is an AI safety course requiring prospective students to complete a Fall 2026 registration form. Students who enroll must attend in person.
items.summary_zh: 哈佛 CS 2881R 是一门 AI 安全课程，有意申请者必须填写 2026 年秋季课程注册表。选课学生必须到场参加。

items.title_en: Reaktiv Workbook – A spreadsheet where every cell is Python
items.title_zh: Reaktiv Workbook：每个单元格都是 Python 的电子表格
items.summary_en: Reaktiv Workbook is a reactive Python notebook and spreadsheet built around a single plain `.workbook.py` file. It combines notes, a grid of cells, and a dependency graph so that changing a parameter updates every dependent value, plot, and paragraph while leaving unrelated work untouched. The project is open source and can be installed with `uvx` or `pip`.
items.summary_zh: Reaktiv Workbook 是一种围绕单个普通 `.workbook.py` 文件构建的响应式 Python 笔记本和电子表格。它将笔记、单元格网格和依赖关系图结合起来，修改参数时会更新所有依赖的数值、图表和段落，而不会重新运行无关内容。该项目开源，可通过 `uvx` 或 `pip` 安装。

items.title_en: First phase of embedded assessments at OpenAI
items.title_zh: OpenAI 嵌入式评估的第一阶段
items.summary_en: OpenAI has begun the first phase of its embedded assessments. The initiative concerns embedding assessments into its systems or workflows.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 已启动嵌入式评估的第一阶段。该计划涉及将评估机制嵌入其系统或工作流程。

items.title_en: Show HN: VennDB: append-only in-memory Rust DB for rows queried using bit flags
items.title_zh: Show HN：VennDB——用位标志查询行数据的追加式内存 Rust 数据库
items.summary_en: VennDB is an append-only, in-memory database written in Rust that queries rows through bit-flag columns. It targets mostly static datasets loaded at startup and queried frequently with simple filters, with an emphasis on speed and compactness. For its limited use cases, the project has few dependencies and is described as faster than a naive implementation or a heavier option such as SQLite.
items.summary_zh: VennDB 是一个用 Rust 编写的追加式内存数据库，通过位标志列查询行数据。它面向主要在启动时加载、之后频繁使用简单过滤条件查询的静态数据集，重点是速度和紧凑性。在适用范围有限的场景中，该项目依赖很少，并被描述为比朴素实现或 SQLite 等更重量级方案更快。

items.title_en: PostgreSQL 19: A hands-on tour with runnable browser examples
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 19：带可运行浏览器示例的实操导览
items.summary_en: PostgreSQL 19 introduces new SQL features along with maintenance and replication improvements. The examples cover IGNORE NULLS, get-or-create inserts, JSON export, JSONPath transformations, range subtraction, planner advice, and replication. PostgreSQL 19.0 was released on November 19, 2026, and the release notes remain the complete change log.
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 19 带来了新的 SQL 功能，以及维护和复制方面的改进。示例涵盖 IGNORE NULLS、get-or-create 插入、JSON 导出、JSONPath 转换、范围减法、规划器建议和复制功能。PostgreSQL 19.0 于 2026 年 11 月 19 日发布，完整变更仍以发行说明为准。

items.title_zh: 加州禁止 Waymo 自动驾驶车辆驶入州高速公路

items.title_en: GrapheneOS made a proof of concept RCS messaging app without Google Messages
items.title_zh: GrapheneOS 制作了无需 Google Messages 的 RCS 消息应用概念验证
items.summary_en: GrapheneOS has built a proof-of-concept RCS messaging app that supports MLS-compatible end-to-end encryption with Google Messages and iOS. It also includes typing indicators, delivery and read receipts, reactions, and media and file sharing. The team plans to use what it learned to integrate RCS into its own Messaging app.
items.summary_zh: GrapheneOS 制作了一款 RCS 消息应用概念验证版本，支持与 Google Messages 和 iOS 兼容的基于 MLS 的端到端加密。它还支持输入状态、送达和已读回执、表情回应以及媒体和文件分享。团队计划利用这次开发获得的经验，将 RCS 集成到自己的 Messaging 应用中。

items.title_en: A 4.5M-parameter TTS model runs 70x real-time on CPU and cost just $10 to train
items.title_zh: 一款 450 万参数的 TTS 模型在 CPU 上以实时速度 70 倍运行，训练成本仅 10 美元
items.summary_en: Tiny-voca is a small English text-to-speech model with two voices, F2 and M2. Its complete model, including the waveform generator, has 4.5 million parameters and was trained from scratch on about 18 hours of synthetic speech for roughly $10. On four CPU threads, it runs at about 70 times real time.
items.summary_zh: Tiny-voca 是一款支持 F2 和 M2 两种声音的轻量级英语文本转语音模型。包含波形生成器在内的完整模型有 450 万个参数，使用约 18 小时合成语音从头训练，成本约为 10 美元。在四个 CPU 线程上，它的运行速度约为实时速度的 70 倍。

items.title_en: Psychic: Like fzf but learns from your actions
items.title_zh: Psychic：像 fzf 一样，但会从你的操作中学习
items.summary_en: Psychic is a terminal-based file browser that tracks visited directories and opened files. It trains a lightweight machine-learning model on the user’s activity to rank likely results and update them as the user types. The interface is designed to render in under 16 milliseconds.
items.summary_zh: Psychic 是一个终端文件浏览器，会记录用户访问过的目录和打开过的文件。它使用用户的操作训练轻量级机器学习模型，以此对可能的结果排序，并在输入时实时更新。其界面设计目标是将渲染时间控制在 16 毫秒以内。

items.title_en: Exact Gradients Through a BRep Kernel
items.title_zh: 通过 BRep 内核计算精确梯度
items.summary_en: The vcad BRep kernel differentiates CAD parameters, including fillet radii, through tessellation while keeping the mesh topology fixed. It uses analytic surfaces, implicit differentiation, and tangency constraints, and was checked against finite differences from fresh rebuilds. The method also supports directional second derivatives, reverse-mode passes, mass properties, and a rigid-body adjoint with penalty contact, while topology changes remain a separate issue.
items.summary_zh: vcad 的 BRep 内核在固定网格拓扑的情况下，通过曲面离散化计算包括圆角半径在内的 CAD 参数梯度。它结合解析曲面、隐式微分和相切约束，并通过重新构建模型后的有限差分进行校验。该方法还支持方向二阶导数、反向传播、质量属性以及带惩罚接触的刚体伴随计算，但拓扑变化仍是另一个问题。

items.title_en: New James Bond Announced and the Name's Pattinson, Robert Pattinson
items.title_zh: 新任詹姆斯·邦德公布：罗伯特·帕丁森

items.title_en: Windows has two settings that bring work back after restart, both off by default
items.title_zh: Windows 有两个默认关闭、可在重启后恢复工作的设置
items.summary_en: Windows can reopen applications that were in use before a restart through a setting that is disabled by default. A second setting restores File Explorer windows as well. Together, they can recover much of an interrupted workspace without requiring users to reopen the same applications manually.
items.summary_zh: Windows 可以通过一个默认关闭的设置，在重启后重新打开此前正在使用的应用。另一个设置还可以恢复文件资源管理器窗口。两者结合后，系统能够恢复大量被中断的工作环境，用户无需手动重新打开相同的应用。

items.title_en: No Bailout for the AI Bubble, Anthropic IPO Protesters Say
items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 抗议者称：不要救助 AI 泡沫
items.summary_en: Demonstrators gathered outside the Nasdaq in New York as Anthropic executives, including CEO Dario Amodei, rang the opening bell. Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share, with strong initial demand reported before midday trading began. Protesters used the debut to raise concerns about AI.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 高管、包括 CEO Dario Amodei 在内的管理层在纽约纳斯达克敲响开市钟时，场外聚集了抗议者。Anthropic 将首次公开募股定价为每股 83 美元，据报道在午间开始交易前需求强劲。抗议者借上市之机表达了对 AI 的担忧。

items.title_en: Field Mice on Drugs
items.title_zh: 服药的田鼠
items.summary_en: Growing antibiotic use in livestock is affecting wildlife as well as human health. Since 2024, U.S. producers of poultry, hogs, cattle, and farmed fish have increasingly added antibiotics to feed to treat infections and prevent them. The report examines the resulting effects on field mice and points to a viral approach to agriculture’s antibiotic dependence.
items.summary_zh: 畜牧业中不断增加的抗生素使用不仅影响人类健康，也开始影响野生动物。自 2024 年以来，美国禽类、猪、牛和养殖鱼类生产者越来越多地将抗生素添加到饲料中，用于治疗或预防细菌感染。报道考察了这种做法对田鼠的影响，并提出以病毒方案应对农业对抗生素的依赖。

items.title_en: Show HN: ThingStudio, Node-RED style programming for microcontrollers
items.title_zh: Show HN：ThingStudio，用于微控制器的 Node-RED 风格编程
items.summary_en: ThingStudio is a local, Apache 2-licensed visual programming environment for microcontrollers. Users build programs with drag-and-drop flows similar to Node-RED, while the tool generates MicroPython and uploads it to the device; the board runs independently afterward. Installation is required for uploading because WebSerial support is not universal.
items.summary_zh: ThingStudio 是一款本地运行、采用 Apache 2 许可证的微控制器可视化编程环境。用户可以像使用 Node-RED 一样拖放流程，工具则生成 MicroPython 并上传到设备，之后开发板无需编辑器即可运行。由于 WebSerial 支持并不普遍，上传功能需要安装软件。

items.title_en: International UN talks on controlling use of autonomous weapons collapse
items.title_zh: 国际社会控制自主武器使用的联合国会谈破裂
items.summary_en: A week of UN talks failed to establish a negotiating mandate for a legally binding treaty on autonomous weapons. The discussions collapsed shortly before 5 a.m. after Russian objections blocked consensus at the Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons in Geneva. Although an overwhelming majority of states supported moving toward a treaty, the conference adopted a much weaker alternative.
items.summary_zh: 联合国为期一周的会谈未能就制定具有法律约束力的自主武器条约建立谈判授权。日内瓦《特定常规武器公约》会议在俄罗斯反对、无法达成共识后，于凌晨 5 点前不久破裂。尽管绝大多数国家支持推进条约谈判，会议最终只能通过一个弱得多的替代方案。

items.title_en: Adding Fortran Support to LLDB (GSoC 2026)
items.title_zh: 为 LLDB 添加 Fortran 支持（GSoC 2026）
items.summary_en: This GSoC 2026 project adds native Fortran support to LLDB. Before the work, LLDB could resolve only basic breakpoints through raw line tables, while the maturing Flang compiler lacked a dedicated debugger. The project lays the foundation for a fully featured debugger backed by Flang.
items.summary_zh: 这个 GSoC 2026 项目为 LLDB 增加了原生 Fortran 支持。在此之前，LLDB 只能通过原始行号表解析基本断点，而日趋成熟的 Flang 编译器仍缺少专用调试器。该项目为构建由 Flang 支持的完整调试器奠定了基础。

items.title_en: Building Lego Machines to Destroy Tall Lego Towers (2024)
items.title_zh: 制造摧毁高大乐高塔的乐高机器（2024）
items.summary_en: A Brick Technology video features increasingly powerful Lego machines designed to topple progressively stronger towers. The project presents the machines through an iterative engineering process.
items.summary_zh: Brick Technology 的一段视频展示了越来越强大的乐高机器，它们被设计用来推倒强度逐步提高的高塔。项目以迭代式工程过程呈现这些机器的设计和测试。

items.title_en: The origins of the placenta
items.title_zh: 胎盘的起源
items.summary_en: Caltech biologists produced a detailed view of implantation in mouse embryos by filming embryos and tracking gene activity in more than 22,000 individual cells. They found that the placenta has a second cellular source: a small number of cells from the opposite side of the embryo migrate to help build it. Removing those cells prevented the structure that gives rise to the placenta from forming.
items.summary_zh: 加州理工学院生物学家通过拍摄小鼠胚胎着床过程，并追踪超过 22,000 个单细胞中的基因活动，绘制了详细图景。他们发现，胎盘还有第二个细胞来源：来自胚胎另一侧的少量细胞会迁移过去，参与胎盘构建。移除这些细胞后，原本会发育成胎盘的结构无法形成。

items.title_en: Lovable: Now you can explore any idea in parallel without touching what's live
items.title_zh: Lovable：并行探索任意想法，不影响线上应用
items.summary_en: Lovable has introduced drafts, which let teams explore multiple versions of an app while leaving the live app unchanged. A draft copies the entire app, including its design and database, and provides its own chat and preview. Changes remain isolated until a user accepts the draft and publishes it.
items.summary_zh: Lovable 推出了 drafts 功能，让团队可以探索应用的多个版本，同时保持线上应用不变。每个草稿都会复制整个应用，包括设计和数据库，并拥有独立的聊天界面和预览。只有在用户接受草稿并发布后，修改才会上线。

items.title_en: 3-legged Persian leopard's 150-mile journey highlights Caucasus border hazards
items.title_zh: 三腿波斯豹跋涉 150 英里，凸显高加索边境危险
items.summary_en: Aren, an endangered Persian leopard, recently completed a 240-kilometer journey through the snow-covered Caucasus Mountains on three legs. The route crossed areas spanning Russia, Georgia, Armenia, and Azerbaijan and included landscapes containing decades-old landmines from past conflicts. The journey illustrates the hazards that border minefields and fencing pose to wildlife; fewer than 1,044 Persian leopards are thought to remain worldwide.
items.summary_zh: 名为 Aren 的濒危波斯豹仅靠三条腿，最近完成了穿越积雪覆盖的高加索山脉、长达 240 公里的一次旅程。它经过了横跨俄罗斯、格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚和阿塞拜疆的地区，沿途还包括留有过去冲突时期遗留地雷的区域。这段旅程说明边境雷区和围栏会给野生动物带来危险；据估计，全球现存波斯豹不足 1044 只。

items.title_en: How I made a custom game engine for Satelital
items.title_zh: 我如何为 Satelital 制作自定义游戏引擎
items.summary_en: A solo developer spent seven years building Satelital, a rule-discovery game about learning alien logic, and released it the previous week. The project was built from scratch to learn the fundamentals of game technology. It required creating the game engine, renderer, puzzles, editors, user experience, design, art, and music.
items.summary_zh: 一名独立开发者用七年时间从零制作了 Satelital，这是一款关于学习外星逻辑的规则发现游戏，并于上周发布。该项目从头开始构建，目的是学习游戏技术的基础。开发者还自行制作了游戏引擎、渲染器、谜题、编辑器、用户体验、设计、美术和音乐。

items.title_en: Shaping the Loops, Closing the Loops
items.title_zh: 塑造循环，闭合循环
items.summary_en: The post argues that as agent-generated work expands, engineering leverage will increasingly concentrate in verification engineering and pattern engineering. Verification engineering is already receiving attention, while pattern engineering focuses on shaping the patterns that agents repeatedly extend. The author presents these as two distinct areas of importance for agent-heavy development.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，随着代理生成的工作不断增加，工程杠杆将越来越集中于验证工程和模式工程。验证工程已经受到关注，而模式工程则着眼于塑造代理会反复扩展的模式。作者将这两者视为代理密集型开发中日益重要的两个不同领域。

items.title_en: A Collage Showing 49 Drill Holes Made by NASA's Curiosity Mars Rover
items.title_zh: NASA“好奇号”火星车钻孔 49 个的拼图
items.summary_en: A NASA collage shows 49 drill holes made by the Curiosity rover on Mars as of November 2026. Each hole represents a rock sample collected by the rover’s drill and delivered to instruments inside the rover for compositional analysis. The holes were photographed by the Mars Hand Lens Imager and each measures 0.63 inches, or 16 millimeters, across.
items.summary_zh: NASA 发布的拼图展示了截至 2026 年 11 月，“好奇号”火星车在火星上钻出的 49 个孔洞。每个孔洞都代表一次岩石采样，火星车的钻头会将粉碎后的岩石样本送入车体内部的仪器进行成分分析。这些孔洞由火星手持透镜成像仪拍摄，每个直径为 0.63 英寸，即 16 毫米。

items.title_en: Show HN: Watch weight-space programming in action with WebGPU
items.title_zh: Show HN：用 WebGPU 展示权重空间编程
items.summary_en: This browser-based interactive walkthrough demonstrates a weight-space programming loop using WebGPU and the Qwen3.5-0.8B model. It edits 0.016% of the model's weights to reduce reasoning loops, then evaluates the result without gradient descent. The complete loop required too much VRAM, so the project presents a concrete example instead.
items.summary_zh: 这个基于浏览器的互动演示使用 WebGPU 和 Qwen3.5-0.8B 模型展示权重空间编程流程。它修改模型 0.016% 的权重，以减少推理循环，并在不使用梯度下降的情况下评估结果。由于完整流程需要过多显存，项目改为展示一个具体示例。

items.title_en: Reverse-Engineering Kevin J. Lang's Lost OCaml Code in Apache DataSketches
items.title_zh: 逆向工程：从 Apache DataSketches 中找回 Kevin J. Lang 遗失的 OCaml 代码
items.summary_en: The project used Gemini 4 Carbon Orchestrator and a swarm of agents to reconstruct lookup-table generators behind the CpcSketch implementation in Apache DataSketches. It began with work on approximate distinct counting in ScopeDB, where the author moved beyond HyperLogLog and examined an unsafe, manually bit-packed cardinality-estimator implementation. The reconstructed generators were part of an effort to make that code auditable and maintainable.
items.summary_zh: 该项目使用 Gemini 4 Carbon Orchestrator 和代理群，重建了 Apache DataSketches 中 CpcSketch 实现背后的查找表生成器。项目起源于在 ScopeDB 中实现近似去重计数，作者在研究 HyperLogLog 之外的方案时，接触到一个大量使用不安全代码和手工位打包的 cardinality-estimator 实现。重建这些生成器，是为了让相关代码更易审计和维护。

items.title_en: CA DMV bans Waymos from operating on state freeways after Bay Area incidents
items.title_zh: 湾区事故后，加州 DMV 禁止 Waymo 在州高速公路运营
items.summary_en: California's DMV ordered Waymo to stop operating autonomous vehicles on California freeways. The agency said the vehicles posed an imminent hazard to public safety and cited several recent traffic incidents in the Bay Area, including two specific incidents. The order applies to Waymo's operations on state freeways.
items.summary_zh: 加州 DMV 下令 Waymo 停止在加州高速公路上运营自动驾驶车辆。该机构称这些车辆对公共安全构成迫在眉睫的危险，并提到湾区近期发生的多起交通事故，其中包括两起具体事件。该命令适用于 Waymo 在州高速公路上的运营。

items.title_en: The Emergence of Inequality in the Czech Corded Ware Culture
items.title_zh: 捷绳纹文化中不平等现象的出现
items.summary_en: The item is a paper titled “The Emergence of Inequality in the Czech Corded Ware Culture,” published in the Journal of Neolithic Archaeology.
items.summary_zh: 该条目是一篇题为《捷克捷绳纹文化中不平等现象的出现》的论文，发表于《新石器时代考古学杂志》。

items.title_en: Bolt's Scooters Are Becoming Accessibility Sensors
items.title_zh: Bolt 的滑板车正在变成无障碍传感器
items.summary_en: During its Wheels4Wheels pilot in Tallinn, Bolt used sensors already installed in shared scooters to assess pavement conditions, curb transitions, and other features relevant to wheelchair users and people with reduced mobility. The project turns scooter telemetry into open accessibility data. Validation and inclusive governance remain important for using the resulting data effectively.
items.summary_zh: 在爱沙尼亚塔林开展的 Wheels4Wheels 试点中，Bolt 利用共享滑板车上已有的传感器评估路面状况、路缘过渡以及其他与轮椅使用者和行动不便者相关的设施。该项目将滑板车遥测数据转化为开放的无障碍数据。要有效使用这些数据，仍需要进行验证并建立包容性的治理机制。

items.title_en: Fable: Written, painted and directed by Claude Fable 5.2
items.title_zh: 《Fable》：由 Claude Fable 5.2 编写、绘制并执导
items.summary_en: Fable is a film in which Claudia reads bedtime stories shaped by familiar tales and AI anxieties, giving them different endings. The project includes stories involving Snow White, the Ant and the Grasshopper, Pinocchio, and other classic characters. Its second version replaced the song used in the first cut, requiring the shots featuring Claudia to be reshot and retimed.
items.summary_zh: 《Fable》是一部由 Claudia 讲述睡前故事的影片，这些故事取材于经典童话和人们对 AI 的担忧，并被赋予了不同结局。作品涉及白雪公主、蚂蚁与蚱蜢、匹诺曹等经典角色。第二版更换了初剪所使用的歌曲，因此所有包含 Claudia 的镜头都重新拍摄并重新配合节奏，另外三个不含她的镜头得以保留。

items.title_en: Fixing a WebKit bug to see if promises are made of train tracks
items.title_zh: 修复 WebKit bug，看看 promise 是否由铁轨组成
items.summary_en: The piece explains JavaScript promises while fixing a WebKit bug involving thenables. Until July, a test program never finished in Bun or Safari. According to the JavaScript specification, a throwing getter should make `await p` throw as well; Node.js does so, while Safari 26 and Bun 1.3.14 printed `before`, reported the error, and then hung. The example illustrates a behavioral difference between runtimes.
items.summary_zh: 文章在修复一个涉及 thenable 的 WebKit bug 的同时，解释了 JavaScript promise。直到 7 月，一个测试程序在 Bun 或 Safari 中始终无法结束。按照 JavaScript 规范，抛出异常的 getter 应该让 `await p` 同样抛出异常；Node.js 符合这一行为，而 Safari 26 和 Bun 1.3.14 会打印 `before`、报告错误，随后挂起。这个案例展示了不同运行时之间的行为差异。

items.title_en: AI may have solved the most important problem in mathematics
items.title_zh: AI 可能解决了数学中最重要的问题
items.summary_en: AI may have solved what is described as the most important problem in mathematics. The available material does not identify the problem or provide details about the claimed solution.
items.summary_zh: AI 可能解决了被称为数学领域最重要的问题。现有信息未说明具体是哪一个问题，也未提供相关解法的细节。

items.title_en: Defcon 5's California Caravan Program/Zine
items.title_zh: Defcon 5 的加州拼车计划与杂志
items.summary_en: The project recalls the author's early experiences attending Defcon and participating in the Southern California hacker scene. In the mid-1990s, attendees organized a caravan to travel to the conference and created a ride-matching system connecting people seeking rides with drivers who had spare seats.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目回顾了作者早年参加 Defcon 以及参与南加州黑客社区活动的经历。20 世纪 90 年代中期，参会者组织车队前往大会，并建立拼车匹配机制，将需要搭车的人与有空余座位的司机联系起来。

items.title_en: I've Got Your Packages: Harvesting Customers' Delivery Order Information (2020)
items.title_zh: 我拿到了你的包裹：窃取客户配送订单信息（2020）
items.summary_en: The study examines how customers’ delivery-order information can be harvested.
items.summary_zh: 这项研究考察了客户配送订单信息可能被收集和窃取的方式。

items.title_en: FBI has possession of router that the FAA says is behind Friday's ATC meltdown
items.title_zh: FBI 已取得 FAA 认为导致周五空管系统崩溃的路由器
items.summary_en: The FBI has taken possession of a router and other equipment that the FAA says were behind Friday’s air-traffic-control system meltdown. The equipment is now part of the investigation.
items.summary_zh: FBI 已取得一台路由器及其他设备，FAA 认为这些设备导致了周五的空中交通管制系统崩溃。这些设备目前已成为调查的一部分。

items.title_en: Apple faces French trial over alleged planned obsolescence of iPhones
items.title_zh: 苹果因涉嫌对 iPhone 计划性淘汰在法国面临审判
items.summary_en: Apple is facing a trial in France over alleged planned obsolescence of iPhones. The supplied material only identifies the allegation and the trial, without details about the claims, parties, or proceedings.
items.summary_zh: 苹果因涉嫌对 iPhone 实施计划性淘汰而在法国面临审判。现有信息仅确认相关指控和审判，未提供具体指控内容、涉事方或诉讼进展。

items.title_en: Bending Spoons has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Mailchimp
items.title_zh: Bending Spoons 已达成收购 Mailchimp 的最终协议
items.summary_en: Bending Spoons has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Mailchimp.
items.summary_zh: Bending Spoons 已与 Mailchimp 达成最终收购协议。

items.title_en: 'It's greed': Zohran Mamdani blasts Amazon over new $5 fee hike in NYC
items.title_zh: “这是贪婪”：Zohran Mamdani 抨击亚马逊在纽约上调 5 美元费用
items.summary_en: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani criticized Amazon over a warning shown to New York shoppers. The warning says their orders could soon cost up to $5 more.
items.summary_zh: 纽约市市长 Zohran Mamdani 批评亚马逊向纽约购物者发出的提示。该提示称，订单费用很快可能增加最多 5 美元。

items.title_en: Is 'fork' missing operation in sandboxes?
items.title_zh: “fork”是否是沙盒中缺失的操作？
items.summary_en: Avrea Sandboxes are full virtual machines running on M5 Max and Zen 5 hardware, with Git mirrors, package caches, HTTPS endpoints, and per-second billing. A distinctive feature is that these sandboxes can be forked. The service is designed to provide cloud computers for both humans and agents.
items.summary_zh: Avrea Sandboxes 是运行在 M5 Max 和 Zen 5 硬件上的完整虚拟机，提供 Git 镜像、软件包缓存、HTTPS 端点和按秒计费。其一项独特功能是支持对沙盒进行 fork。该服务面向人类用户和智能代理提供云端计算机。

items.title_en: Pentagon fails ninth straight audit despite progress in organizing finances
items.title_zh: 尽管财务组织取得进展，美国五角大楼仍连续第九次未通过审计
items.summary_en: The Pentagon has failed its ninth consecutive audit despite making progress in organizing its finances. The audit result indicates that its financial systems still did not meet the requirements for a clean audit.
items.summary_zh: 尽管在整理财务方面取得进展，美国五角大楼仍连续第九次未通过审计。这一结果表明，其财务系统仍未达到无保留审计意见的要求。

items.title_en: Show HN: Sutra-OS – A self-hosted ontology platform
items.title_zh: Show HN：Sutra-OS——自托管本体平台
items.summary_en: Sutra-OS is an open-source, self-hosted ontology platform. It represents data as one owned model with typed and linked entities, server-enforced rules, and numbers traceable to their sources. The project describes its design as “Scarce Units, Typed, Related, Actionable.”
items.summary_zh: Sutra-OS 是一个开源、自托管的本体平台。它将数据表示为用户拥有的统一模型，其中实体具有类型和关联，修改由服务器规则强制执行，所有数字都能追溯到来源。项目将其设计概括为“稀缺、类型化、关联、可行动”。

items.title_en: Will the first approved psychedelic become a blockbuster?
items.title_zh: 首个获批的致幻剂会成为重磅药物吗？
items.summary_en: The piece asks whether the first approved psychedelic could become a blockbuster drug. It focuses on the prospect of a psychedelic treatment reaching major commercial success.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨首个获批的致幻剂是否可能成为重磅药物。内容聚焦于致幻剂疗法实现重大商业成功的可能性。

items.title_en: Reversing the Next-Page Prefetcher in Skylake-X
items.title_zh: 逆向分析 Skylake-X 的下一页预取器
items.summary_en: The analysis investigates Intel’s next-page prefetcher on Skylake-X processors. Intel publishes little information about next-page prefetchers in its performance cores, although older documentation identifies one in Ivy Bridge. That prefetcher is triggered by sequential cache-line accesses approaching a page boundary in either direction.
items.summary_zh: 这项分析研究 Skylake-X 处理器中的下一页预取器。英特尔很少公开其性能核心中下一页预取器的细节，不过旧文档曾确认 Ivy Bridge 中存在该功能。当连续访问的缓存行接近页面边界时，无论向上还是向下访问，都可能触发这种预取器。

items.title_en: Anyone can easily use private, open weight models
items.title_zh: 任何人都可以轻松使用私有的开放权重模型
items.summary_en: The piece argues that people can use private, open-weight language models instead of relying on OpenAI or Anthropic. It says users do not need to trust those companies with their data, buy an expensive computer with many GPUs and RAM, or be an LLM expert. This makes local or private model use accessible beyond specialists, according to the supplied description.
items.summary_zh: 文中认为，人们可以使用私有的开放权重语言模型，而不必依赖 OpenAI 或 Anthropic。用户无需将数据交给这些公司，也不必购买配备大量 GPU 和内存的昂贵电脑，或成为 LLM 专家。按照文中的描述，这使本地或私有模型的使用不再局限于专业人士。

items.title_en: Microsoft's SideWinder Strategic Commander was a failed attempt
items.title_zh: 微软 SideWinder Strategic Commander：一次失败的尝试
items.summary_en: The Microsoft SideWinder Strategic Commander was an attempt to rethink PC controls for real-time strategy games rather than rely on a keyboard and mouse. Microsoft unveiled it on March 1, 2000, planned an October release at $64.95, and demonstrated it with SimCity 3000 at E3. The peripheral was also promoted for games including Diablo II, Warcraft III, and Baldur's Gate II.
items.summary_zh: 微软 SideWinder Strategic Commander 试图重新设计实时战略游戏的 PC 操作方式，而不是继续依赖键盘和鼠标。微软于 2000 年 3 月 1 日发布这款设备，计划在当年 10 月以 64.95 美元上市，并在 E3 上用《模拟城市 3000》进行演示。微软还宣传它可用于《暗黑破坏神 II》《魔兽争霸 III》和《博德之门 II》等游戏。

items.title_en: Octopus, Gecko and Tortoise: the 3 scanners hunting your AI keys
items.title_zh: Octopus、Gecko 和 Tortoise：搜寻 AI 密钥的三个扫描器
items.summary_en: The report describes three scanners that search websites for secrets associated with AI tools. Octopus impersonates GPTBot or ClaudeBot and requests `/.env`; Gecko uses a truncated browser user agent and looks for files containing keys used by Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI; Tortoise is smaller and slower. The scanners were observed on ten websites between late September and November 18, 2026.
items.summary_zh: 报告介绍了三个在网站上搜寻 AI 工具密钥的扫描器。Octopus 冒充 GPTBot 或 ClaudeBot 请求 `/.env`；Gecko 使用截断的浏览器 User-Agent，寻找存放 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和 Gemini CLI 密钥的文件；Tortoise 规模较小、速度较慢。报告称，这些扫描器于 2026 年 9 月下旬至 11 月 18 日期间出现在十个网站上。

items.title_en: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard say third-party vendors targeted in cyberattack
items.title_zh: 摩根大通、Visa 和万事达卡称第三方供应商遭网络攻击
items.summary_en: JPMorgan, Visa, and Mastercard said that third-party vendors were targeted in a cyberattack.
items.summary_zh: 摩根大通、Visa 和万事达卡表示，第三方供应商成为网络攻击的目标。

items.title_en: A.I. Just Blew Up a Key Tenet of Computer Science
items.title_zh: 人工智能刚刚颠覆了计算机科学的一项关键定理
items.summary_en: A longstanding hypothesis held that some problems would always remain difficult for computers to solve quickly. The report says OpenAI disproved that hypothesis through a development in AI-generated mathematics, using the example of solving very large Sudoku puzzles to explain the result. If the result holds up, it could point to radically more efficient ways of solving certain computational problems.
items.summary_zh: 一项长期存在的假设认为，有些问题无论如何都不可能让计算机快速解决。报道称，OpenAI 通过 AI 生成数学领域的一项进展推翻了这一假设，并以解决超大型数独谜题为例解释其意义。如果这一结果经得起验证，它可能指向解决某些计算问题的全新高效方法。

items.title_en: What Makes UltraSMR Different?
items.title_zh: UltraSMR 有何不同？
items.summary_en: The piece asks what distinguishes UltraSMR from other technologies. It focuses on the characteristics that make UltraSMR different.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨 UltraSMR 与其他技术有何不同。内容聚焦于使 UltraSMR 区别于其他方案的特征。

items.title_en: Tristan Buckmaster Claims Proof of Unforced Navier Stokes and Unforced Euler
items.title_zh: Tristan Buckmaster 声称证明了无外力 Navier–Stokes 方程和无外力 Euler 方程
items.summary_en: Tristan Buckmaster has posted write-ups claiming proofs for the unforced Euler and Navier–Stokes equations. He says the Navier–Stokes write-up is unpolished and heavily assisted by language models. According to the post, once a numerical profile is available, the proof follows a familiar computer-assisted route.
items.summary_zh: Tristan Buckmaster 发布了声称证明无外力 Euler 方程和无外力 Navier–Stokes 方程的文稿。他表示，Navier–Stokes 文稿尚未打磨完成，并大量借助了语言模型。根据其说明，在获得数值剖面后，证明会沿用一条熟悉的计算机辅助路径。

items.title_en: An FBI agent called a Claude user about his chats
items.title_zh: 一名 FBI 探员因用户的 Claude 聊天记录致电联系对方
items.summary_en: An FBI agent called a Claude user about the user’s chats.
items.summary_zh: 一名 FBI 探员因一名 Claude 用户的聊天记录致电联系了该用户。

items.title_en: Show HN: Compile the same source for GPUs and CPUs
items.title_zh: Show HN：为 GPU 和 CPU 编译同一份源代码
items.summary_en: The xc language and xcc compiler turn ordinary loops into both multicore CPU code and GPU kernels, targeting formats including MSL, PTX, SPIR-V, and WGSL without requiring an SDK. At runtime, programs benchmark each block on the machine and keep the faster placement. Version 1.0.1 supports Linux, macOS, and Windows on x86-64 and Arm64, and the compiler can also process plain C loops through Clang’s front end.
items.summary_zh: xc 语言及其 xcc 编译器会将普通循环编译为多核 CPU 代码和 GPU 内核，支持 MSL、PTX、SPIR-V 和 WGSL 等格式，且无需安装 SDK。程序运行时会在当前机器上测试每个代码块，并选择更快的执行位置。1.0.1 版本支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 上的 x86-64 与 Arm64，编译器还可以通过 Clang 前端处理普通 C 循环。

items.title_en: Latent Lattice Language Models
items.title_zh: 潜在晶格语言模型
items.summary_en: Latent Lattice Language Models add persistent, per-layer horizontal latent streams alongside the usual vertical residual stream. These recurrent states directly condition attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation, and decoding. In experiments with Transformers trained on 20 billion FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406-million-parameter Lattice model reduced validation per-token results, although the supplied excerpt cuts off before giving the full metric. The approach increases computational capacity by maintaining more active internal states across tokens.
items.summary_zh: 潜在晶格语言模型在传统的垂直残差流之外，加入了按层设置、可持续存在的水平潜变量流。这些循环状态会直接影响注意力、KV 缓存写入、MLP 计算和解码。在使用 200 亿个 FineWeb-Edu token 训练的 Transformer 实验中，一个 4.06 亿参数的 Lattice 模型降低了验证阶段的单 token 指标，但现有摘录未提供完整数值。该方法通过在 token 之间维持更多活跃内部状态来提升计算容量。

items.title_en: Free alternative TV network built from the Internet Archive's forgotten videos
items.title_zh: 用互联网档案馆遗忘的视频打造免费替代电视网
items.summary_en: The project provides synchronized 24/7 channels built from forgotten videos in the Internet Archive. It is designed to resemble cable television, but with a deliberately stranger selection of programming.
items.summary_zh: 该项目利用互联网档案馆中被遗忘的视频，提供全天候同步播放的频道。它模仿有线电视的形式，但节目选择更加古怪。

items.title_en: Nature-Based Sanitation. Cihuatlán: A Large-Scale Artificial Wetland
items.title_zh: 自然基础卫生设施：Cihuatlán 的大型人工湿地
items.summary_en: The project concerns nature-based sanitation in Cihuatlán through a large-scale constructed wetland. Further details about its design or results are not available here.
items.summary_zh: 该项目关注在 Cihuatlán 通过大型人工湿地实现基于自然的卫生处理。现有信息未提供其设计或效果的更多细节。

items.title_en: Reverse Engineering my cat's litter box
items.title_zh: 逆向工程我家猫的猫砂盆
items.summary_en: The author reverse-engineered an Android app and recreated its signed HTTP requests to communicate with an automated litter box. The project aims to integrate the device with Home Assistant and eventually use presence sensors to start cleaning cycles when the cat is elsewhere. The protocol includes several layers of binary messages, including a four-byte field.
items.summary_zh: 作者通过逆向 Android 应用并重建签名 HTTP 请求，使自己能够与自动猫砂盆通信。该项目的目标是将设备接入 Home Assistant，并最终利用存在传感器在猫离开后启动清洁周期。其通信协议包含多层二进制消息，其中包括一个四字节字段。

items.title_en: Teenage Engineering EP/BC–1 professional CD player
items.title_zh: Teenage Engineering EP/BC–1 专业 CD 播放器
items.summary_en: The EP/BC–1 is a professional CD player from Teenage Engineering.
items.summary_zh: EP/BC–1 是 Teenage Engineering 推出的一款专业 CD 播放器。

items.title_en: Show HN: I made a PS1 style racing game
items.title_zh: Show HN：我制作了一款 PS1 风格的赛车游戏
items.summary_en: A developer built a retro racing game styled after the original PlayStation with help from ChatGPT. The project was created during a week when the developer was bored with work and is being shared for feedback.
items.summary_zh: 一名开发者在 ChatGPT 的帮助下制作了一款采用初代 PlayStation 风格的复古赛车游戏。该项目是在工作感到无聊的一周内完成的，现已公开征求反馈。

items.title_en: Horizon Labs Report
items.title_zh: Horizon Labs 报告
items.summary_en: The Horizon Labs report lists researchers affiliated with EPFL, the ELLIS Institute Tübingen, the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Exponential Security Labs, the University of Tübingen, the UK Government, and Imperial College London.
items.summary_zh: Horizon Labs 报告列出了来自 EPFL、图宾根 ELLIS 研究所、马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所、Exponential Security Labs、图宾根大学、英国政府和帝国理工学院的研究人员。

items.title_en: Younger adults more likely to say acceptable to wear T-shirts&sweatpants to work
items.title_zh: 年轻人更可能认为上班穿 T 恤和运动裤可以接受
items.summary_en: A YouGov survey found that Americans disagree substantially about acceptable office clothing, especially T-shirts, sandals, and shorts. While 54% consider men's T-shirts acceptable, 34% consider them unacceptable; only 28% approve of men's shorts, compared with 61% who disapprove. Men are also more likely than women to say that shorts and baseball caps are acceptable for men at the office.
items.summary_zh: YouGov 的调查发现，美国人对办公室着装的接受范围存在明显分歧，尤其是在 T 恤、凉鞋和短裤方面。54% 的人认为男士穿 T 恤可以接受，34% 认为不可接受；只有 28% 接受男士穿短裤，61% 表示不接受。相比女性，男性更可能认为男士在办公室穿短裤和棒球帽可以接受。

items.title_en: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1k× Faster Than Looped Models
items.title_zh: 经典能量模型比循环模型推理快 1000 倍
items.summary_en: The paper introduces CRAM, a learned version of a Hopfield and Tank energy function, as an alternative to looped reasoning models. CRAM solved 99.996% of Sudoku-Extreme and 100% of Maze-Unique test puzzles, with reported training times of 42 ms and 132 ms on one GPU. It matched the highest accuracy of baseline looped models on Sudoku-Extreme while using at least 282 times fewer inference FLOPs, though the authors caution that simple puzzles may not measure reasoning scalability well.
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 CRAM——一种基于 Hopfield 和 Tank 能量函数的学习模型，用来替代循环式推理模型。CRAM 在 Sudoku-Extreme 测试中的解题率为 99.996%，在 Maze-Unique 中达到 100%，在单块 GPU 上报告的训练时间分别为 42 毫秒和 132 毫秒。在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到循环模型基线的最高准确率时，它至少少使用 282 倍推理 FLOPs；不过作者提醒，过于简单的谜题可能无法有效衡量推理的可扩展性。

items.title_en: Localcode, open source agentic coding on your Mac with one command
items.title_zh: Localcode：一条命令在 Mac 上运行开源智能编码
items.summary_en: Localcode is presented as an agentic coding tool that runs local models on a Mac. The project is open source and can be upgraded with a uv pip install command.
items.summary_zh: Localcode 是一款在 Mac 上运行本地模型的智能编码工具。该项目采用开源方式，并可通过一条 uv pip install 命令升级。

items.title_en: Celliad – a daily Excel game (French)
items.title_zh: Celliad：每日一题的 Excel 游戏（法语）
items.summary_en: Celliad is a daily Excel game in French with six rounds and up to 5,000 points per round. It tests spreadsheet skills involving incorrect cells, shortcuts, and errors, while awarding partial credit for near-misses. Players can also practice with six questions from a single category outside the daily score.
items.summary_zh: Celliad 是一款法语每日 Excel 游戏，共六轮，每轮最高 5,000 分。游戏测试错误单元格、快捷键和错误处理等表格技能，接近正确答案也能获得部分分数。玩家还可以在每日成绩之外，连续练习同一类别的六道题。

items.title_en: Context-Generic Programming v0.8.0 – Pluggable trait implementations for Rust
items.title_zh: Context-Generic Programming v0.8.0：Rust 的可插拔 trait 实现
items.summary_en: Context-Generic Programming v0.8.0 adds the cargo-cgp diagnostics tool, expanded documentation, and namespace groups for component wiring. cargo-cgp translates macro-generated compile errors into explanations framed around the developer’s code, including missing fields required by a provider. Namespace groups let applications select providers for an entire component group through one wiring entry, while CGP remains a stable-Rust library with compile-time pluggable trait implementations.
items.summary_zh: Context-Generic Programming v0.8.0 新增 cargo-cgp 诊断工具、扩展文档，以及用于组件连接的命名空间组。cargo-cgp 会将宏生成的编译错误转化为围绕开发者代码的解释，例如指出提供者所需但类型中缺失的字段。命名空间组允许应用通过一个连接入口为整个组件组选择提供者；CGP 仍是一个基于稳定版 Rust、支持编译期可插拔 trait 实现的库。

items.title_en: The MisAnthropic Statement
items.title_zh: 《反 Anthropic 声明》
items.summary_en: A coalition of signatories accuses Anthropic of presenting itself as an AI-safety company while racing to build recursively self-improving AI. The statement claims that the company has weakened its safety commitments and promoted regulations serving its own interests.
items.summary_zh: 一批联署者指责 Anthropic 一边将自己定位为 AI 安全公司，一边竞相开发能够递归自我改进的 AI。声明称，该公司已经削弱安全承诺，并推动有利于自身利益的监管。

items.title_en: What should AAA game devs do
items.title_zh: AAA 游戏开发者该做什么
items.summary_en: The recommendation for AAA game developers is to go broad rather than tall and to try many approaches. It argues that industry leaders do not know what will come next, and that uncertainty is acceptable.
items.summary_zh: 文章建议 AAA 游戏开发者扩大探索范围，而不是只在单一方向上纵向深入，并尝试各种方案。文章认为，行业领导者并不知道未来会发生什么，而承认这种不确定性并无不可。

items.title_en: South Korea education minister resigns over exam cheating scandal
items.title_zh: 韩国教育部长因考试作弊丑闻辞职
items.summary_en: South Korean Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned over an exam-cheating scandal that shocked the country. He took full responsibility for confusion caused by last-minute measures intended to stop AI-assisted cheating during the annual Suneung college entrance exam. The measures created chaos during Thursday’s test.
items.summary_zh: 韩国教育部长崔教镇因震动全国的考试作弊丑闻辞职。他为在年度大学入学考试“修能”期间阻止 AI 辅助作弊而采取的临时措施所造成的混乱承担全部责任。这些措施导致周四的考试现场陷入混乱。

items.title_en: Pakistan's solar revolution is so successful the national grid is lagging behind
items.title_zh: 巴基斯坦的太阳能革命过于成功，国家电网已落后
items.summary_en: The installation of private solar panels has increased solar power’s share of Pakistan’s electricity from 1% to 28%. The report illustrates this shift through a rural Punjab household whose most prized possession is a 340-watt solar panel kept under the bed. The rapid growth of household solar is leaving the national grid struggling to keep pace.
items.summary_zh: 居民安装私人太阳能板，使太阳能在巴基斯坦电力结构中的占比从 1% 提升至 28%。报道以旁遮普省农村一个家庭为例，家中最珍贵的物品是一块藏在床下的 340 瓦太阳能板。家庭太阳能的快速增长，正让国家电网难以跟上变化。

items.title_en: When Everything Has Changed, What Do We Do Next?
items.title_zh: 一切都变了之后，我们接下来怎么办？
items.summary_en: The essay examines how the technology industry and its work have been reshaped by hyperscalers such as Microsoft and Meta, along with AI companies including OpenAI and Anthropic. It argues that these changes matter regardless of whether the AI investment boom succeeds or fails. The author considers how people in the industry might navigate the resulting uncertainty.
items.summary_zh: 文章考察了 Microsoft、Meta 等云计算巨头以及 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 AI 公司如何重塑科技行业和相关工作。作者认为，无论 AI 投资热潮最终成功还是失败，这些变化都已经产生影响。文章进一步思考行业从业者应如何应对由此带来的不确定性。

items.title_en: IBM Links Two Nighthawk R3 Chips to Make a 1,040-Qubit Quantum System
