items.title_zh: IBM 将两块 Nighthawk R3 芯片连接成 1040 量子比特系统
items.summary_en: IBM is linking two Nighthawk R3 chips to create a quantum system with 1,040 qubits. The effort is part of the company's broader push toward a fault-tolerant quantum computer targeted for 2029. The Nighthawk line uses 120-qubit processors with a square-lattice architecture, while the Nighthawk r2 added a reset system capable of more than 100,000 circuits per second.
items.summary_zh: IBM 正将两块 Nighthawk R3 芯片连接起来，构建一个拥有 1040 个量子比特的量子系统。这项工作是其推动在 2029 年实现容错量子计算机计划的一部分。Nighthawk 系列采用拥有 120 个量子比特的处理器和方格架构，而 Nighthawk r2 增加了新的重置系统，吞吐量可超过每秒 10 万个电路。

items.title_en: Nvidia says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
items.title_zh: 英伟达称无意让黄仁勋复任 CEO
items.summary_en: At Nvidia's fiscal Q3 2027 earnings call, board chair Harvey Jones said the board unanimously accepted former CEO Jensen Huang's resignation. Jones added that the board does not intend to reinstate Huang as CEO. Nvidia also said it would not take additional questions about Huang's departure during the call.
items.summary_zh: 在英伟达 2027 财年第三季度财报电话会上，董事长哈维·琼斯表示，董事会一致接受前 CEO 黄仁勋的辞职。琼斯补充说，董事会无意让黄仁勋复任 CEO。英伟达还表示，电话会期间不会再回答有关黄仁勋离任的问题。

items.title_en: Show HN: Radiotherapy Delivery Demo
items.title_zh: Show HN：放疗递送演示
items.summary_en: A treatment-planning demo uses WebAssembly and WebGPU to display two-dimensional and three-dimensional treatment delivery and to run GPU-accelerated dose calculations in the browser. The system is intended to make treatment-planning technology more accessible and easier to explain to patients. It was originally developed at UT Southwestern Medical Center with three.js, then rewritten by Neuralrad using Rust and a WebAssembly module.
items.summary_zh: 这款放疗计划演示使用 WebAssembly 和 WebGPU，在浏览器中显示二维、三维治疗递送，并运行 GPU 加速的剂量计算。该系统旨在提高治疗计划技术的可访问性，也让治疗计划流程更容易向患者解释。它最初由 UT Southwestern Medical Center 使用 three.js 开发，之后由 Neuralrad 以 Rust 和 WebAssembly 模块重写。

items.title_en: Show HN: Robotics needs better CAD, so I wrote a B-rep kernel and 3,487 tests
items.title_zh: Show HN：机器人需要更好的 CAD，因此我写了一个 B-rep 内核和 3,487 个测试
items.summary_en: Springcraft has released springrep, a dependency-free B-rep kernel written in safe Rust, along with the MIT-licensed brep-conformance test suite. The kernel supports operations including fillets, sweeps, lofts, shells, offsets, STEP, and exact geometric queries. The 3,487-test suite exposed hundreds of bugs and edge cases, and springrep now passes all of its tests.
items.summary_zh: Springcraft 发布了用安全 Rust 编写、无依赖的 B-rep 内核 springrep，以及采用 MIT 许可证的 brep-conformance 测试套件。该内核支持圆角、扫掠、放样、壳、偏移、STEP 和精确几何查询等操作。包含 3,487 个测试的套件发现了数百个错误和边界情况，目前 springrep 已通过全部测试。

items.title_en: US judge rejects CFTC emergency bid to block New York from policing Kalshi
items.title_zh: 美国法官驳回 CFTC 阻止纽约监管 Kalshi 的紧急申请
items.summary_en: A US judge rejected the Commodity Futures Trading Commission's emergency request to stop New York from policing Kalshi. The ruling leaves New York's ability to regulate Kalshi unblocked.
items.summary_zh: 美国一名法官驳回了商品期货交易委员会提出的紧急申请，该申请旨在阻止纽约州监管 Kalshi。裁决意味着纽约监管 Kalshi 的权限未被阻止。

items.title_en: Uber says hackers stole information on close to 150k DLs during data breach
items.title_zh: Uber 称黑客在数据泄露中窃取了近 15 万份驾照信息
items.summary_en: Uber said personal and driver’s-license information belonging to nearly 150,000 drivers was stolen in an October breach at Fireworks AI, one of its technology providers. The provider notified Uber on October 9 that attackers had broken in and stolen internal credentials, which were then used to access Uber’s data. Uber disclosed the incident in notices filed with several U.S. attorneys general.
items.summary_zh: Uber 表示，近 15 万名司机的个人信息和驾照信息在其技术供应商 Fireworks AI 10 月发生的数据泄露中被窃取。该供应商于 10 月 9 日通知 Uber，攻击者入侵系统并窃取了内部凭据，随后利用这些凭据访问 Uber 数据。Uber 已在提交给多州美国检察长的通知中披露此事。

items.title_en: Show HN: OpenTodo – a self-hosted, local-first task manager in one Go binary
items.title_zh: Show HN：OpenTodo——单个 Go 二进制文件实现的自托管、本地优先任务管理器
items.summary_en: OpenTodo is a free, open-source task manager that can be self-hosted or hosted for users. It works on phones and computers, supports offline use and shared lists, and keeps users’ data under their control. The project is designed as a local-first alternative to subscription-based task applications.
items.summary_zh: OpenTodo 是一款免费开源的任务管理器，用户可以自行部署或交由他人托管。它支持手机和电脑、离线使用以及与家人或团队共享列表，并让用户掌控自己的数据。该项目旨在提供一种本地优先的替代方案，减少对订阅制任务应用的依赖。

items.title_en: Atomic Nuked Veteran
items.title_zh: 原子弹爆炸幸存老兵
items.summary_en: A post about an “Atomic Nuked Veteran” questions how applicants qualify for a related license plate. The discussion jokingly asks whether eligibility is verified with a Geiger counter, while the available excerpt does not provide the actual verification process.
items.summary_zh: 一篇关于“原子弹爆炸幸存老兵”的文章讨论相关车牌申请人如何证明资格。讨论开玩笑地问是否会用盖革计数器进行验证，但现有摘录没有说明实际审核方式。

items.title_en: Masullo on the Riemann Hypothesis
items.title_zh: Masullo 论黎曼猜想
items.summary_en: On November 20, 2026, two attempts to prove the Riemann Hypothesis appeared. One, by Levent Alpöge working with Claude, consists mainly of 17 million lines of Lean code; the other is Alessandro Masullo's 940-page handwritten manuscript, posted by Ravi Vakil.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 20 日，出现了两份试图证明黎曼猜想的工作。一份由 Levent Alpöge 与 Claude 合作完成，主要由 1700 万行 Lean 代码构成；另一份是 Alessandro Masullo 撰写的 940 页手稿，由 Ravi Vakil 发布。

items.title_en: String Art Font (2017)
items.title_zh: 字符串艺术字体（2017）
items.summary_en: The project creates typefaces from geometric string-art patterns wrapped around fixed pins. One font uses exactly 1,500 wraps of a single string around 200 pins, while simpler variants use 22 pins. The fonts can be animated to show the string’s path as each letter is constructed.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目利用围绕固定针脚缠绕的几何弦线图案制作字体。其中一种字体在 200 个针脚上用同一根线缠绕 1,500 次，另一些简化版本使用 22 个针脚。字体还可以动态展示每个字母构造时弦线的移动路径。

items.title_en: The Opportunivore's Dilemma
items.title_zh: 机会主义杂食者的困境
items.summary_en: After an SUV struck two elk near Yellowstone, local resident Brian Ertel helped the shaken but unharmed driver escape the wreck and secured the scene with arriving responders and students. One elk was dead and the other mortally wounded, so Ertel used a copper-jacketed bullet to end the injured animal’s suffering while avoiding lead contamination. The episode sets up a broader account of wildlife, roads, and human responses to animals near developed areas.
items.summary_zh: 一辆 SUV 在黄石国家公园附近撞上两只麋鹿后，当地居民 Brian Ertel 帮助受惊但未受伤的司机脱离残骸，并与赶到的救援人员和学生一起控制现场。一只麋鹿当场死亡，另一只伤势致命；Ertel 使用铜制弹头结束了受伤动物的痛苦，以避免铅污染。这一事件引出了对野生动物、道路以及人类如何应对出现在开发区域附近的动物的更广泛叙述。

items.title_en: New Species of Giant Fungus Discovered in China Grows Up to 20 Inches Tall
items.title_zh: 中国发现新巨型真菌，最高可长到 20 英寸
items.summary_en: Researchers from the Kunming Institute of Botany discovered a new fungus species in China's Yunnan Province and named it Dianjunus rex. The ascomycete forms unusually large fruiting bodies, reaching up to 20 inches in height and nearly five pounds in weight. Its name refers to the ancient Dian Kingdom and the Chinese pronunciation of fungus. The species is notable for producing the largest recorded masses of mushroom-like fruiting bodies.
items.summary_zh: 中国科学院昆明植物研究所的研究团队在云南省发现了一种新真菌，并将其命名为 Dianjunus rex。它属于子囊菌，能形成异常巨大的子实体，高度可达 20 英寸，重量接近 5 磅。其名称取自古滇国以及“真菌”一词的中文读音。该物种因产生目前记录中最大的蘑菇状子实体而引人注目。

items.title_en: Teskooano: A 3D N-body simulator in the browser
items.title_zh: Teskooano：浏览器中的三维 N 体模拟器
items.summary_en: Teskooano is a browser-based simulator for exploring the Solar System and procedurally generated star systems. It uses real N-body physics and can display the Solar System in its current arrangement.
items.summary_zh: Teskooano 是一个基于浏览器的模拟器，用于探索太阳系和程序生成的恒星系统。它采用真实的 N 体物理，并能展示当前布局的太阳系。

items.title_en: Cincinnati Zoo's Fiona the hippo has died, days after ingesting a visitor's hat
items.title_zh: 辛辛那提动物园的河马 Fiona 去世，数日前曾吞下游客的帽子
items.summary_en: Fiona, a hippopotamus at the Cincinnati Zoo, died days after ingesting a visitor’s hat.
items.summary_zh: 辛辛那提动物园的河马 Fiona 去世，数日前曾吞下一名游客的帽子。

items.title_en: 0rwx – A simple model of AI usage, inspired by Unix permissions
items.title_zh: 0rwx：受 Unix 权限启发的简易 AI 使用模型
items.summary_en: 0rwx proposes a simple model and labeling system for discussing AI usage, inspired by Unix permissions. Its four levels are based not necessarily on the tools used, but on the user's ability to scrutinize generated work.
items.summary_zh: 0rwx 提出了一种受 Unix 权限启发的简易 AI 使用模型和标注体系。它的四个等级不一定取决于所使用的工具，而取决于用户审查生成内容的能力。

items.title_en: Can I borrow a lunar rover? (2013)
items.title_zh: 我能借用一辆月球车吗？（2013）
items.summary_en: The item asks whether it is possible to borrow a lunar rover. No further details about the question or its answer are established here.
items.summary_zh: 该条目提出了是否可以借用一辆月球车的问题。现有信息未说明问题的具体背景或答案。

items.title_en: Creativity in Negative Space
items.title_zh: 负空间中的创造力
items.summary_en: The essay argues that AI is strongest in “positive space,” where culture has already established patterns and categories. It contrasts this with human creativity, which it places in “negative space”: gaps that have not yet been named. The discussion comes as AI becomes increasingly capable of summarization, boilerplate code, translation, and image generation.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，AI 最擅长的是“正空间”，也就是文化已经建立模式和分类的领域。文章将其与人类创造力对比，认为人类创造力存在于尚未被命名的“负空间”中。这样的讨论出现在 AI 日益擅长总结、编写样板代码、翻译和生成图像之际。

items.title_en: Hackers Hijack Websites of CNN, BBC and Major Banks
items.title_zh: 黑客劫持 CNN、BBC 和多家大型银行的网站
items.summary_en: A breach of a single platform reportedly allowed hackers to mine data from 178 websites across several industries. The affected sites included media organizations CNN and BBC as well as major banks. The incident was described as part of a broader week of cyber disruption affecting major companies.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，黑客通过入侵一个平台，从多个行业的 178 个网站获取数据。受影响的网站包括 CNN、BBC 等媒体机构以及多家大型银行。该事件被描述为一周网络混乱的一部分，波及多家大型企业。

items.title_en: LZ-RDO lands in ARM's astc-encoder
items.title_zh: LZ-RDO 已进入 Arm 的 astc-encoder
items.summary_en: The author’s rate-distortion optimization work for ASTC has been merged into Arm’s astc-encoder in pull request 781. Fabian “ryg” Giesen added optimizations and improvements to the original implementation before landing it. The change is now part of the public compressor implementation.
items.summary_zh: 作者为 ASTC 开发的率失真优化工作已通过第 781 号拉取请求合并进 Arm 的 astc-encoder。Fabian“ryg”Giesen 在原始实现基础上加入了优化和改进，随后完成合并。该改动现已成为公开压缩器实现的一部分。

items.title_en: Older people with religious or spiritual beliefs enjoy better quality of life
items.title_zh: 有宗教或精神信仰的老年人生活质量更高
items.summary_en: A study of more than 5,000 people found that older adults who are religious or spiritual reported a better quality of life than those without faith in a higher power.
items.summary_zh: 一项针对 5,000 多人的研究发现，有宗教或精神信仰的老年人生活质量高于不相信更高力量的人。

items.title_en: FBI Criminal Database Hacked
items.title_zh: FBI 刑事数据库遭黑客入侵
items.summary_en: The FBI is investigating a reported major cyberattack against the National Crime Information Center, a national law-enforcement database. The NCIC contains sensitive records on fugitives, missing people, criminal histories, and stolen property. President Donald Trump said he had been briefed on the incident and described it as “not good.”
items.summary_zh: FBI 正在调查一起据报针对国家犯罪信息中心（NCIC）的重大网络攻击。NCIC 存有关于逃犯、失踪人员、犯罪记录和被盗财产的敏感执法数据。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示自己已听取事件简报，并称情况“不妙”。

items.title_en: Jon Stewart's 2004 appearance on Crossfire
items.title_zh: Jon Stewart 2004 年做客《Crossfire》
items.summary_en: On October 15, 2004, Jon Stewart appeared on CNN's Crossfire with hosts Tucker Carlson and Paul Begala. He criticized the show as lacking nuance and promoting partisan hackery, and the widely circulated exchange was followed three months later by Crossfire's cancellation and Carlson's dismissal. Commentators differ on how much influence Stewart's appearance had.
items.summary_zh: 2004 年 10 月 15 日，Jon Stewart 参加了 CNN《Crossfire》，主持人为 Tucker Carlson 和 Paul Begala。他批评节目缺乏细腻观点、沦为党派化攻击平台；这段交锋广泛传播，三个月后《Crossfire》停播，Carlson 被解雇。评论人士对于 Stewart 的出场究竟产生了多大影响仍有不同看法。

items.title_en: What Happened in Fall 2026: AI and P vs. NP
items.title_zh: 2026 年秋季发生了什么：AI 与 P vs. NP
items.summary_en: NP problem. It focuses on developments linking artificial intelligence with attempts to address the famous complexity question.
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾了 2026 年秋季与 AI 和 P vs. NP 问题相关的事件。内容聚焦于人工智能发展与解决这一著名复杂性问题的尝试之间的联系。

items.title_en: Exascale fusion simulation team named finalist for 2026 Gordon Bell Prize
items.title_zh: 超大规模聚变模拟团队入围 2026 年戈登·贝尔奖
items.summary_en: An exascale fusion simulation team has been named a finalist for the 2026 Gordon Bell Prize. The accompanying visualization shows the tritium breeding zone with the magnetic field switched off, depicting turbulent flow with warmer colors representing higher normalized speeds.
items.summary_zh: 一个开展超大规模聚变模拟的团队入围了 2026 年戈登·贝尔奖。配图展示了关闭磁场后的氚增殖区，其中呈现出湍流；较暖的颜色代表更高的归一化流速。

items.title_en: A live service duress prototype
items.title_zh: 实时服务型胁迫原型
items.summary_en: Vault-share is a self-hosted, invite-only encrypted file-sharing application built with Flask. Each file uses its own AES-256-GCM key, which is sealed separately for every authorized reader using HPKE, while uploads are signed and integrity-checked. The prototype also supports duress passwords that reveal separate cover vaults and can require a USB flash drive for the master key.
items.summary_zh: Vault-share 是一个基于 Flask 的自托管、仅限邀请的加密文件共享应用。每个文件使用独立的 AES-256-GCM 密钥，并通过 HPKE 分别封装给每位获授权的读取者；上传内容还会进行签名和完整性校验。该原型还支持在胁迫密码下打开独立的伪装保险库，并可要求使用 USB 闪存盘保存主密钥。

items.title_en: US drivers pay an extra $12B a year for digital car repairs
items.title_zh: 美国司机每年为数字化汽车维修多付 120 亿美元
items.summary_en: Modern vehicles require software tools for repairs, and the associated subscriptions and charges raise costs for mechanics and customers. A Public Interest Research Group investigation estimates that computerization has inflated US car repair costs by $12 billion annually.
items.summary_zh: 现代汽车维修需要使用软件工具，相关订阅和费用推高了维修厂与消费者的成本。公共利益研究组织的一项调查估计，汽车数字化每年使美国维修费用增加 120 亿美元。

items.title_en: Merkle Tree Certificates
items.title_zh: 默克尔树证书
items.summary_en: A proposed X.509 certificate design integrates public certificate logging in the style of Certificate Transparency. Merkle Tree certificates aim to reduce logging overhead for shorter-lived certificates and large post-quantum signatures while retaining comparable security properties. An optional size optimization can eliminate signatures, but only for up-to-date relying parties and older certificates.
items.summary_zh: 这份提案描述了一种将类似证书透明度的公开日志机制整合进 X.509 证书的设计。默克尔树证书旨在降低短生命周期证书和大型后量子签名带来的日志开销，同时保持可比的安全属性。可选的尺寸优化可以省略签名，但仅适用于使用最新软件的依赖方和较旧的证书。

items.title_en: Show HN: Professor Euler – Offline math desk, 300-function CAS, workbooks
items.title_zh: Show HN：Professor Euler——离线数学桌面、300 项 CAS 与练习册
items.summary_en: Professor Euler is a free study app for adults that runs on Android phones, tablets, and Windows. It provides a mathematics curriculum from Grade 6 through a master’s degree, with support for handwriting, user-provided AI providers, textbooks, and lectures. Topics include explanations, worked examples, common mistakes, summaries, exercises, review rounds, and course exams.
items.summary_zh: Professor Euler 是一款免费的成人学习应用，可运行于 Android 手机、平板和 Windows。它提供从六年级到硕士阶段的数学课程，支持手写、用户自带的 AI 服务、教材和讲座。每个主题包含概念讲解、例题、常见错误、总结、练习、复习轮次和课程考试。

items.title_en: Tesla launches FSD v15, targets its biggest weaknesses, from signs to potholes
items.title_zh: 特斯拉发布 FSD v15，重点改善标志识别和坑洼处理等弱项
items.summary_en: Tesla has begun rolling out FSD v15 with improvements to sign detection, pothole handling, and speed control in school zones. The update also adds a live visualization called Reality View. Tesla claims that the system handles safety-critical cases 25 times better, though the excerpt presents this as a company claim.
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉已开始推送 FSD v15，改进内容包括交通标志识别、坑洼处理以及学校区域的速度控制。更新还加入了名为 Reality View 的实时可视化功能。特斯拉声称系统处理安全关键场景的能力提升了 25 倍，但现有内容将其表述为公司方面的说法。

items.title_en: Battery storage in Great Britain: how a grid battery makes money
items.title_zh: 英国电池储能：电网电池如何赚钱
items.summary_en: Grid-scale batteries in Great Britain can earn revenue by buying electricity when it is cheap and selling it when prices rise. They can also provide frequency response, reserve capacity, and availability during periods of high demand. These services operate through separate markets with their own rules and prices, and the article explains how batteries choose between them and allocate risk.
items.summary_zh: 英国的大型电网电池可以在电价低时买入电力、价格上涨时卖出，从中获得收入。它们还可以提供频率响应、备用容量，并在需求高峰时保持可用。这些服务分别对应拥有不同规则和价格的市场，文章解释了电池如何在这些市场之间选择以及如何分配风险。

items.title_en: Show HN: agent-mcts – Monte Carlo tree search on top of Claude Code
items.title_zh: Show HN：agent-mcts——在 Claude Code 之上运行蒙特卡洛树搜索
items.summary_en: agent-mcts is an open-source MIT-licensed harness that applies Monte Carlo Tree Search to coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex CLI. Instead of following one solution path, it explores multiple branches, backtracks from dead ends, and directs more budget toward promising paths. The project has been verified with Claude Code and lists support for other agents.
items.summary_zh: agent-mcts 是一个采用 MIT 许可的开源工具，可将蒙特卡洛树搜索应用于 Claude Code 和 Codex CLI 等编程代理。它不再只沿着一条方案路径前进，而是探索多个分支、从死路回退，并将更多预算投入到有希望的路径上。该项目已通过 Claude Code 验证，并列出了对其他代理的支持情况。

items.title_en: Black high school students sue after AI mistakes Doritos bag for gun
items.title_zh: 黑人高中生起诉：AI 将多力多滋包装袋误认成枪
items.summary_en: The Lawyers’ Committee for Civil Rights Under Law filed a lawsuit on behalf of four current and former Black students in Baltimore County. The suit names Omnilert, Baltimore County Public Schools and personnel, the county police department, and individual officers. It alleges that technological and human errors in an AI weapon-detection surveillance system led to the students’ unlawful detention and search.
items.summary_zh: 美国公民权利法律委员会代表巴尔的摩县四名现任和前任黑人学生提起诉讼。被告包括 Omnilert、巴尔的摩县公立学校及相关人员、县警察部门和个别警员。诉讼称，AI 武器探测监控系统中的技术和人为错误导致这些学生遭到非法拘留和搜查。

items.title_en: Funkycache: A Python library to cache functions in SQLite
items.title_zh: Funkycache：一个用 SQLite 缓存函数的 Python 库
items.summary_en: Funkycache grew out of an SQLite-backed cache created to speed up a static site's build system. Static site generation is well suited to caching because many steps are deterministic and have no side effects, so even millisecond-level savings accumulate across hundreds of pages. The original cache supported getting and setting strings with separate namespaces for different functions.
items.summary_zh: Funkycache 源于一个用于加速静态网站构建系统的 SQLite 缓存。静态网站生成很适合缓存，因为许多步骤都是确定性的且没有副作用，在数百个页面上累积起来，即使每步节省几毫秒也很有价值。最初的缓存支持字符串的读取和写入，并为不同函数提供独立命名空间。

items.title_en: Beyond Floating Point: Next-Generation Computer Arithmetic
items.title_zh: 超越浮点数：下一代计算机算术
items.summary_en: The talk presents posits, a numerical data type designed as a possible replacement for IEEE 754 floating-point numbers. Posits are described as offering larger dynamic range, higher accuracy, simpler exception handling, and no infinity or NaN values, while scaling from two-bit operands to thousands of bits. The design could allow chips, particularly GPUs, to perform more arithmetic per watt with less silicon than comparable floating-point hardware.
items.summary_zh: 演讲介绍了 posit，一种旨在替代 IEEE 754 浮点数的数据类型。Posit 被描述为具有更大的动态范围、更高精度和更简单的异常处理机制，并且不会出现无穷大或 NaN，同时可从 2 位操作数扩展到数千位。与类似的浮点硬件相比，这种设计可能让芯片，尤其是 GPU，以更少的硅面积实现更高的每瓦计算量。

items.title_en: Elementary Applied Topology, 2nd Ed by Robert Ghrist [pdf]
items.title_zh: 《基础应用拓扑学》第二版，Robert Ghrist 著
items.summary_en: The second edition of Robert Ghrist’s “Elementary Applied Topology” is available as a PDF. It is an introductory work on applied topology.
items.summary_zh: Robert Ghrist 所著《基础应用拓扑学》第二版已提供 PDF 版本。这是一本介绍应用拓扑学的入门著作。

items.title_en: Google: AI agent turned a security patch into a exploit with no human help
items.title_zh: Google：AI 代理在无人协助下将安全补丁变成了漏洞利用程序
items.summary_en: Google Threat Intelligence Group said a suspected Russian-speaking operator used an AI agent to turn security patches into working exploits without human involvement. The operation ultimately stole data from victim organizations, and Google described it as a major advance over the previous quarter in autonomous vulnerability discovery and exploitation.
items.summary_zh: Google 威胁情报部门表示，一名疑似讲俄语的操作者使用 AI 代理，在无人参与的情况下将安全补丁转化为可用的漏洞利用程序。该行动最终从受害组织窃取了数据；Google 称，与上一季度相比，这代表攻击者在自主发现和利用漏洞方面取得了显著进展。

items.title_en: A human liver has been kept alive outside the body for a record seven weeks
items.title_zh: 人类肝脏在体外存活七周，创下纪录
items.summary_en: Researchers in Australia claim to have kept a donated human liver alive outside the body for seven weeks using machine perfusion. A team in Sydney led by surgeon and inventor Carlo Pulitano connected the liver to automated pumps and sensors that supplied nutrients and blood and removed waste. The details have not yet been published, but the work could expand possibilities for transplantation and biomedical research.
items.summary_zh: 澳大利亚研究人员声称，利用机器灌注技术让一枚捐赠的人类肝脏在体外存活了七周。由外科医生兼发明家 Carlo Pulitano 领导的悉尼团队，将肝脏连接到自动泵和传感器系统，为其提供营养物和血液并清除废物。具体细节尚未发表，但这项工作可能拓展移植和生物医学研究的空间。

items.title_en: Man's use of synthetic testosterone for cows nearly destroyed his heart
items.title_zh: 男子使用给牛注射的合成睾酮，心脏几乎被毁
items.summary_en: A Massachusetts man experienced years of heart failure, repeated hospitalizations, life support, and specialist testing without revealing that he was taking illicit anabolic-androgenic steroids. One of the substances was approved only for use in animals and is primarily used to increase cattle’s muscle. Doctors warn that similarly life-threatening cases are becoming more common.
items.summary_zh: 一名马萨诸塞州男子多年遭受心力衰竭，反复住院，曾接受生命支持和大量专科检查，但一直没有透露自己在使用非法合成代谢类固醇。其中一种物质仅获准用于动物，主要用于增加牛的肌肉。医生警告，类似的危及生命病例正变得越来越常见。

items.title_en: Waymo stalls in high San Francisco floodwaters during storm
items.title_zh: 暴雨期间，Waymo 自动驾驶汽车在旧金山高位积水中抛锚
items.summary_en: A Waymo vehicle stalled in high floodwaters in San Francisco during a storm.
items.summary_zh: 暴雨期间，一辆 Waymo 自动驾驶汽车在旧金山的高位积水中抛锚。

items.title_en: Running coding agents without handing them my credentials
items.title_zh: 在不给编程代理凭据的情况下运行它们
items.summary_en: The author built lend so remote coding agents can use tools on a laptop only with the user’s approval. The agents run in disposable virtual machines, while SSH keys, the 1Password vault, and authenticated GitHub and cloud CLIs remain on the laptop. The setup allows multiple agents to work while keeping sensitive credentials outside their environments.
items.summary_zh: 作者开发了 lend，让远程编程代理在获得用户批准后使用笔记本电脑上的工具。代理运行在可随时销毁的虚拟机中，而 SSH 密钥、1Password 保管库以及已登录的 GitHub 和云端 CLI 都留在笔记本电脑上。这种设置让多个代理可以并行工作，同时将敏感凭据隔离在代理环境之外。

items.title_en: Nvidia Beats Estimates, Raises Guidance After Huang's Ouster
items.title_zh: 英伟达业绩超预期，在黄仁勋被罢免后上调指引
items.summary_en: Nvidia beat analysts' estimates and raised its guidance after Jensen Huang's ouster. No further figures or details about the results are established here.
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋被罢免后，英伟达业绩超出预期并上调了指引。现有信息未提供具体业绩数据或更多细节。

items.title_en: Munich Laser Emits a Beam of Matter Waves (1999)
items.title_zh: 慕尼黑激光器发射物质波束（1999）
items.summary_en: Scientists in Germany developed a laser that emits a continuous beam of matter waves rather than light. The work involved researchers from the Max Planck Institute for Quantum Optics and the University of Munich. It relies on controlling atoms at temperatures close to absolute zero, where their wave nature becomes observable. The result enables unprecedented control over atomic motion.
items.summary_zh: 德国科学家开发出一种发射连续物质波束、而非光束的激光器。研究人员来自马克斯·普朗克量子光学研究所和慕尼黑大学。该技术依赖于在接近绝对零度的温度下控制原子，此时原子的波动性会显现出来。研究成果实现了对原子运动前所未有的控制。

items.title_en: The Specialization of Desire
items.title_zh: 欲望的专业化
items.summary_en: The piece is titled “The Specialization of Desire.” No further details about its subject or argument are established here.
items.summary_zh: 这篇作品的标题是《欲望的专业化》。现有信息未说明其具体主题或论点。

items.title_en: Silicon Valley Is Suffering from Model Collapse
items.title_zh: 硅谷正遭遇模型崩溃
items.summary_en: The item concerns model collapse in Silicon Valley.
items.summary_zh: 该内容关注硅谷正在遭遇的模型崩溃现象。

items.title_en: Talking Venice with Mahesh Subramony at AMD In-Depth
items.title_zh: 在 AMD In-Depth 节目中与 Mahesh Subramony 谈 Venice
items.summary_en: The item is a conversation with Mahesh Subramony about Venice at AMD In-Depth.
items.summary_zh: 该内容是 AMD In-Depth 与 Mahesh Subramony 围绕 Venice 展开的对话。

items.title_en: Arizona grandfather hailed as a hero after finding missing toddler in desert
items.title_zh: 亚利桑那州祖父在沙漠中找到失踪幼童，被誉为英雄
items.summary_en: Jay Stewart joined the search for two-year-old Vella Campillo after she wandered from her front yard into the desert wearing only a diaper. He found her safely curled under a bush within several hours, leading to her rescue, and was later formally recognized as a hero.
items.summary_zh: 两岁的 Vella Campillo 只穿着尿布从家门前走入沙漠后，Jay Stewart 加入了搜寻行动。几小时内，他在一丛灌木下发现蜷缩着的孩子并使她获救，之后被正式誉为英雄。

items.title_en: Kubernetes Is Strengthening Its Position as the AI Platform of Choice
items.title_zh: Kubernetes 正巩固其作为首选 AI 平台的地位
items.summary_en: The supplied material says that Kubernetes-related improvements extend beyond a single release and are also arriving through Karpenter. It frames these developments as part of Kubernetes’s broader role in AI infrastructure. No additional concrete release details are provided.
items.summary_zh: 现有材料指出，Kubernetes 的改进并不局限于单次发布，Karpenter 也在带来其他重要变化。这些发展被视为 Kubernetes 在 AI 基础设施中更广泛作用的一部分。材料未提供更多具体的版本或功能细节。

items.title_en: New open source C4 Diagram tool
items.title_zh: 新的开源 C4 图表工具
items.summary_en: A new open-source tool for creating C4 diagrams has been released. It is intended for documenting software architecture using the C4 model.
items.summary_zh: 一款新的开源 C4 图表工具已经发布。它用于使用 C4 模型记录软件架构。

items.title_en: VB Harness – Make local coding agents verify their own work
items.title_zh: VB Harness——让本地编程智能体自行验证工作
items.summary_en: VB Harness makes local coding agents work in small tasks and isolated copies, using a project’s own checks to validate each change. It supports LM Studio, Ollama, and other OpenAI-compatible models, and retains changes only when type checks, linting, builds, tests, and independent review succeed. The tool is designed to make local agents accountable without trying to make the underlying model smarter.
items.summary_zh: VB Harness 将本地编程智能体的工作拆分为小任务，并在隔离副本中执行，通过项目自身的检查来验证每次修改。它支持 LM Studio、Ollama 和其他兼容 OpenAI API 的模型，只有在类型检查、代码检查、构建、测试和独立复审均通过后才会保留改动。该工具旨在让本地智能体对结果负责，而不是试图直接提升底层模型的智能程度。

items.title_en: Valve says it might have to raise the price of supply-limited Steam Machines
items.title_zh: Valve 称受供应限制的 Steam Machine 可能不得不涨价
items.summary_en: Valve says rising memory and storage costs may force a price change for Steam Machines. Production was already limited because scarce RAM and storage components could not be secured at reasonable prices, and the 2TB model is expected to be especially constrained.
items.summary_zh: Valve 表示，内存和存储成本上涨可能迫使 Steam Machine 调整价格。由于无法以合理价格获得稀缺的内存和存储组件，产品产量此前已受到限制，其中 2TB 型号预计将尤其紧缺。

items.title_en: The Gateless Gate 3D
items.title_zh: 《无门关》3D 版
items.summary_en: The Gateless Gate is a collection of Zen koans assembled by a Chinese monk in 1228. The project turns the cryptic work into a fully interactive modern edition inspired in part by Buddhist art seen at a museum in Turin.
items.summary_zh: 《无门关》是一本由中国僧人于 1228 年编纂的禅宗公案集。该项目将这部充满隐喻的作品制作成完全互动的现代版本，部分灵感来自作者在都灵博物馆看到的佛教艺术。

items.title_en: Waymo Pulls Its Cars from All U.S. Freeways Temporarily
items.title_zh: Waymo 暂时撤下其在美国所有高速公路上的车辆
items.summary_en: Waymo has temporarily pulled its cars from all US freeways. The available information does not establish the reason, duration, or operational scope of the move beyond the title.
items.summary_zh: Waymo 已暂时撤下其在美国所有高速公路上运行的车辆。现有信息未说明这一措施的原因、持续时间或具体运营范围。

items.title_en: Replacing implicit optionals with a None type in TypeDB
items.title_zh: 在 TypeDB 中用 None 类型替代隐式可选值
items.summary_en: TypeDB is changing its optionality semantics from implicit handling to a native None type. The previous behavior automatically unwrapped optional values, which could hide bugs and made it impossible to condition on emptiness. The new design requires explicit handling, similar to Rust or Kotlin.
items.summary_zh: TypeDB 将可选值语义从隐式处理改为原生 None 类型。此前的行为会自动解包可选值，可能掩盖错误，也无法根据值是否为空进行条件判断。新设计要求显式处理，方式类似 Rust 或 Kotlin。

items.title_en: SoftBank explored $1T buyout of SK Hynix
items.title_zh: 软银曾探索以 1 万亿美元收购 SK 海力士
items.summary_en: SoftBank explored a $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix. No further details about the proposal, its status, or the parties’ actions are established here.
items.summary_zh: 软银曾探索以 1 万亿美元收购 SK 海力士。现有信息未说明该提议的更多细节、当前状态或相关各方的后续行动。

items.title_en: Acoustic parameters of bird vocalizations&their perceived pleasantness by humans
items.title_zh: 鸟类鸣声的声学参数及其在人类听来悦耳的程度
items.summary_en: The study examines why some bird sounds are perceived by humans as more pleasant and restorative than others. It focuses on identifying the acoustic parameters associated with that perception.
items.summary_zh: 这项研究考察了为什么有些鸟鸣在人类听来比其他鸟鸣更悦耳、更具恢复性。研究重点是找出与这种感受相关的声学参数。

items.title_en: Pushing WireGuard on macOS to 5 Gbit/s
items.title_zh: 让 macOS 上的 WireGuard 达到 5 Gbit/s
items.summary_en: The project aims to increase WireGuard VPN throughput on macOS to 5 Gbit/s. The work focuses on correct backpressure to avoid packet loss and batching to reduce per-packet overhead. The authors argue that VPN optimization should target Apple and Windows platforms as well as Linux, since enterprise users commonly connect from those systems.
items.summary_zh: 该项目旨在将 macOS 上 WireGuard VPN 的吞吐量提升至 5 Gbit/s。相关工作重点解决避免丢包的正确背压机制，以及降低单包开销的批处理技术。作者认为，VPN 优化不仅应关注 Linux，也应覆盖 Apple 和 Windows 平台，因为企业用户普遍使用这些系统连接网络。

items.title_en: A Zip Archive That Boots Your PC Is Now a Reality
items.title_zh: 能启动电脑的 ZIP 压缩包如今成为现实
items.summary_en: A proof of concept shows that a valid ZIP archive can also function as a bootable disk image on x86 computers. The experimental project preserves compatibility with ordinary archive utilities while allowing the file to boot without extraction.
items.summary_zh: 一项概念验证显示，有效的 ZIP 压缩包也可以在 x86 电脑上充当可启动磁盘镜像。这个实验项目在保留普通压缩包工具兼容性的同时，允许文件无需解压即可启动电脑。

items.title_en: EAX x86 Register Meaning and History
items.title_zh: EAX x86 寄存器的含义与历史
items.summary_en: The piece explains the historical meaning behind the name EAX in x86 assembly. Rather than treating EAX simply as a register, it examines what the letters E, A, and X stand for.
items.summary_zh: 文章解释了 x86 汇编中 EAX 名称背后的历史含义。它不只是将 EAX 视为一个寄存器，而是进一步探讨 E、A 和 X 三个字母的来源。

items.title_en: How the World Draws the World
items.title_zh: 世界如何绘制世界
items.summary_en: The item points to Maps Mania, a blog dedicated to notable interactive digital maps and the tools used to create them. Its focus is on mapping projects and map-making technology.
items.summary_zh: 该项目指向 Maps Mania，这是一个专门介绍优秀数字互动地图及其制作工具的博客。其内容聚焦于地图项目和制图技术。

items.title_en: Expozine at 25: Has the Independent Print Scene Outgrown Expozine?
items.title_zh: Expozine 迎来 25 周年：独立印刷界是否已经超越 Expozine？
items.summary_en: At its 25th edition, Montreal’s Expozine rejected nearly 40% of applicants while ARCMTL launched an online catalogue making more than 10,000 zines easier to find. The fair continues to showcase artists and Montreal’s independent arts and literary culture. Its growth raises questions about how to accommodate an expanding community and preserve its printed artifacts for future generations.
items.summary_zh: 蒙特利尔 Expozine 第 25 届活动拒绝了近 40% 的申请者；与此同时，ARCMTL 推出在线目录，让超过 10,000 本 zine 更容易被找到。该展会继续展示艺术家作品以及蒙特利尔的独立艺术和文学文化。它的发展也引出了如何容纳不断扩大的社群，以及如何为后代保存这些印刷品的问题。

items.title_en: White House removes cyber-security chief after series of tech outages
items.title_zh: 白宫在一系列技术故障后撤换网络安全负责人
items.summary_en: White House National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross was fired after reportedly losing the confidence of Chief of Staff Stephen Miller. Cairncross had held the position for a little over a year. President Donald Trump said the reason was that Cairncross was not “good enough.”
items.summary_zh: 据报道，白宫国家网络安全主任 Sean Cairncross 因失去幕僚长 Stephen Miller 的信任而被解职。Cairncross 担任这一职务的时间略超过一年。总统 Donald Trump 表示，原因是 Cairncross“不够好”。

items.title_en: Give Me Back My Monolith (2019)
items.title_zh: 把我的单体应用还回来（2019）
items.summary_en: The author argues that enthusiasm for microservices may have passed its peak, with some teams reconsidering or reversing migrations from monoliths. Splitting one application into many services introduces new operational and architectural problems that were previously simple. The discussion catalogs those additional responsibilities and argues that a performant monolith can remain a valid choice.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，微服务的热潮可能已经过峰值，一些团队开始重新考虑，甚至逆转从单体应用到微服务的迁移。将一个应用拆成多个服务，会引入许多此前简单的问题和新的运维、架构负担。文章整理了这些额外职责，并指出性能良好的单体应用仍然可以是合理选择。

items.title_en: Unreal Tournament 2004 in the Browser
items.title_zh: 在浏览器中运行《虚幻竞技场 2004》
items.summary_en: Unreal Tournament 2004 can be played in a browser through WebRTC servers listed on the web master list.
items.summary_zh: 《虚幻竞技场 2004》现可在浏览器中运行，并通过 WebRTC 连接网页主服务器列表中的游戏服务器。

items.title_en: Oops All Shells – Stupid Vulnerability Name Generator
items.title_zh: Oops All Shells——愚蠢的漏洞名称生成器
items.summary_en: Oops All Shells is a fictional vulnerability-name generator. Its creators describe it as a satirical response to the marketing-oriented vulnerability naming industry, with no peer review.
items.summary_zh: Oops All Shells 是一个虚构的漏洞名称生成器。创建者称其是在讽刺日益营销化的漏洞命名行业，并明确表示内容未经同行评审。

items.title_en: On The Use of AI-Based Tools to Find Bugs in Open Source Software
items.title_zh: 关于使用 AI 工具寻找开源软件漏洞
items.summary_en: It includes observations from HAProxy lead developer Willy Tarreau about AI-discovered bugs and access to models, while noting that the account reflects the author’s personal experience.
items.summary_zh: 该内容考察了 AI 辅助开源软件安全报告所面临的挑战。文中引用了 HAProxy 首席开发者 Willy Tarreau 对 AI 发现漏洞和模型访问问题的看法，同时说明这些内容代表作者个人经历。

items.title_en: Erectile dysfunction drug could hold promise for Alzheimer's disease
items.title_zh: 勃起功能障碍药物或有望治疗阿尔茨海默病
items.summary_en: Researchers are studying whether drugs developed for erectile dysfunction can also protect the brain. In a large international trial, the experimental drug AR1001 slowed symptom worsening by 31% among people not taking other Alzheimer's drugs, although results across the full trial were less clear.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员正在研究原本用于治疗勃起功能障碍的药物是否也能保护大脑。在一项大型国际试验中，实验性药物 AR1001 使未服用其他阿尔茨海默病药物的人群症状恶化速度减缓了 31%，但完整试验总体结果并不明确。

items.title_en: Forking TuxGuitar into a 17-EDO tab editor
items.title_zh: 将 TuxGuitar 分叉为 17-EDO 制谱编辑器
items.summary_en: TuxGuitar 17EDO is a fork of TuxGuitar 2.1.0 for instruments using 17 equal divisions of the octave. It changes the tab, staff, fretboard, and synthesizer from 12-EDO to 17-EDO, with no 12-EDO mode. The specification is detailed enough for a coding agent to reproduce the changes from a stock checkout.
items.summary_zh: TuxGuitar 17EDO 是面向 17 平均律乐器的 TuxGuitar 2.1.0 分支。它将六线谱、五线谱、指板和合成器全部从 12 平均律改为 17 平均律，并不提供 12 平均律模式。相关规格说明足够详细，编码代理可以据此从原版代码重新实现这些修改。

items.title_en: Previous-Token Prediction Based LLM Inversion for Prompt Reconstruction
items.title_zh: 基于前序 Token 预测的 LLM 逆向：重建提示词
items.summary_en: Researchers propose a black-box method for reconstructing prompts from the outputs of a language model. They train an inverse language model from scratch on synthetic input-output data generated by the target model, using previous-token prediction rather than requiring model weights or logits. The method can sample multiple prompt reconstructions that produce similar responses and is reported to generalize across datasets.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员提出了一种黑盒方法，用于根据语言模型的输出重建提示词。他们利用目标模型生成的合成输入输出数据，从零训练一个逆向语言模型，并采用前序 Token 预测，不需要目标模型的权重或 logits。该方法可以采样多个能产生相似响应的提示词重建结果，并据称能够跨数据集泛化。

items.title_en: From 8-bit Amiga to Synthwave: Original tracks composed on an Amiga in the 90s
items.title_zh: 从 8 位 Amiga 到 Synthwave：90 年代在 Amiga 上创作的原创曲目
items.summary_en: Jean-Paul Vosmeer is an electronic music artist and composer. His work includes Amiga game soundtracks from the early 1990s and newer synthwave releases, available on major streaming platforms.
items.summary_zh: Jean-Paul Vosmeer 是一名电子音乐艺术家和作曲家。他的作品包括 20 世纪 90 年代初创作的 Amiga 游戏配乐，以及后来的 Synthwave 发行作品，现已在主要流媒体平台上线。

items.title_en: The Story of Ministry's Jesus Built My Hotrod
items.title_zh: Ministry《Jesus Built My Hotrod》的故事
items.summary_en: Ministry's “Jesus Built My Hotrod” was finished after a drunken Gibby Haynes entered the studio and babbled improvised nonsense. The resulting song became a major seller and an act of defiance toward the label.
items.summary_zh: Ministry 的《Jesus Built My Hotrod》是在 Gibby Haynes 喝醉后走进录音室、胡乱念出一堆即兴话语之后完成的。这首歌后来大卖，也成为对唱片公司的反抗。

items.title_en: Friselle: The ingenious Italian bread that can last for a year
items.title_zh: Friselle：一年都不会坏的巧妙意大利面包
items.summary_en: Friselle is an Italian bread presented as capable of lasting for a year. The item focuses on this bread’s unusually long shelf life.
items.summary_zh: Friselle 是一种据称可以保存一年的意大利面包。该条目聚焦于这种面包异常持久的保质期。

items.title_en: Eight years of running DocSpring on Convox
items.title_zh: 在 Convox 上运行 DocSpring 的八年
items.summary_en: DocSpring has run on Convox, a Heroku-like PaaS deployed in a customer’s own AWS account, since 2018. The author describes lessons about deployments, Terraform, maintenance, compliance, and AWS costs after migrating from Heroku. Convox provided an application platform out of the box while allowing the team to gradually take over and adapt its Terraform configuration.
items.summary_zh: DocSpring 自 2018 年起一直运行在 Convox 上。Convox 是部署于用户自有 AWS 账户中的 Heroku 式 PaaS。作者总结了从 Heroku 迁移后在部署、Terraform、维护、合规和 AWS 成本方面的经验；Convox 提供了开箱即用的平台，同时让团队逐步接管并调整 Terraform 配置。

items.title_en: The Tech Leadership Blueprint: a practical handbook for engineering leaders
items.title_zh: 《科技领导力蓝图》：工程领导者的实用手册
items.summary_en: The Tech Leadership Blueprint is described as a practical handbook for engineering leaders. No further information about its contents, author, or recommendations is established here.
items.summary_zh: 《科技领导力蓝图》是一部面向工程领导者的实用手册。现有信息未提供其内容、作者或具体建议的更多详情。

items.title_en: Goose Typing – Python Morsels
items.title_zh: 鹅式类型检查
items.summary_en: The piece explains how Python's `isinstance` can be used alongside duck typing. Although `isinstance` checks an object's type, the discussion argues that it can still support duck-typed designs. The combination allows type checking without abandoning Python's focus on behavior.
items.summary_zh: 文章解释了如何在 Python 中将 `isinstance` 与鸭子类型结合使用。虽然 `isinstance` 会检查对象类型，但文中认为它仍可服务于鸭子类型设计。这种组合能够进行类型检查，同时不必放弃 Python 对对象行为的重视。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Cheapest CPU Vms
items.title_zh: Ask HN：最便宜的 CPU 虚拟机
items.summary_en: A user is looking for alternatives to the cheapest CPU virtual machines after reporting that Hetzner’s lowest-priced plans have been out of stock for weeks or months.
items.summary_zh: 由于 Hetzner 最便宜的 CPU 虚拟机套餐已经缺货数周甚至数月，一名用户正在寻找价格同样低廉或更便宜的替代方案。

items.title_en: Dissecting Spring petclinic (Part 2 – Bending the persistence)
items.title_zh: 剖析 Spring Petclinic（第二部分：改造持久化层）
items.summary_en: In the second part of a Spring series, the author replaces Spring Data with JDBI, mostly pure SQL, and simple POJOs for persistence. The change exposes how much work Spring Data and Hibernate or JPA normally handle, while making a data-centric persistence layer harder to keep simple. The author does not consider the redesign an improvement, but a necessary step toward a broader goal involving clearer tests and better understanding of the project.
items.summary_zh: 在 Spring 系列的第二篇中，作者用 JDBI、接近纯 SQL 的实现和简单 POJO 替换了 Spring Data 的持久化方案。这一变化显示出 Spring Data、Hibernate 或 JPA 通常会替开发者承担多少工作，也说明要保持数据导向的持久化层简洁并不容易。作者并不认为这次重构让项目变得更好，而是将其视为实现更大目标、改进测试清晰度和理解项目的必要步骤。

items.title_en: Collisions in Hash Functions
items.title_zh: 哈希函数中的碰撞
items.summary_en: The project presents 123 pairs of different inputs that produce the same hash digest, with the actual bytes available for verification. A hash function is intended to map inputs to short fingerprints without collisions. Showing the colliding inputs makes claims about broken hashes directly checkable.
items.summary_zh: 该项目展示了 123 对生成相同哈希摘要的不同输入，并提供实际字节内容供验证。哈希函数的设计目标是将输入映射为短指纹，同时避免不同输入发生碰撞。公开产生碰撞的输入，可以直接检验哈希函数被攻破的说法。

items.title_en: US National Cyber Director to step down
items.title_zh: 美国国家网络主任将离任
items.summary_en: The U.S. national cyber director is stepping down.
items.summary_zh: 美国国家网络主任将离任。

items.title_en: What we learned operating auth for 1k APIs
items.title_zh: 运营 1000 个 API 身份认证服务的经验
items.summary_en: The post shares production lessons from operating authentication for more than 1,000 APIs. In May 2025, a bug at Nango prevented refreshed credentials from being saved, and the change was reverted in just under two hours. During that window, scheduled jobs refreshed and discarded tokens for hundreds of connections, although most recovered because their old refresh tokens still worked.
items.summary_zh: 文章分享了运营 1000 多个 API 身份认证服务的生产经验。2025 年 5 月，Nango 的一个漏洞导致刷新后的凭证无法保存，相关改动在不到两小时内被回滚。在此期间，定时任务为数百个连接刷新并丢弃了访问令牌和刷新令牌，但大多数连接因旧刷新令牌仍有效而恢复。

items.title_en: Actual Curl Rewrites in Rust
items.title_zh: 真正用 Rust 重写 curl
items.summary_en: The long-standing idea of rewriting curl in Rust has often been treated as a joke or a serious challenge. The author says recent AI capabilities have made it possible for someone to demonstrate such a rewrite. The piece presents an actual Rust rewrite rather than merely revisiting the idea.
items.summary_zh: 长期以来，用 Rust 重写 curl 的想法既常被当作玩笑，也被视为严肃挑战。作者表示，近期的 AI 能力让人们终于能够展示这样的重写成果。文章介绍的是实际的 Rust 重写，而不只是再次讨论这一设想。

items.title_en: Twin films are films with the same or similar plots released with a short time
items.title_zh: 双生电影：在短时间内上映、情节相同或相似的电影
items.summary_en: Twin films are movies with similar plots produced by different studios and released close together. Possible causes include companies developing similar scripts, competition to distribute topical stories, staff movement, industrial espionage, or the circulation of the same screenplay. The term differs from “mockbuster,” which usually refers to a lower-budget film designed to capitalize on interest in a major blockbuster.
items.summary_zh: “双生电影”指由不同制片厂制作、情节相同或相似并在相近时间上映的电影。可能原因包括不同公司同时开发相似剧本、争相发行热门题材、员工流动、工业间谍活动，或同一剧本被提交给多家制片厂。“双生电影”不同于“仿制大片”，后者通常指借助热门大片带来的关注度而制作的低成本电影。

items.title_en: Reviving the Donkey Car with Erlang
items.title_zh: 用 Erlang 复兴 Donkey Car
items.summary_en: The author is reviving the Donkey Car, a small robot car platform, using Erlang-based Nerves and BEAM Bots rather than the original Python project. The hardware includes Raspberry Pis mounted on an RC-car-like vehicle. The project follows recent developments in the Nerves ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 作者正使用基于 Erlang 的 Nerves 和 BEAM Bots 复兴 Donkey Car 这一小型机器人车平台，而不是采用原有的 Python 项目。硬件是在类似遥控车的车辆上安装 Raspberry Pi。该项目利用了 Nerves 生态近期的发展。

items.title_en: Ink2Tex
items.title_zh: Ink2Tex
items.summary_en: Ink2Tex converts handwritten or printed mathematics captured by an iPhone or Android phone into editable LaTeX. It also compiles the result to PDF and can hand it off to Overleaf. The app is intended for lecture notes, worked solutions, exams, whiteboards, and textbook pages.
items.summary_zh: Ink2Tex 可以将 iPhone 或 Android 手机拍摄的手写或印刷数学内容转换为可编辑的 LaTeX。它还会将结果编译为 PDF，并支持交给 Overleaf 使用。该应用面向课堂笔记、解题过程、试卷、白板和教材页面等场景。

items.title_en: Right Code, Wrong Comment: The Pointer Chase Inside Zlib
items.title_zh: 正确的代码，错误的注释：zlib 内部的指针追踪
items.summary_en: A 38-line comment in zlib’s `deflate.c` claims that a shared buffer cannot overwrite unread symbols, but that claim is wrong. An attempted exploit was nevertheless blocked by three hidden Huffman invariants. In release builds, the assertion in `trees.c` is removed, and the relevant routines do not check whether the pending buffer has enough space before writing.
items.summary_zh: zlib 的 `deflate.c` 中一段 38 行的注释声称共享缓冲区不可能覆盖尚未读取的符号，但这一说法是错误的。然而，尝试构造漏洞利用时仍受到三个隐藏的 Huffman 不变量阻碍。在发布版本中，`trees.c` 里的断言会被移除，而相关函数在写入前不会检查 pending 缓冲区是否有足够空间。

items.title_en: AI Will Not Make You Rich (2025)
items.title_zh: AI 不会让你发财（2025）
items.summary_en: The piece argues that AI-driven disruption is real and predictable. The available excerpt provides instructions for downloading the article as an EPUB and sending it to a Kindle or Kindle app.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，AI 带来的颠覆是真实且可预见的。现有内容还提供了将文章下载为 EPUB 并发送到 Kindle 或 Kindle 应用的操作说明。

items.title_en: FailTrace – Reproduce a failed GitHub Actions run locally from its URL
items.title_zh: FailTrace：通过 URL 在本地复现失败的 GitHub Actions 运行
items.summary_en: FailTrace takes the URL of a failed GitHub Actions run and identifies the failed job and step. It matches that failure to the workflow file at the exact commit, extracts the relevant log output, and explains what is needed to reproduce the issue locally. The tool is designed to reduce guesswork when debugging CI failures.
items.summary_zh: FailTrace 接收失败的 GitHub Actions 运行 URL，并找出失败的作业和步骤。它会将失败过程与对应提交中的工作流文件匹配，提取相关日志，并说明在本地复现问题所需的条件。该工具旨在减少调试 CI 失败时的猜测。

items.title_en: White House national cyber director leaving his post
items.title_zh: 白宫国家网络主任将离任
items.summary_en: White House official Sean Cairncross will leave his position as national cyber director. His departure comes as outages have affected Microsoft services, air-traffic-control systems, banks, and the National Security Agency’s internal network over the previous week.
items.summary_zh: 白宫官员 Sean Cairncross 将离任国家网络主任一职。他的离职发生在过去一周多起故障影响微软服务、空中交通管制系统、银行以及美国国家安全局内部网络之际。

items.title_en: Top White House Cybersecurity Official Steps Down
items.title_zh: 白宫最高网络安全官员离职
items.summary_en: A top White House cybersecurity official is stepping down.
items.summary_zh: 白宫一名最高级别的网络安全官员将离职。

items.title_en: UK government forced to disclose secret Apple backdoor order
items.title_zh: 英国政府被迫披露要求苹果提供加密数据的秘密命令
items.summary_en: The U.K. government was ordered to confirm that it issued Apple a secret order demanding access to encrypted customer information. The Investigatory Powers Tribunal rejected the claim that disclosure would harm national security. The ruling is a rare rebuke to the government’s effort to keep the encryption order secret.
items.summary_zh: 英国政府被裁定必须确认其曾向苹果发出秘密命令，要求提供客户的加密信息。英国调查权力法庭驳回了披露该命令会损害国家安全的说法。这一裁决罕见地驳斥了政府试图对加密命令保密的做法。

items.title_en: C64 ultimate firmware 1.2.1 released
items.title_zh: C64 Ultimate 固件 1.2.1 发布
items.summary_en: C64 Ultimate firmware version 1.2.1 has been released. The release concerns firmware for the C64 Ultimate platform.
items.summary_zh: C64 Ultimate 固件 1.2.1 已发布。此次更新面向 C64 Ultimate 平台的固件。

items.title_en: Show HN: 1.499x speedup and 28.5% dynamic energy drop on A40 via BF16 tiling
items.title_zh: Show HN：通过 BF16 分块在 A40 上提速 1.499 倍并降低 28.5% 动态能耗
items.summary_en: The project reports a 1.499× speedup and a 28.5% reduction in dynamic energy on an NVIDIA A40 using BF16 tiling. The supplied benchmark context identifies the GPU as an Ampere A40 with 48 GB of GDDR6 memory and a 300 W TDP. The authors provide raw benchmark outputs and methodology materials for civilian, academic, and commercial research.
items.summary_zh: 该项目报告称，通过 BF16 分块技术，NVIDIA A40 上的性能提升了 1.499 倍，动态能耗降低了 28.5%。基准测试使用的是 Ampere 架构 A40，配备 48 GB GDDR6 显存和 300 W TDP。作者提供了原始基准输出和方法材料，供民用、学术及商业研究使用。

items.title_en: The Weather at Home
items.title_zh: 家中的天气
items.summary_en: The author built Field Guide, a local website that describes current outdoor conditions in plain sentences. It uses readings from a Tempest weather station connected to Home Assistant and replaces a standard WeeWX dashboard of gauges, tables, and summaries. The site is accessible only from the home network or through Tailscale.
items.summary_zh: 作者构建了 Field Guide，这是一个用普通句子描述当前室外状况的本地网站。它使用连接到 Home Assistant 的 Tempest 气象站数据，取代了由仪表盘、表格和汇总组成的标准 WeeWX 页面。该网站只能通过家庭网络或 Tailscale 访问。

items.title_en: Integrals of Polynomials with Galois Group S_p
items.title_zh: 伽罗瓦群为 S_p 的多项式积分
items.summary_en: The work studies integrals over an interval of rational polynomials whose Galois group is the symmetric group S_p for a prime p. It defines the collection of possible integral values and examines whether that set is bounded. It also proves the existence of infinitely many monic, irreducible degree-p polynomials satisfying the Zero Integral Condition.
items.summary_zh: 这项工作研究伽罗瓦群为素数 p 对应的对称群 S_p 的有理系数多项式在区间上的积分。文章定义了所有可能积分值构成的集合，并考察该集合是否有界。文章还证明了满足“零积分条件”的首一不可约 p 次多项式有无穷多个。

items.title_en: Show HN: ADE Index – a sourced and ranked index of 975 agentic coding tools
items.title_zh: Show HN：ADE Index——收录 975 个智能体编程工具的有来源排名索引
items.summary_en: ADE Index catalogs agent workspaces, CLI agents, editors, and builders used for coding agents. Its listings include real screenshots, prices, and release activity, with one entry per product. The index currently describes 383 agent workspaces and supports operating multiple coding agents from desktop and mobile.
items.summary_zh: ADE Index 汇集了用于运行和管理编程智能体的工作区、CLI 智能体、编辑器和构建工具。每个产品条目包含真实截图、价格和发布活动，并实行一产品一条目。目前索引收录了 383 个智能体工作区，并支持在桌面和移动设备上操作多个编程智能体。

items.title_en: Recurrent Interface Networks
items.title_zh: 循环接口网络
items.summary_en: Recurrent Interface Networks are an attention-based architecture that separates core computation from input and output dimensionality. They perform global self-attention over latent tokens and use cross-attention to route information between latent and data tokens. The authors apply recurrent latent self-conditioning during diffusion and report state-of-the-art pixel diffusion results for image and video generation at 1024×1024 resolution.
items.summary_zh: 循环接口网络是一种基于注意力的架构，将核心计算与输入输出维度解耦。它在潜在 Token 上执行全局自注意力，并通过交叉注意力在潜在 Token 与数据 Token 之间传递信息。作者在扩散过程中采用循环式潜在自条件机制，并报告称该方法在 1024×1024 图像和视频生成的像素扩散模型上达到当前最佳结果。

items.title_en: Ask HN: When does your app need its own UI vs. using it via MCP?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：应用何时需要独立 UI，何时只需通过 MCP 使用？
items.summary_en: The discussion asks when an application should provide its own user interface instead of exposing data through MCP to Claude or ChatGPT. It considers a future in which most work happens inside conversational AI systems and asks how application developers should build for that environment.
items.summary_zh: 讨论聚焦于应用何时应提供独立用户界面，何时只需通过 MCP 向 Claude 或 ChatGPT 提供数据。问题还设想了未来大部分工作都在对话式 AI 系统中完成的场景，并探讨应用开发者应如何面向这种环境构建产品。

items.title_en: Identity Verification Built for Devs
items.title_zh: 为开发者打造的身份验证
items.summary_en: The service provides an open-source identity-verification API with OCR, liveness detection, and face matching. It supports deterministic decisions and can be self-hosted with Docker or run on managed cloud infrastructure. The project describes itself as GDPR-friendly.
items.summary_zh: 该服务提供开源身份验证 API，支持 OCR、活体检测和人脸匹配。它支持确定性决策，可通过 Docker 自托管，也可以运行在托管云基础设施上。项目称其符合 GDPR 友好原则。

items.title_en: Ergodicity: What Does It Mean?
items.title_zh: 遍历性：它意味着什么？
items.summary_en: The essay explains why the distinction between ensemble averages and time averages matters for investing and risk. It argues that investment and wealth processes are non-ergodic, so expected values can be misleading when applied directly to individual outcomes. The author uses the concept to develop an accessible explanation of ergodicity in finance.
items.summary_zh: 文章解释了集合平均与时间平均的区别为何会影响投资和风险判断。作者认为，投资和财富过程具有非遍历性，因此将期望值直接用于个人结果时可能会产生误导。文章以此为基础，试图用易懂的方式解释遍历性在金融中的含义。

items.title_en: Ex MS researcher publishes claimed Windows lock-screen bypass through Narrator
items.title_zh: 前微软研究员公布据称可通过讲述人绕过 Windows 锁屏的方法
items.summary_en: Abdelhamid Naceri published FastUnlock, a claimed Windows 11 lock-screen bypass using Narrator. It requires physical access, has not been independently reproduced in the reviewed reporting, and the public demonstration stops before showing code execution.
items.summary_zh: Abdelhamid Naceri 发布了 FastUnlock，声称该工具可利用“讲述人”绕过 Windows 11 锁屏。该方法需要物理接触设备，相关报道中尚未得到独立复现，公开演示也没有展示代码执行。

items.title_en: LiberNT: An AI-Fueled Fork of ReactOS Focused on Windows 11 Compatibility
items.title_zh: LiberNT：利用 AI、面向 Windows 11 兼容性的 ReactOS 分支
items.summary_en: LiberNT is a new project forked from the ReactOS codebase and uses AI to iterate quickly. Its goal is compatibility with Windows 11, while ReactOS continues conventional progress such as initial USB 3.0 driver and improved DirectX support.
items.summary_zh: LiberNT 是一个从 ReactOS 代码库分叉出来的新项目，利用 AI 加快迭代，目标是实现 Windows 11 兼容性。与此同时，ReactOS 仍在以传统方式推进，例如初步支持 USB 3.0 驱动并改进 DirectX 支持。

items.title_en: Claude Mythos slashed software work to onboard AMD GPUs to around three days
items.title_zh: Claude Mythos 将 AMD GPU 软件适配工作压缩到约三天
items.summary_en: Anthropic says its Claude Mythos Preview brought one model’s prompt processing to AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs in about three days. The claim suggests that AI-generated low-level code could reduce the software work required to support non-Nvidia accelerators. It also bears on the role of CUDA in the GPU software ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，Claude Mythos Preview 用约三天时间让一个模型的提示词处理运行在 AMD Instinct MI355X GPU 上。这一说法表明，AI 生成的底层代码可能减少支持非英伟达加速器所需的软件工作量。它也涉及 CUDA 在 GPU 软件生态中的作用。
